functions.name: Card.AddCounter

params.name: singly
params.description: default: false

description_zh: 尝试给c放置count个countertype类型的指示物，并返回核心是否接受该次放置。
c必须受当前处理中的原因效果影响。放置指示物的玩家使用当前原因玩家。singly为true时，指示物上限检查允许只放置到剩余上限为止。
description_en: Attempts to add count counters of countertype to c and returns whether the core accepted the addition.

The card must be affected by the resolving reason effect. The current reason player is used as the player adding the counters. When singly is true, counter-limit checks allow a partial addition up to the remaining limit.

functions.name: Card.AddMonsterAttribute

params.name: attribute
params.description: default: 0

params.name: race
params.description: default: 0

params.name: level
params.description: default: 0

params.name: atk
params.description: default: 0

params.name: def
params.description: default: 0

description_zh: 通过效果给c追加临时怪兽属性。
该绑定会清除STATUS_NO_LEVEL，用type适用EFFECT_PRE_MONSTER，并对非零的属性、种族、等级、基础攻击力和基础守备力数值适用对应变更效果。
description_en: Adds temporary monster properties to c through effects.
The binding clears STATUS_NO_LEVEL, applies EFFECT_PRE_MONSTER with type, and applies Attribute, Race, Level, base ATK, and base DEF changes for nonzero supplied values.

functions.name: Card.AssumeProperty
description_zh: 临时假定c的一个属性供核心检查使用。
assume_type可为ASSUME_CODE、ASSUME_TYPE、ASSUME_LEVEL、ASSUME_RANK、ASSUME_ATTRIBUTE、ASSUME_RACE、ASSUME_ATTACK或ASSUME_DEFENSE。
description_en: Temporarily assumes one property of c for core checks.
assume_type is one of ASSUME_CODE, ASSUME_TYPE, ASSUME_LEVEL, ASSUME_RANK, ASSUME_ATTRIBUTE, ASSUME_RACE, ASSUME_ATTACK, or ASSUME_DEFENSE.

functions.name: Card.CancelCardTarget
description_zh: 把target从c的持续卡片对象关系中移除。
description_en: Removes target from c's persistent card-target relation list.

functions.name: Card.CancelToGrave

params.name: cancel
params.description: default: true

description_zh: 取消送墓确定状态，cancel=false则重新设置送墓确定状态
注：送墓确定状态指的是在场上发动的不留场的魔法和陷阱后，这些卡片的状态
送墓确定状态中的卡无法返回手卡和卡组，并且连锁结束时送去墓地
此函数的作用是取消此状态使其留场，用于光之护封剑和废铁稻草人等卡
description_en: Cancels the confirmed-to-Graveyard state for c. If cancel is false, sets that state again.

This state is used for non-continuous Spell/Trap Cards activated on the field before they leave the field; while set, they cannot return to the hand or Deck and are sent to the Graveyard when the Chain ends.
Use this helper to keep such cards on the field, as with Swords of Revealing Light or Scrap-Iron Scarecrow.

functions.name: Card.CheckActivateEffect

params.name: neglect_con
params.description: true to skip the activation effect's condition check.
params.description_zh: 为true时跳过该发动效果的Condition检查。

params.name: neglect_cost
params.description: true to skip the activation effect's cost check.
params.description_zh: 为true时跳过该发动效果的Cost检查。

params.name: copy_info
params.description: true to copy triggering-event information for non-free-chain activations.
params.description_zh: 为true时，对非自由时点发动复制触发时点信息。

returns.description: The usable activation effect, or nil/no value if none is currently usable.
returns.description_zh: 可用的发动效果；当前没有可用发动效果时为nil/不返回值。

returns.description: eg when copy_info returns event data.
returns.description_zh: copy_info返回事件信息时的eg。

returns.description: ep when copy_info returns event data.
returns.description_zh: copy_info返回事件信息时的ep。

returns.description: ev when copy_info returns event data.
returns.description_zh: copy_info返回事件信息时的ev。

returns.description: re when copy_info returns event data.
returns.description_zh: copy_info返回事件信息时的re。

returns.description: r when copy_info returns event data.
returns.description_zh: copy_info返回事件信息时的r。

returns.description: rp when copy_info returns event data.
returns.description_zh: copy_info返回事件信息时的rp。

description_zh: 检查c是否有当前可以发动的卡片发动效果。
neglect_con为true时跳过Condition检查；neglect_cost为true时跳过Cost检查。
copy_info为true且匹配的发动效果不是自由时点发动时，返回值会包含触发时点信息：eg、ep、ev、re、r、rp。
没有可用发动效果时不返回Lua值，因此本地脚本通常检查第一个返回值是否不为nil。
description_en: Checks whether c has an activation effect that can currently be activated.
If neglect_con is true, condition checks are skipped. If neglect_cost is true, cost checks are skipped.
When copy_info is true and the matching activation is not a free-chain activation, the returned values include the triggering event information: eg, ep, ev, re, r, and rp.
Returns no Lua values when no activation effect is currently usable, so local scripts usually compare the first result with nil.

functions.name: Card.CheckEquipTarget
description_zh: 检查c2是否是c1的合法装备对象。
核心要求c1受到接受c2的EFFECT_EQUIP_LIMIT影响，并且还会检查旧式和现代同盟怪兽的装备数量限制。
description_en: Checks whether c2 is a valid Equip target for c1.
The core requires c1 to be affected by an EFFECT_EQUIP_LIMIT that accepts c2, and it also enforces old and modern Union count limits.

functions.name: Card.CheckFusionMaterial

params.name: chkf
params.description: default: PLAYER_NONE

params.name: not_material
params.description: default: false

description_zh: 检查c的融合素材要求是否可以由g满足，并可要求必须包含gc。
chkf会传给融合素材条件检查；not_material用于只检查素材可用性、但暂不把卡视为实际素材的手续。
description_en: Checks whether c's Fusion Material requirements can be satisfied by g, optionally requiring gc to be included.
chkf is forwarded to the Fusion Material condition check, and not_material is used by procedures that check material availability without treating the cards as actual materials yet.

functions.name: Card.CheckFusionSubstitute
description_zh: 检查c能否代替融合怪兽fcard所列名的指定融合素材。
description_en: Checks whether c can substitute for a specifically named Fusion Material listed by Fusion Monster fcard.

functions.name: Card.CheckRemoveOverlayCard
description_zh: 检查player能否为了reason从c上取除至少count个超量素材。
即使c本身素材不足，可适用的EFFECT_OVERLAY_REMOVE_REPLACE替代效果也可能使该函数返回true。
description_en: Checks whether player can remove at least count Xyz Materials from c for reason.
Replacement effects with EFFECT_OVERLAY_REMOVE_REPLACE can make this return true even when c itself has too few materials.

functions.name: Card.CheckUnionTarget
description_zh: 检查target是否是在EFFECT_UNION_LIMIT下c的合法同盟装备对象。
核心还会检查c与target之间的新式/旧式同盟数量兼容性。
description_en: Checks whether target is a valid Union equip target for c under EFFECT_UNION_LIMIT.
The core also enforces new/old Union count compatibility between c and target.

functions.name: Card.CheckUniqueOnField

params.name: c
params.description: Card being tested against unique-on-field restrictions.

params.name: check_player
params.description: Player whose field is checked for a uniqueness conflict.

params.name: check_location
params.description: On-field location mask to check; default: LOCATION_ONFIELD. The core masks this value to LOCATION_ONFIELD.

params.name: icard
params.description: Optional card ignored during the check, useful when testing a pending replacement or move.

returns.description: True if c can coexist under the unique-on-field rules for the requested player and location.

description_zh: 检查c在check_player场上是否满足当前唯一性规则，可以与已存在的卡共存。
check_location默认LOCATION_ONFIELD，并会被限制为场上位置；测试即将移动的卡时，可用icard指定一张忽略的卡。
description_en: Checks whether c can coexist on check_player's field under the current unique-on-field rules.
check_location defaults to LOCATION_ONFIELD and is masked to on-field locations. icard can be supplied as an ignored card when testing a pending move.

functions.name: Card.ClearEffectRelation
description_zh: 清除c当前保存的全部效果关系。
description_en: Clears all effect relations currently stored on c.

functions.name: Card.CompleteProcedure
description_zh: 把c标记为已经完成正规召唤手续。
description_en: Marks c as having completed its proper Summon procedure.

functions.name: Card.CopyEffect

params.name: count
params.description: default: 1

description_zh: 把卡号code的initial_effect复制到c上，并返回生成的复制id；code对应通常怪兽时返回-1。
reset为0时默认RESETS_STANDARD。count默认1；带阶段重置但未指定自己/对方回合时，会规范为双方回合。若c是非效果怪兽，核心还会以同样重置条件追加TYPE_EFFECT。
description_en: Copies the initial_effect of card code onto c and returns the generated copy id, or -1 if code belongs to a Normal Monster.

reset defaults to RESETS_STANDARD when 0. count defaults to 1; phase resets without a turn side are normalized to both players' turns. If c is a non-Effect Monster, the core also adds TYPE_EFFECT for the same reset.

functions.name: Card.CreateEffectRelation
description_zh: 在c与效果e之间建立关联。
若e是当前连锁中某个连锁环的发动效果，该关联会绑定到该连锁环；否则核心会保存直接的效果关联。
description_en: Creates a relation between c and effect e.
If e is the triggering effect of a current Chain Link, the relation is tied to that Chain Link; otherwise the core stores a direct effect relation.

functions.name: Card.CreateRelation
description_zh: 建立从c1到c2的关系，并按reset清除。
description_en: Creates a relation from c1 to c2 that is cleared by reset.

functions.name: Card.EnableCounterPermit

params.name: c
params.description: Card receiving the counter permit effect.

params.name: countertype
params.description: Counter type that c is allowed to hold.

params.name: location
params.description: Single-effect range for the permit. Omitted defaults to LOCATION_MZONE for monsters, otherwise LOCATION_SZONE + LOCATION_FZONE.

params.name: condition
params.description: Optional condition callback stored on the permit effect; ignored unless this argument is a function.

description_zh: 给c登记单卡的指示物许可效果，使其可以在指定范围放置countertype类型的指示物。
省略location时，怪兽默认LOCATION_MZONE，非怪兽默认LOCATION_SZONE + LOCATION_FZONE。提供condition时会作为该许可效果的条件回调保存。
description_en: Registers a single-card counter permit effect allowing c to receive counters of countertype in the chosen range.
If location is omitted, monsters default to LOCATION_MZONE and non-monsters default to LOCATION_SZONE + LOCATION_FZONE. An optional condition callback is stored on the permit effect.

functions.name: Card.EnableDualState
description_zh: 给c登记带客户端提示的EFFECT_DUAL_STATUS效果。
description_en: Registers an EFFECT_DUAL_STATUS client-hint effect on c.

functions.name: Card.EnableReviveLimit
description_zh: 为c添加苏生限制
##实际上是不可复制、不会被无效的EFFECT_UNSUMMONABLE_CARD和EFFECT_REVIVE_LIMIT效果
description_en: Marks c as needing to be properly Summoned before it can be Special Summoned from public locations.

functions.name: Card.GetActivateEffect

returns.description: The activation effect registered on c, or nil if none is registered.
returns.description_zh: c上登记的发动效果；没有登记时返回nil。

description_zh: 返回c的发动效果，即类型包含EFFECT_TYPE_ACTIVATE的效果；主要用于魔法/陷阱卡。
如果该卡没有登记发动效果则返回nil，因此调用Effect方法前应先检查返回值。
当其他效果要移动或处理场地魔法等魔法/陷阱的发动时，可用返回的Effect先检查其是否可以发动。
description_en: Returns c's activation effect, the effect with type EFFECT_TYPE_ACTIVATE. This is mainly used for Spell/Trap Cards.
Returns nil when the card has no registered activation effect, so guard the result before calling Effect methods.
Use the returned Effect to check whether a Field Spell or other Spell/Trap can be activated before moving or resolving it through another effect.

functions.name: Card.GetAttack
description_zh: 返回c当前的攻击力；未知或负数攻击力按0返回。
description_en: Returns c's current ATK, with unknown or negative ATK reported as 0.

functions.name: Card.GetAttackableTarget

returns.description: Attackable monsters.
Whether c can attack directly.

description_zh: 返回c可攻击的卡的Group，以及c能否直接攻击的布尔值。
description_en: Returns the Group of cards c can attack and a boolean indicating whether c can attack directly.

functions.name: Card.GetAttackAnnouncedCount
description_zh: 返回c的攻击宣言次数。
description_en: Returns c's attack declaration count.

functions.name: Card.GetAttackedCount
description_zh: 返回c在当前回合的攻击次数。
description_en: Returns c's attack count for the current turn.

functions.name: Card.GetAttackedGroup
description_zh: 返回c攻击过的卡组成的Group。
description_en: Returns the Group of cards that c has attacked.

functions.name: Card.GetAttackedGroupCount
description_zh: 返回c保存的攻击记录数量。
description_en: Returns the number of attack records stored for c.

functions.name: Card.GetAttribute
description_zh: 返回c当前的属性位掩码。
被视为具有多个属性的卡可能返回多个ATTRIBUTE_*值的按位组合。
description_en: Returns c's current Attribute bitmask.
Cards treated as having multiple Attributes can return a bitwise combination of ATTRIBUTE_* values.

functions.name: Card.GetAttributeInGrave

params.name: player
params.description: default: current reason player

description_zh: 返回c在墓地中对player视为具有的属性；player省略时使用当前原因玩家。
description_en: Returns the Attribute c is treated as having in the GY for player, defaulting to the current reason player.

functions.name: Card.GetBaseAttack
description_zh: 返回c当前的基础攻击力；未知或负数攻击力按0返回。
description_en: Returns c's current base ATK, with unknown or negative ATK reported as 0.

functions.name: Card.GetBaseDefense
description_zh: 返回c当前的基础守备力。未知或负数基础守备力会被该绑定限制为0。
description_en: Returns c's current base DEF. Unknown or negative base DEF values are clamped to 0 by this binding.

functions.name: Card.GetBattledGroup
description_zh: 返回c已经战斗过的卡组成的Group。
description_en: Returns the Group of cards that c has battled.

functions.name: Card.GetBattledGroupCount
description_zh: 返回c当前记录的已战斗卡集合数量。
description_en: Returns the number of cards currently recorded in c's battled-cards set.

functions.name: Card.GetBattlePosition
description_zh: 返回c的临时战斗表示形式快照。
description_en: Returns c's temporary battle-position snapshot.

functions.name: Card.GetBattleTarget

returns.description: The monster battling c, or nil.

description_zh: 返回当前正在与c战斗的怪兽；若c不是当前攻击怪兽或攻击对象则返回nil。
description_en: Returns the monster currently battling c, or nil if c is not the current attacker or attack target.

functions.name: Card.GetCardTarget
description_zh: 返回包含c当前记录的全部持续取对象卡的Group。
description_en: Returns a Group containing all persistent card targets currently recorded on c.

functions.name: Card.GetCardTargetCount
description_zh: 返回c当前记录的持续取对象卡数量。
description_en: Returns the number of persistent card targets currently recorded on c.

functions.name: Card.GetCode
description_zh: 返回c的当前卡号（可能因为效果改变）
description_en: Returns c's current card code and, when present, its secondary code.

functions.name: Card.GetColumnGroup
description_zh: 返回与c位于同一纵列的卡组成的Group。
此MDPro3/YGOPro绑定只接收c。它使用c当前场上的纵列，包含相关怪兽区域、魔法与陷阱区域以及额外怪兽区域的纵列关系；若c不在场上，返回的Group为空。
description_en: Returns a Group containing cards in the same column as c.

This MDPro3/YGOPro binding only takes c. It uses c's current on-field column, including related Monster Zones, Spell & Trap Zones, and Extra Monster Zone column relationships; if c is not on the field, the returned Group is empty.

functions.name: Card.GetColumnGroupCount
description_zh: 返回与c所在纵列重叠的卡数量。
description_en: Returns the number of cards in columns overlapping c.

functions.name: Card.GetColumnZone
description_zh: 返回loc范围内与c所在纵列重叠的区域位掩码。
提供player且视角为对方时，核心会交换掩码中的双方区域部分。
description_en: Returns the zone bitmask for columns overlapping c within loc.
When player is supplied as the opposing perspective, the core swaps the player/opponent halves of the mask.

functions.name: Card.GetControler
description_zh: 返回c的当前控制者
description_en: Returns c's current controller.

functions.name: Card.GetCounter
description_zh: 返回c上的countertype类型指示物信息。
countertype为0时，此核心返回c当前拥有的不同指示物类型数量，而不是全部指示物的总数。
description_en: Returns counters on c for countertype.
When countertype is 0, this core returns the number of different counter types currently present on c, not the total number of all counters.

functions.name: Card.GetCurrentScale
description_zh: 返回c当前使用的灵摆刻度。
在灵摆区域时，会按c所在区域序号返回当前左/右刻度；不在灵摆区域时，返回c记载的左刻度数值。
description_en: Returns the Pendulum Scale c currently uses.
In a Pendulum Zone, this returns the left or right current scale according to c's zone sequence. Outside a Pendulum Zone, it returns c's printed left scale value.

functions.name: Card.GetDefense
description_zh: 返回c当前的守备力。未知或负数守备力会被该绑定限制为0。
description_en: Returns c's current DEF. Unknown or negative DEF values are clamped to 0 by this binding.

functions.name: Card.GetDestination
description_zh: 返回c当前送去参数中保存的目标位置。
description_en: Returns the destination location currently stored in c's send-to parameters.

functions.name: Card.GetEffectCount
description_zh: 返回c的效果筛选中当前找到的code效果数量。
description_en: Returns the number of effects with code currently found by c's effect filter.

functions.name: Card.GetEquipCount
description_zh: 返回当前装备给c的装备卡数量。
description_en: Returns the number of Equip Cards currently equipped to c.

functions.name: Card.GetEquipGroup
description_zh: 以Group返回当前装备给c的装备卡。
description_en: Returns the Equip Cards currently equipped to c as a Group.

functions.name: Card.GetEquipTarget
description_zh: 返回c当前装备到的卡；如果c没有装备对象则返回nil。
description_en: Returns the card that c is currently equipped to, or nil if c has no equip target.

functions.name: Card.GetFieldID

params.name: c
params.description: Card whose current field ID is returned.

returns.description: Current field ID assigned by the core for c's current field identity.

description_zh: 返回c当前的field ID，即核心在c移动到当前位置时分配的时间标识。
数值越小表示越早进入当前位置。核心会在卡获得新的场上身份时更新该值，例如进入场上或变更控制者。此值不同于Card.GetRealFieldID，后者用于战斗状态等真实位置检查。
description_en: Returns c's current field ID, the core timestamp assigned when c moved to its current place.

Smaller values are older. The core refreshes this value when the card gains a new field identity, such as entering the field or changing controller. This differs from Card.GetRealFieldID, which tracks the real field ID used by battle-state checks.

functions.name: Card.GetFirstCardTarget
description_zh: 返回c的第1个持续取对象卡；没有时返回nil。
description_en: Returns c's first persistent card target, or nil.

functions.name: Card.GetFlagEffect

params.name: c
params.description: Card whose single-card flag effects are counted.

params.name: code
params.description: Flag-effect code; the core masks it with MAX_CARD_ID and adds EFFECT_FLAG_EFFECT.

returns.description: Number of matching flag effects on c.

description_zh: 返回c上编号为code的标记效果数量。
description_en: Returns how many flag effects with code are registered on c.

functions.name: Card.GetFlagEffectLabel

params.name: c
params.description: Card whose single-card flag effects are inspected.

params.name: code
params.description: Flag-effect code; the core masks it with MAX_CARD_ID and adds EFFECT_FLAG_EFFECT.

returns.description: First label value, or nil if no matching flag effect exists.
Additional integer label values from additional matching flag effects.

description_zh: 返回c上编号为code的每个标记效果的第1个Label值。
没有匹配的标记效果时返回nil；匹配的标记效果没有Label时，该位置返回0。
description_en: Returns the first label value from each flag effect with the given code on c.
If c has no matching flag effect, the core returns nil. Matching flag effects with no label return 0 for that slot.

functions.name: Card.GetFusionAttribute

params.name: player
params.description: default: current reason player

description_zh: 返回c作为融合素材使用时对player使用的属性；player省略时使用当前原因玩家。
description_en: Returns the Attribute c uses as Fusion Material for player, defaulting to the current reason player.

functions.name: Card.GetFusionCode

returns.description: Current code.
Additional Fusion Material code values, if any.

description_zh: 返回c作为融合素材使用时的卡号：当前卡号、存在时的第二卡号，以及EFFECT_ADD_FUSION_CODE的追加值。
核心以not_material状态检查时，只返回当前卡号和第二卡号。
description_en: Returns c's Fusion Material codes: current code, second code when present, then EFFECT_ADD_FUSION_CODE values.
When the core is checking with not_material set, only the current and second codes are returned.

functions.name: Card.GetFusionType
description_zh: 返回c用于融合素材检查的融合素材种类位掩码。
description_en: Returns c's Fusion Material Type mask used by Fusion Material checks.

functions.name: Card.GetHandSynchro

returns.description: Hand Synchro enabling effect.
Effect target function.
Minimum hand-material count.
Maximum hand-material count.

description_zh: 返回c上的手牌同调启用效果、其Target函数，以及手牌素材数量min/max。
只检查怪兽区域中的卡。优先检查EFFECT_HAND_SYNCHRO，其次检查带LOCATION_HAND的EFFECT_TUNER_MATERIAL_LIMIT。
description_en: Returns the hand-Synchro enabling effect on c, its target function, and the min/max hand-material counts.
Only Monster Zone cards are checked. EFFECT_HAND_SYNCHRO has priority, then EFFECT_TUNER_MATERIAL_LIMIT with LOCATION_HAND.

functions.name: Card.GetLeaveFieldDest
description_zh: 返回c因REASON_EFFECT适用离场改去效果时会前往的位置。
description_en: Returns the location c would be redirected to by leave-field effects for REASON_EFFECT.

functions.name: Card.GetLeftScale
description_zh: 返回c当前的左灵摆刻度数值。
description_en: Returns c's current left Pendulum Scale value.

functions.name: Card.GetLevel
description_zh: 返回c的当前等级
description_en: Returns c's current Level.

functions.name: Card.GetLink
description_zh: 返回c的连接值；c不是连接怪兽时返回0。
description_en: Returns c's Link Rating, or 0 if c is not a Link Monster.

functions.name: Card.GetLinkAttribute

params.name: player
params.description: default: current reason player

description_zh: 返回c作为连接素材使用时对player使用的属性；player省略时使用当前原因玩家。
description_en: Returns the Attribute c uses as Link Material for player, defaulting to the current reason player.

functions.name: Card.GetLinkCode

returns.description: Current code.
Additional Link Material code values, if any.

description_zh: 返回c作为连接素材使用时的卡号：当前卡号、存在时的第二卡号，以及EFFECT_ADD_LINK_CODE的追加值。
description_en: Returns c's Link Material codes: current code, second code when present, then EFFECT_ADD_LINK_CODE values.

functions.name: Card.GetLinkedGroup
description_zh: 返回当前位于c连接区域中的卡。
description_en: Returns the cards currently occupying zones linked by c.

functions.name: Card.GetLinkedGroupCount
description_zh: 返回位于c所连接区域中的卡数量。
description_en: Returns the number of cards in zones linked by c.

functions.name: Card.GetLinkedZone

params.name: player
params.description: default: c's controller

description_zh: 返回c产生的连接区域位掩码。
默认从c控制者视角返回。传入对方玩家作为player时，会交换自己/对方两部分位掩码，转换为该玩家视角。
description_en: Returns the linked-zone bitmask generated by c.
By default the bitmask is from c's controller perspective. Passing the opponent as player swaps the self and opponent halves to that player's perspective.

functions.name: Card.GetLinkRace

params.name: player
params.description: default: current reason player

description_zh: 返回c作为连接素材使用时对player使用的种族；player省略时使用当前原因玩家。
description_en: Returns the Race c uses as Link Material for player, defaulting to the current reason player.

functions.name: Card.GetLinkType
description_zh: 返回c用于连接素材检查的连接素材种类位掩码。
description_en: Returns c's Link Material Type mask used by Link Material checks.

functions.name: Card.GetLocation
description_zh: 返回c当前所在位置；c当前被当作不在场上时返回0。
description_en: Returns c's current location, or 0 if c is currently treated as not being on the field.

functions.name: Card.GetMaterial

params.name: c
params.description: Card whose stored material list is being read.

returns.description: New Group containing c's stored material cards; the Group is empty if no material cards are stored.

description_zh: 返回c当前记录的素材卡Group。
description_en: Returns a Group containing the cards currently stored as c's material cards.

functions.name: Card.GetMaterialCount
description_zh: 返回当前记录为c素材的卡数量。
description_en: Returns the number of cards currently recorded as c's materials.

functions.name: Card.GetMutualLinkedGroup
description_zh: 返回与c互相连接的卡的Group。
description_en: Returns the Group of cards mutually linked with c.

functions.name: Card.GetMutualLinkedGroupCount
description_zh: 返回与c互相连接的卡数量。
description_en: Returns the number of cards mutually linked with c.

functions.name: Card.GetMutualLinkedZone

params.name: player
params.description: default: c:GetControler()

description_zh: 返回c互相连接的区域位掩码；提供与c控制者相对的player参数时，会交换为该玩家视角。
description_en: Returns the zone mask of c's mutually linked zones, swapped to player viewpoint when a player argument opposite c's controller is supplied.

functions.name: Card.GetOriginalAttribute
description_zh: 返回c卡片数据中的原本属性；c带STATUS_NO_LEVEL时返回0。
description_en: Returns c's original Attribute from card data, or 0 while c is marked with STATUS_NO_LEVEL.

functions.name: Card.GetOriginalCode
description_zh: 返回c卡片数据中的原本卡号。
description_en: Returns c's original card code from card data.

functions.name: Card.GetOriginalCodeRule

returns.description: Primary rule-original code.
Second rule code, when present.

description_zh: 返回c按规则使用的原本卡号。
双卡号卡返回两个卡号：记载的原本卡号和第二规则卡号。其他卡只返回核心使用的决斗卡号。
description_en: Returns c's rule-original card code.
Double-code cards return two codes: the printed original code and the second rule code. Other cards return only the duel code used by the core.

functions.name: Card.GetOriginalLeftScale
description_zh: 返回c记载的左灵摆刻度。
description_en: Returns c's printed left Pendulum Scale.

functions.name: Card.GetOriginalLevel
description_zh: 返回c卡片数据中的原本等级；超量怪兽、连接怪兽以及带STATUS_NO_LEVEL的卡返回0。
description_en: Returns c's original Level from card data, or 0 for Xyz Monsters, Link Monsters, and cards marked with STATUS_NO_LEVEL.

functions.name: Card.GetOriginalRace
description_zh: 返回c卡片数据中的原本种族；c带STATUS_NO_LEVEL时返回0。
description_en: Returns c's original Race from card data, or 0 while c is marked with STATUS_NO_LEVEL.

functions.name: Card.GetOriginalRank
description_zh: 返回c卡片数据中的原本阶级；c不是超量怪兽时返回0。
description_en: Returns c's printed Rank from card data, or 0 if c is not an Xyz Monster.

functions.name: Card.GetOriginalRightScale
description_zh: 返回c记载的右灵摆刻度。
description_en: Returns c's printed right Pendulum Scale.

functions.name: Card.GetOriginalType
description_zh: 返回c原本卡片数据中的种类位掩码，而不是当前被修改后的种类。
description_en: Returns c's original card-data type bitmask, not its current modified type.

functions.name: Card.GetOverlayCount
description_zh: 返回c当前叠放的超量素材数量。
description_en: Returns the number of current Xyz Materials attached to c.

functions.name: Card.GetOverlayGroup
description_zh: 返回当前叠放在c下面作为超量素材的卡组成的Group。
description_en: Returns a Group containing the cards currently attached to c as Xyz Materials.

functions.name: Card.GetOverlayTarget
description_zh: 返回c作为超量素材叠放到的卡；c未作为素材叠放时返回nil。
description_en: Returns the card that c is attached to as an Xyz Material, or nil when c is not attached.

functions.name: Card.GetOwner
description_zh: 返回c的原本持有者玩家。
description_en: Returns c's original owner player.

functions.name: Card.GetOwnerTarget
description_zh: 返回把c作为持续卡片对象拥有者的卡组成的Group。
description_en: Returns the Group of cards that are targeting c as their persistent card-target owner.

functions.name: Card.GetOwnerTargetCount
description_zh: 返回把c作为持续卡片对象拥有者的卡数量。
description_en: Returns the number of cards targeting c as their persistent card-target owner.

functions.name: Card.GetPosition
description_zh: 返回c当前的表示形式数值。
description_en: Returns c's current position value.

functions.name: Card.GetPreviousAttackOnField
description_zh: 返回c之前场上状态记录的攻击力数值。
description_en: Returns the ATK value recorded for c's previous on-field state.

functions.name: Card.GetPreviousAttributeOnField
description_zh: 返回c之前场上状态记录的属性数值。
description_en: Returns the Attribute value recorded for c's previous on-field state.

functions.name: Card.GetPreviousCodeOnField

returns.description: Second previous code, when present.

description_zh: 返回c之前场上状态记录的卡号。
若之前状态有第二卡号，则第二卡号作为第2个返回值返回。
description_en: Returns the card code recorded for c's previous on-field state.
If the previous state had a second code, that code is returned as a second value.

functions.name: Card.GetPreviousControler
description_zh: 返回c之前记录的控制者。
description_en: Returns c's previous controller value.

functions.name: Card.GetPreviousDefenseOnField
description_zh: 返回c先前在场上时的DEF值。
description_en: Returns the DEF value c had while it was previously on the field.

functions.name: Card.GetPreviousEquipTarget
description_zh: 返回c之前的装备对象；没有时返回nil。
description_en: Returns c's previous Equip target, or nil.

functions.name: Card.GetPreviousLevelOnField
description_zh: 返回c先前在场上时的等级值。
description_en: Returns the Level value c had while it was previously on the field.

functions.name: Card.GetPreviousLocation
description_zh: 返回c在上一次位置变化前的原位置位掩码。
description_en: Returns c's previous location bitmask from before its last location change.

functions.name: Card.GetPreviousOverlayCountOnField
description_zh: 返回c位置变化之前在场上叠放的卡片数量
description_en: Returns the number of cards that were overlaid on c while it was previously on the field.

functions.name: Card.GetPreviousPosition
description_zh: 返回c之前记录的表示形式数值。
description_en: Returns c's previously recorded position value.

functions.name: Card.GetPreviousRaceOnField
description_zh: 返回c之前场上状态记录的种族数值。
description_en: Returns the Race value recorded for c's previous on-field state.

functions.name: Card.GetPreviousRankOnField
description_zh: 返回c先前在场上时的阶级值。
description_en: Returns the Rank value c had while it was previously on the field.

functions.name: Card.GetPreviousSequence
description_zh: 返回c之前记录的位置序号。
description_en: Returns c's previous sequence value.

functions.name: Card.GetPreviousTypeOnField
description_zh: 返回c之前场上状态记录的种类数值。
description_en: Returns the Type value recorded for c's previous on-field state.

functions.name: Card.GetRace
description_zh: 返回c的当前种族
注：对某些多种族怪兽如动画效果的魔术猿，此函数的返回值可能是几个种族的组合值
description_en: Returns c's current Race value. Cards with multiple Races can return a bitmask containing more than one Race.

functions.name: Card.GetRaceInGrave
description_zh: 返回c在墓地中对player视为具有的种族；player省略时使用当前原因玩家。
description_en: Returns the Race c is treated as having in the GY for player, defaulting to the current reason player.

functions.name: Card.GetRank
description_zh: 返回c当前的阶级。
非超量卡返回0。超量怪兽不在怪兽区域时返回原本阶级；在怪兽区域时会应用阶级变更效果，结果最低为1。
description_en: Returns c's current Rank.
Non-Xyz cards return 0. Xyz Monsters outside the Monster Zone return their original Rank; in the Monster Zone, Rank-changing effects are applied and the result is at least 1.

functions.name: Card.GetRealFieldID
description_zh: 返回c的真实field ID，即核心用于关系追踪的场上识别值。
description_en: Returns c's real field ID, the core field identifier used for relation tracking.

functions.name: Card.GetReason
description_zh: 返回c当前记录的原因位掩码/数值。
这是c当前状态中记录的原因，例如REASON_EFFECT、REASON_COST或REASON_BATTLE；并不只用于表示形式变更。
description_en: Returns c's current reason bitmask/value.
This is the reason recorded in c's current state, such as REASON_EFFECT, REASON_COST, or REASON_BATTLE; it is not limited to position changes.

functions.name: Card.GetReasonCard
description_zh: 返回c当前记录的原因卡；没有记录原因卡时返回nil。
description_en: Returns c's current reason card, or nil when no reason card is recorded.

functions.name: Card.GetReasonEffect
description_zh: 返回c当前记录的原因效果；没有记录原因效果时返回nil。
description_en: Returns c's current reason effect, or nil when no reason effect is recorded.

functions.name: Card.GetReasonPlayer
description_zh: 返回c当前记录的原因玩家，即c当前原因状态中的玩家。
description_en: Returns c's current reason player, the player recorded in c's current reason state.

functions.name: Card.GetRightScale
description_zh: 返回c当前的右灵摆刻度数值。
description_en: Returns c's current right Pendulum Scale value.

functions.name: Card.GetRitualLevel
description_zh: 返回c为仪式怪兽rc提供的仪式等级数值。
description_en: Returns the Ritual Level value c contributes for Ritual Monster rc.

functions.name: Card.GetSequence

params.name: c
params.description: Card whose current sequence is returned.
params.description_zh: 要读取当前序号的卡。

returns.description: Sequence in c's current location.
returns.description_zh: c在当前位置中的序号。

description_zh: 返回c在当前位置中的序号。
在场上时，主要怪兽区域和魔法与陷阱区域从左到右使用0-4；场地区域使用5；灵摆区域使用6-7。
在其他位置时，序号表示该卡在该位置中的顺序，从0开始。
description_en: Returns c's sequence within its current location.
For field zones, Main Monster Zones and Spell & Trap Zones use 0-4 from left to right, the Field Zone uses 5, and Pendulum Zones use 6-7.
For other locations, sequence is the card's position in that location, starting from 0.

functions.name: Card.GetSpecialSummonInfo
description_zh: 返回c的特殊召唤的信息
SUMMON_INFO_CODE
SUMMON_INFO_CODE2
SUMMON_INFO_TYPE
SUMMON_INFO_LEVEL
SUMMON_INFO_RANK
SUMMON_INFO_ATTRIBUTE
SUMMON_INFO_RACE
SUMMON_INFO_ATTACK
SUMMON_INFO_DEFENSE
SUMMON_INFO_REASON_EFFET
description_en: Returns Special Summon information for c.

Supported fields include SUMMON_INFO_CODE, SUMMON_INFO_CODE2, SUMMON_INFO_TYPE, SUMMON_INFO_LEVEL, SUMMON_INFO_RANK, SUMMON_INFO_ATTRIBUTE, SUMMON_INFO_RACE, SUMMON_INFO_ATTACK, SUMMON_INFO_DEFENSE, SUMMON_INFO_REASON_EFFECT, and SUMMON_INFO_REASON_PLAYER.

functions.name: Card.GetSummonLocation
description_zh: 返回c是从哪个位置被召唤的，该值从召唤信息中解析。
description_en: Returns the location c was Summoned from, decoded from its summon information.

functions.name: Card.GetSummonPlayer
description_zh: 返回记录为召唤c的玩家。
description_en: Returns the player recorded as having Summoned c.

functions.name: Card.GetSummonType
description_zh: 返回c记录的召唤类型位，并按默认召唤类型字段进行掩码。
description_en: Returns c's recorded Summon Type bits masked to the default Summon Type field.

functions.name: Card.GetSynchroLevel
description_zh: 返回c为同调怪兽scard提供的同调等级数值。
description_en: Returns the Synchro Level value c contributes for Synchro Monster scard.

functions.name: Card.GetSynchroType
description_zh: 返回c用于同调素材检查的同调素材种类位掩码。
description_en: Returns c's Synchro Material Type mask used by Synchro Material checks.

functions.name: Card.GetTextAttack
description_zh: 返回c卡片数据中记录的攻击力。
这是记载/数据库数值，不是当前攻击力。不同于Card.GetAttack，该绑定不会把未知攻击力限制为0；但带STATUS_NO_LEVEL的卡返回0。
description_en: Returns the ATK value recorded in c's card data.
This is the printed/database value, not the current ATK. Unlike Card.GetAttack, the binding does not clamp unknown ATK to 0, except cards marked STATUS_NO_LEVEL return 0.

functions.name: Card.GetTextDefense
description_zh: 返回c卡片数据中记载/保存的守备力数值；c处于无等级状态时返回0。
description_en: Returns c's printed/stored DEF value, or 0 while c has no-Level status.

functions.name: Card.GetTributeRequirement

returns.description: Minimum Tribute count.
Maximum Tribute count.

description_zh: 返回通常召唤c所需的最小和最大解放数量。
description_en: Returns the minimum and maximum Tribute counts for Normal Summoning c.

functions.name: Card.GetTunerLimit

returns.description: The tuner-material-limit effect.
The effect target function, if any.
The effect value, if any.
Minimum allowed material count.
Maximum allowed material count.

description_zh: 返回影响c的调整素材限制效果、该效果的Target函数或nil、Value或nil，以及允许的最小和最大数量；没有该效果时不返回值。
description_en: Returns the tuner-material-limit effect affecting c, that effect's target function or nil, its value or nil, and the allowed minimum and maximum counts; if no such effect applies, no values are returned.

functions.name: Card.GetTurnCounter
description_zh: 返回c的回合计数器。
description_en: Returns c's turn counter.

functions.name: Card.GetTurnID
description_zh: 返回c保存的回合ID。
核心在卡加入某个位置时更新该值，因此脚本常用它与Duel.GetTurnCount()比较来判断同回合时点。
description_en: Returns c's stored turn ID.
The core updates this value when the card is added to a location, so scripts commonly compare it with Duel.GetTurnCount() for same-turn timing checks.

functions.name: Card.GetType
description_zh: 返回c当前的类型掩码，包含卡片当前受到的临时类型变更。
description_en: Returns c's current type mask, including temporary type changes applied to the card.

functions.name: Card.GetUnionCount

returns.description: Modern Union count.
Old Union count.

description_zh: 返回c当前的新式同盟数量和旧式同盟数量。
description_en: Returns c's modern Union count and old Union count.

functions.name: Card.GetXyzType
description_zh: 返回c用于超量素材检查的超量素材种类位掩码。
description_en: Returns c's Xyz Material Type mask used by Xyz Material checks.

functions.name: Card.IsAbleToChangeControler
description_zh: 只检查c是否不受EFFECT_CANNOT_CHANGE_CONTROL影响。
description_en: Checks only whether c is free of EFFECT_CANNOT_CHANGE_CONTROL.

functions.name: Card.IsAbleToDeck
description_zh: 检查c是否可以送去卡组
description_en: Checks whether c can be returned to the Deck.

functions.name: Card.IsAbleToDeckAsCost
description_zh: 检查c是否可以作为cost送去卡组
description_en: Checks whether c can be returned to the Deck as a cost.

functions.name: Card.IsAbleToDeckOrExtraAsCost
description_zh: 检查c是否可以作为cost送去卡组或额外卡组（用于新宇侠、剑斗兽融合怪兽的召唤手续检测）等价于 (c:IsAbleToDeckAsCost() or c:IsAbleToExtraAsCost())
description_en: Checks whether c can be returned to the Deck or Extra Deck as a cost.

functions.name: Card.IsAbleToExtra
description_zh: 判断c能否由当前原因玩家返回额外卡组。
description_en: Checks whether c can be returned to the Extra Deck by the current reason player.

functions.name: Card.IsAbleToExtraAsCost
description_zh: 检查c是否可以作为cost送去额外卡组，主卡组的灵摆卡会返回false
description_en: Checks whether c can be returned to the Extra Deck as a cost.

functions.name: Card.IsAbleToGrave
description_zh: 检查c是否可以送去墓地
description_en: Checks whether c can be sent to the Graveyard.

functions.name: Card.IsAbleToGraveAsCost
description_zh: 检查c是否可以作为cost送去墓地
description_en: Checks whether c can be sent to the Graveyard as a cost.

functions.name: Card.IsAbleToHand

params.name: player
params.description: default: reason player

description_zh: 判断c能否由player送去或返回手牌。
player省略时使用当前原因玩家。
description_en: Checks whether c can be returned or added to the hand by the current reason player.
An optional player argument can be passed when a specific player is performing the action.

functions.name: Card.IsAbleToHandAsCost
description_zh: 检查c是否可以作为cost送去手卡
注：此函数会在Card.IsAbleToHand的基础上追加检测c的实际目的地
当c送往手卡会被送去其它地方时（如缩退回路适用中，或者c是融合、同调 等额外怪兽的一种），此函数返回false
##以下几个函数类似
description_en: Checks whether c can be returned to the hand as a cost.
This uses c's actual return destination and returns false when the card would go somewhere other than the player's hand, such as the Extra Deck.

functions.name: Card.IsAbleToRemove
description_zh: 检查c是否可以被玩家player除外
description_en: Checks whether c can be banished by player in position pos for reason.
player defaults to the current reason player, pos defaults to POS_FACEUP, and reason defaults to REASON_EFFECT.

functions.name: Card.IsAbleToRemoveAsCost

params.name: pos
params.description: default: POS_FACEUP

description_zh: 判断c能否由当前原因玩家作为cost除外。
pos指定除外时的表示形式，省略时为POS_FACEUP。
description_en: Checks whether c can be banished as a cost by the current reason player.
pos controls the banished position and defaults to POS_FACEUP.

functions.name: Card.IsAllColumn
description_zh: 检查c是否被视为占用或适用于全部纵列。
description_en: Checks whether c is treated as occupying or applying to all columns.

functions.name: Card.IsAllReasons
description_zh: 检查c是否包含reason之中全部原因
description_en: Checks whether c includes all reasons in reason.

functions.name: Card.IsAllTypes
description_zh: 检查c是否包含type之中全部类型
description_en: Checks whether c includes all types in type.

functions.name: Card.IsAttack
description_zh: 检查c是否为怪兽或当前被当作怪兽，并且当前攻击力是否等于任意给定的atk值。
nil的atk参数会被跳过。不是怪兽且未被当作怪兽的卡返回false。
description_en: Checks whether c is a monster or currently treated as one, and whether its current ATK equals any supplied atk value.
Nil atk arguments are skipped. Non-monsters that are not treated as monsters return false.

functions.name: Card.IsAttackable
description_zh: 检查c当前是否满足核心的基础可攻击条件。
该卡必须是表侧攻击表示，或带EFFECT_DEFENSE_ATTACK的表侧守备表示，并且不能处于禁止状态、不能攻击、攻击被无效，或回合玩家被跳过战斗阶段。该函数不检查攻击宣言费用。
description_en: Checks whether c currently satisfies the core's basic attack-capable conditions.

The card must be face-up Attack Position, or face-up Defense Position with EFFECT_DEFENSE_ATTACK, and it must not be forbidden, unable to attack, attack-disabled, or under a skipped Battle Phase. This does not check attack-announcement costs.

functions.name: Card.IsAttackAbove

params.name: c
params.description: Card whose current ATK is checked.

params.name: atk
params.description: Minimum ATK value accepted by the check.

returns.description: True if c is a monster or treated as one and its current ATK is at least atk.

description_zh: 检查c是否为怪兽或当前被当作怪兽，并且当前攻击力是否大于等于atk。
不同于Card.IsAttackBelow，此核心在比较前不会额外检查攻击力未知的情况。
description_en: Checks whether c is a monster or currently treated as one, and whether its current ATK is at least atk.
Unlike Card.IsAttackBelow, this core does not add a separate guard for unknown ATK before comparing.

functions.name: Card.IsAttackBelow

params.name: c
params.description: Card whose current ATK is checked.

params.name: atk
params.description: Maximum ATK value accepted by the check.

returns.description: True if c is a monster or treated as one, has known ATK, and that ATK is at most atk.

description_zh: 检查c是否为怪兽或被当作怪兽，并且当前攻击力已确定且小于等于atk。
攻击力未知的卡返回false，因为核心要求当前攻击力至少为0。
description_en: Checks whether c is a monster, or treated as one, whose current ATK is known and less than or equal to atk.
Cards with unknown ATK return false because the core requires the current ATK to be at least 0.

functions.name: Card.IsAttackPos
description_zh: 检查c当前表示形式是否包含POS_ATTACK。
description_en: Checks whether c's current position contains POS_ATTACK.

functions.name: Card.IsAttribute
description_zh: 检查c是否属于属性attribute
description_en: Checks whether c currently has at least one Attribute flag from attribute.

functions.name: Card.IsCanAddCounter

params.name: singly
params.description: default: false

params.name: loc
params.description: default: 0

description_zh: 检查当前原因玩家能否在c上放置count个countertype类型的指示物。
loc为0时，c必须当前表侧表示存在于场上。loc不为0时，改为用loc检查指示物许可效果的范围。singly为true时，指示物上限按当前数量+1检查，而不是按当前数量+count检查。
description_en: Checks whether the current reason player can place count counters of countertype on c.

When loc is 0, c must currently be face-up on the field. When loc is nonzero, the counter permit range is checked against loc instead. If singly is true, counter limits are tested as current count + 1 rather than current count + count.

functions.name: Card.IsCanBeBattleTarget
description_zh: 检查c1能否被c2选择为攻击对象。
description_en: Checks whether c1 can be chosen as a battle target by c2.

functions.name: Card.IsCanBeDisabledByEffect
description_zh: 检查c的效果是否能被e无效。
已经被无效的卡，或原本就没有效果的卡，或不受e影响的卡不能被无效。
第三个参数可选，指示其是否为怪兽效果。
description_en: Checks whether c's effects can be negated by e.
Cards that are already negated, have no original effects, or are unaffected by e cannot be negated.
The optional third parameter indicates whether this is a monster effect.

functions.name: Card.IsCanBeEffectTarget
description_zh: 判断c能否成为e的效果对象；省略e时使用当前原因效果。
description_en: Checks whether c can be targeted by e, or by the current reason effect when e is omitted.

functions.name: Card.IsCanBeFusionMaterial

params.name: summon_type
params.description: default: SUMMON_TYPE_FUSION

description_zh: 检查c能否作为fc和summon_type的融合素材使用。
fc可省略，summon_type默认SUMMON_TYPE_FUSION。该绑定没有ignore_mon参数，而是交给核心的融合素材合法性检查处理。
description_en: Checks whether c can be used as Fusion Material for fc and summon_type.
fc is optional and summon_type defaults to SUMMON_TYPE_FUSION. The binding has no ignore_mon argument; it delegates to the core Fusion Material legality checks.

functions.name: Card.IsCanBeLinkMaterial
description_zh: 检查c能否作为连接素材；可选地指定连接怪兽scard。
description_en: Checks whether c can be used as Link Material, optionally for Link Monster scard.

functions.name: Card.IsCanBePlacedOnField

params.name: toplayer
params.description: Target player. Defaults to the current reason player.

params.name: tolocation
params.description: Target location. Defaults to LOCATION_SZONE.

returns.description: true if c can be placed on that player's field.

description_zh: Checks whether c can be placed onto the target player's field.
Returns false if the target player is invalid, c is forbidden, or placing c there would violate uniqueness checks.
description_en: Checks whether c can be placed onto the target player's field.
Returns false if the target player is invalid, c is forbidden, or placing c there would violate uniqueness checks.

functions.name: Card.IsCanBeRitualMaterial
description_zh: 检查c能否作为sc的仪式素材。
仪式脚本通常在选定仪式怪兽后，用Card.IsCanBeRitualMaterial过滤Duel.GetRitualMaterial取得的组，以遵守该怪兽自身的素材限制。
只有在尚未确定具体仪式怪兽、只检查通用素材池时，才对sc传入nil。
description_en: Checks whether c can be used as Ritual Material for sc.
Ritual scripts usually call this after choosing the Ritual Monster, filtering Duel.GetRitualMaterial's result with Card.IsCanBeRitualMaterial so monster-specific material restrictions are respected.
Pass nil for sc only when checking the generic material pool before a specific Ritual Monster is known.

functions.name: Card.IsCanBeSpecialSummoned

params.name: c
params.description: Card being checked.

params.name: e
params.description: Effect that would perform the Special Summon.

params.name: sumtype
params.description: Summon type value recorded for the Special Summon.

params.name: sumplayer
params.description: Player treated as performing the Special Summon.

params.name: nocheck
params.description: If true, skips c's Summoning-condition check.

params.name: nolimit
params.description: If true, skips c's revive-limit or proper-Summon limit check.

params.name: sumpos
params.description: Summon position mask checked by the core; default: POS_FACEUP.

params.name: toplayer
params.description: Player whose field c would be Summoned to; default: sumplayer.

params.name: zone
params.description: Allowed Monster Zone bitmask; default: 0xff.

returns.description: True if c can be Special Summoned with the supplied parameters.

description_zh: 检查c能否通过效果e，以给定的召唤类型、召唤玩家、表示形式、目标玩家和可选区域进行特殊召唤。
nocheck为true时跳过召唤条件检查；nolimit为true时跳过苏生限制或正规召唤限制检查。
description_en: Checks whether c can be Special Summoned by effect e using sumtype, sumplayer, sumpos, target player, and optional zone.
If nocheck is true, c's Summoning condition is skipped. If nolimit is true, c's revive limit or proper-Summon limit is skipped.

functions.name: Card.IsCanBeSynchroMaterial
description_zh: 检查c能否作为scard的同调素材；核心需要配对调整时可提供tuner。
description_en: Checks whether c can be used as Synchro Material for scard, with tuner supplied when the core needs the paired Tuner.

functions.name: Card.IsCanBeXyzMaterial
description_zh: 检查c能否作为超量素材使用，可选指定要召唤的sc。
核心会拒绝衍生物、超量素材用种类不是怪兽的卡、带STATUS_FORBIDDEN的卡，以及适用的EFFECT_CANNOT_BE_XYZ_MATERIAL效果。
description_en: Checks whether c can be used as Xyz Material, optionally for sc.
The core rejects Tokens, cards whose Xyz-material type is not a monster, cards with STATUS_FORBIDDEN, and applicable EFFECT_CANNOT_BE_XYZ_MATERIAL effects.

functions.name: Card.IsCanChangePosition
description_zh: 检查核心中供效果改变表示形式使用的能力判断。
在此MDPro3/YGOPro核心中，该底层辅助函数对连接怪兽返回false，对其他卡返回true；它不会执行更完整的手动改变战斗表示形式检查。
description_en: Checks the core's effect-specific position-change capability for c.
In this MDPro3/YGOPro core, that helper returns false for Link Monsters and true for other cards; it does not perform the broader manual battle-position-change checks.

functions.name: Card.IsCanHaveCounter
description_zh: 检查c能否持有countertype类型的指示物。
description_en: Checks whether c can hold counters of countertype.

functions.name: Card.IsCanOverlay

params.name: player
params.description: default: current reason player

description_zh: 检查c能否由player作为超量素材使用。
player省略时使用当前原因玩家。核心会排除衍生物、处于非法状态的禁止使用卡，以及由对方控制且不能变更控制权的卡。
description_en: Checks whether c can be used as Xyz Material by player.
player defaults to the current reason player. The core rejects Tokens, forbidden cards in invalid states, and cards controlled by the other player that cannot change control.

functions.name: Card.IsCanRemoveCounter

returns.description: nil if player is invalid.

description_zh: 检查player能否因reason从c上取除count个countertype类型的指示物。
description_en: Checks whether player can remove count counters of countertype from c for reason.

functions.name: Card.IsCanTurnSet

params.name: c
params.description: Card checked for whether it can be turned face-down.

returns.description: True if c can be turned face-down by the current reason player.

description_zh: 检查c能否被当前原因玩家变成里侧表示。
连接怪兽、衍生物、已经里侧表示的卡，以及受到EFFECT_CANNOT_TURN_SET影响的卡或玩家会返回false。
description_en: Checks whether c can be turned face-down by the current reason player.
The core returns false for Link Monsters, Tokens, already face-down cards, and cards or players affected by EFFECT_CANNOT_TURN_SET.

functions.name: Card.IsChainAttackable

params.name: ac
params.description: default: 2

params.name: monsteronly
params.description: default: false

description_zh: 检查当前攻击怪兽能否按连续攻击规则再次攻击。
这个核心绑定会校验c，但实际检查决斗中的当前攻击怪兽。ac默认2，monsteronly要求必须有攻击对象，不能直接攻击。
description_en: Checks whether the current attacker can make another attack under chain-attack rules.
This core binding validates c but tests the duel's current attacker. ac defaults to 2, and monsteronly requires an attack target instead of allowing a direct attack.

functions.name: Card.IsCode
description_zh: 检查c的卡号是否匹配任意给定的卡号。
description_en: Checks whether c's current card code, or alternate code if it has one, matches any supplied code.

functions.name: Card.IsControler
description_zh: 检查c的当前控制着是否是controler
description_en: Checks whether c's current controller is controler.

functions.name: Card.IsControlerCanBeChanged

params.name: ignore_mzone
params.description: default: false

params.name: zone
params.description: default: 0xff

description_zh: 检查c的控制权当前能否转移给另一名玩家。
c必须在怪兽区域，且不受EFFECT_CANNOT_CHANGE_CONTROL影响。ignore_mzone不为true时，对方还必须在zone指定范围内有可用的怪兽区域。
description_en: Checks whether control of c can currently move to the other player.
The card must be in the Monster Zone and must not be affected by EFFECT_CANNOT_CHANGE_CONTROL. Unless ignore_mzone is true, the opponent must also have an available Monster Zone in zone.

functions.name: Card.IsDefense
description_zh: 检查c不是连接怪兽、是怪兽或当前被当作怪兽，并且当前守备力是否等于任意给定def值。
nil的def参数会被跳过。不同于旧导入文本，该绑定不会明确要求c位于怪兽区域。
description_en: Checks whether c is not a Link Monster, is a monster or currently treated as one, and has current DEF equal to any supplied def value.
Nil def arguments are skipped. Unlike the old imported text, the binding does not explicitly require c to be in the Monster Zone.

functions.name: Card.IsDefenseAbove
description_zh: 检查c当前守备力是否大于等于def。
连接怪兽，以及不是怪兽且当前未被当作怪兽的卡，返回false。
description_en: Checks whether c has current DEF greater than or equal to def.
Link Monsters and cards that are not monsters or currently treated as monsters return false.

functions.name: Card.IsDefenseBelow
description_zh: 检查c已知的当前守备力是否小于等于def。
连接怪兽和非怪兽返回false；未知或负数守备力也返回false。
description_en: Checks whether c has known current DEF less than or equal to def.
Link Monsters and non-monsters return false, and unknown or negative DEF also returns false.

functions.name: Card.IsDefensePos
description_zh: 检查c当前表示形式是否包含POS_DEFENSE。
description_en: Checks whether c's current position contains POS_DEFENSE.

functions.name: Card.IsDestructable
description_zh: 检查c能否被破坏。
不传e时，核心只排除超量素材以及已经在墓地或除外的卡。传入e时，会检查c是否受e影响，以及按当前原因玩家判断的效果破坏耐性。
description_en: Checks whether c can be destroyed.

Without e, the core only rejects Xyz Materials and cards already in the GY or banished. With e, it checks whether c is affected by e and whether effect-destruction protection applies for the current reason player.

functions.name: Card.IsDirectAttacked
description_zh: 检查c是否保存有直接攻击记录。
description_en: Checks whether c has a direct-attack record.

functions.name: Card.IsDisabled
description_zh: 检查c当前是否带STATUS_DISABLED。
description_en: Checks whether c currently has STATUS_DISABLED.

functions.name: Card.IsDiscardable

params.name: reason
params.description: default: REASON_COST

description_zh: 检查c是否可以以reason原因丢弃
注：此函数仅用于检测，
以REASON_DISCARD作为原因把一张手卡送墓并不会导致那张卡不能丢弃
description_en: Checks whether c can be discarded for reason.
This is only a check: sending a card from the hand to the Graveyard with REASON_DISCARD does not by itself make that card unable to be discarded.

functions.name: Card.IsDualState
description_zh: 检查c当前是否受EFFECT_DUAL_STATUS影响。
description_en: Checks whether c is currently affected by EFFECT_DUAL_STATUS.

functions.name: Card.IsEffectProperty

params.name: filter
params.description: filter(Effect)

description_zh: 检查c是否为持有满足过滤条件filter效果的卡
description_en: Checks whether c has an effect matching filter.

functions.name: Card.IsExtraDeckMonster
description_zh: 检查c是否属于核心视为额外卡组怪兽的卡种。
description_en: Checks whether c is a card kind treated by the core as an Extra Deck monster.

functions.name: Card.IsExtraLinkState
description_zh: 检查c是否处于额外连接状态。
description_en: Checks whether c is part of an Extra Link state.

functions.name: Card.IsFacedown
description_zh: 检查c是否是里侧表示
description_en: Checks whether c is in face-down position.

functions.name: Card.IsFaceup
description_zh: 检查c是否为表侧表示。
description_en: Checks whether c is in face-up position.

functions.name: Card.IsFaceupEx
description_zh: 检查c是否是表侧表示，在手卡墓地主卡组等处始终返回true
description_en: Checks whether c is face-up; returns true for cards in the hand, Graveyard, Main Deck, and similar hidden/non-field locations.

functions.name: Card.IsForbidden
description_zh: 判断c当前是否具有STATUS_FORBIDDEN状态。
description_en: Checks whether c currently has STATUS_FORBIDDEN.

functions.name: Card.IsFusionAttribute

params.name: player
params.description: default: current reason player

description_zh: 检查c作为融合素材使用时的属性是否包含attribute。
player默认当前原因玩家。核心使用c:GetFusionAttribute(player)，因此会计入融合素材用属性变更效果。
description_en: Checks whether c's Attribute while used as Fusion Material contains attribute.
player defaults to the current reason player. The core uses c:GetFusionAttribute(player), so Fusion Material Attribute-changing effects are included.

functions.name: Card.IsFusionCode
description_zh: 检查c作为融合素材使用时，是否能当作任意给定code。
核心会计入c当前卡号、第二卡号以及EFFECT_ADD_FUSION_CODE数值。没有适用的融合专用追加卡号，或素材卡号检查被禁用时，退回Card.IsCode检查。
description_en: Checks whether c can be treated as any supplied code while used as Fusion Material.
The core includes c's current code, second code, and EFFECT_ADD_FUSION_CODE values. If no Fusion-only code additions apply, or material-code checks are disabled, it falls back to Card.IsCode.

functions.name: Card.IsFusionSetCard
description_zh: 判断c作为融合素材时是否可以视为属于任一传入的系列编号。
nil系列编号参数会被忽略。
description_en: Checks whether c can be treated as belonging to any supplied set code while used as Fusion Material.
nil set-code arguments are ignored.

functions.name: Card.IsFusionSummonableCard
description_zh: 检查c能否作为融合怪兽用召唤类型sum_type进行融合召唤；sum_type默认0。
description_en: Checks whether c can be Fusion Summoned as a Fusion Monster for summon type sum_type, defaulting to 0.

functions.name: Card.IsFusionType
description_zh: 检查c作为融合素材使用时的种类是否包含type。
原本为怪兽的卡位于魔法与陷阱区域，且正在素材检查时，核心使用卡片数据中的种类；其他情况使用c当前种类。
description_en: Checks whether c's type while used as Fusion Material contains type.
For an original Monster Card in the Spell & Trap Zone, the core uses the card-data type while material checks are active; otherwise it uses c's current type.

functions.name: Card.IsHasCardTarget
description_zh: 检查c1当前是否把c2作为持续取对象卡。
description_en: Checks whether c1 currently has c2 as a persistent card target.

functions.name: Card.IsHasDefense
description_zh: 检查c是否持有守备力
description_en: Checks whether c has DEF.

functions.name: Card.IsHasEffect

returns.description: Additional matching effects, if any.

description_zh: 返回当前影响c且效果编号为code的效果；没有匹配效果时返回nil。
提供player时，只返回该玩家仍可使用次数限制的效果。多个匹配效果会作为多个Lua返回值返回。
description_en: Returns the effects currently affecting c with effect code code, or nil if none match.
When player is supplied, only effects whose count limit can still be used by that player are returned. Multiple matching effects are returned as multiple Lua return values.

functions.name: Card.IsHasLevel
description_zh: 检查c是否持有等级
description_en: Checks whether c has a Level.

functions.name: Card.IsImmuneToEffect
description_zh: 检查c是否免疫效果e（即不受效果e的影响）
description_en: Checks whether c is unaffected by effect e.

functions.name: Card.IsLevel
description_zh: 判断c当前等级是否等于任一传入的等级值。
nil等级参数会被忽略。
description_en: Checks whether c's current Level equals any supplied level value.
nil level arguments are ignored.

functions.name: Card.IsLevelAbove
description_zh: 检查c是否是等级level以上
description_en: Checks whether c has a Level greater than 0 and greater than or equal to level.

functions.name: Card.IsLevelBelow
description_zh: 检查c是否是等级level以下（至少为1）
description_en: Checks whether c has a Level greater than 0 and less than or equal to level.

functions.name: Card.IsLink
description_zh: 检查c:GetLink()是否等于任意给定link值。nil的link参数会被跳过；非连接怪兽按0比较。
description_en: Checks whether c:GetLink() equals any supplied link value. Nil link arguments are skipped; non-Link cards compare as 0.

functions.name: Card.IsLinkAbove
description_zh: 检查c是否具有非0连接值，且连接值大于等于link。
description_en: Checks whether c has a nonzero Link Rating greater than or equal to link.

functions.name: Card.IsLinkAttribute

params.name: player
params.description: default: current reason player

description_zh: 检查c作为连接素材使用时的属性是否包含attribute。
player默认当前原因玩家。核心使用c:GetLinkAttribute(player)，因此会计入连接素材用属性变更效果。
description_en: Checks whether c's Attribute while used as Link Material contains attribute.
player defaults to the current reason player. The core uses c:GetLinkAttribute(player), so Link Material Attribute-changing effects are included.

functions.name: Card.IsLinkBelow
description_zh: 检查c是否具有非0连接值，且连接值小于等于link。
description_en: Checks whether c has a nonzero Link Rating that is less than or equal to link.

functions.name: Card.IsLinkCode
description_zh: 检查c作为连接素材使用时是否匹配任意给定卡号。
会检查c当前卡号、第二卡号以及EFFECT_ADD_LINK_CODE追加的卡号。没有连接卡号追加效果时，该绑定退回使用Card.IsCode。
description_en: Checks whether c matches any supplied code while used as Link Material.
This includes c's current code, second code, and EFFECT_ADD_LINK_CODE values. If no link-code additions apply, the binding falls back to Card.IsCode.

functions.name: Card.IsLinkMarker
description_zh: 检查c是否具有方向dir的连接标记。
description_en: Checks whether c has Link Marker direction dir.

functions.name: Card.IsLinkRace

params.name: player
params.description: default: current reason player

description_zh: 检查c作为player的连接素材使用时的种族是否包含race。player省略时使用当前原因玩家。
description_en: Checks whether c's Race while used as Link Material for player contains race. player defaults to the current reason player.

functions.name: Card.IsLinkSetCard
description_zh: 检查c作为连接素材使用时能否视为任意给定setcode的系列卡。nil的setcode参数会被跳过。
description_en: Checks whether c can be treated as any supplied setcode while used as Link Material. Nil setcode arguments are skipped.

functions.name: Card.IsLinkState
description_zh: 检查c当前是否处于连接状态。
description_en: Checks whether c is currently in linked state.

functions.name: Card.IsLinkSummonable

params.name: minc
params.description: default: 0

params.name: maxc
params.description: default: 0

description_zh: 检查连接怪兽c能否由当前原因玩家进行连接召唤。
可选的materials、lcard、minc、maxc会限制核心检查使用的连接素材池和素材数量。
description_en: Checks whether Link Monster c can be Link Summoned by the current reason player.
Optional materials, lcard, minc, and maxc restrict the Link Material pool and material count used by the core check.

functions.name: Card.IsLinkType
description_zh: 检查c作为连接素材使用时的种类是否包含type。
description_en: Checks whether c's type while used as Link Material contains type.

functions.name: Card.IsLocation
description_zh: 检查c当前是否在location位置。
description_en: Checks whether c is currently in location.
Cards treated as not being on the field return false for field locations, including during a Summon before it successfully reaches the Monster Zone.

functions.name: Card.IsMSetable

params.name: min
params.description: default: 0

params.name: zone
params.description: default: 0x1f

description_zh: 判断c能否由当前原因玩家在怪兽区域通常盖放。
ignore_count会跳过通常召唤/盖放次数检查。e用于检查由该效果进行的盖放，min为要求的最少解放数量，zone限制可用怪兽区域。
description_en: Checks whether c can be Normal Set in a Monster Zone for the current reason player.
ignore_count skips the Normal Summon/Set count check. e checks Set legality for that effect, min is the minimum number of releases required, and zone restricts usable Monster Zones.

functions.name: Card.IsNonAttribute
description_zh: 检查c是否有attribute以外的属性
（如暗黑神鸟同时具有暗和风属性，not IsAttribute(暗)是false，但IsNonAttribute(暗)是true）
description_en: Checks whether c has any Attribute other than attribute.
For example, if a monster is both DARK and WIND, IsAttribute(DARK) is true, but IsNonAttribute(DARK) is also true.

functions.name: Card.IsNotTuner
description_zh: 检查c对同调怪兽scard而言是否被视为非调整。
description_en: Checks whether c is treated as a non-Tuner for Synchro Monster scard.

functions.name: Card.IsOnField
description_zh: 检查c是否在场
注：当怪兽召唤，反转召唤，特殊召唤时召唤成功之前，此函数返回false
description_en: Checks whether c is currently on the field and is not being treated as off the field.

functions.name: Card.IsOriginalCodeRule
description_zh: 检查c按规则使用的原本卡号是否匹配任意给定code。
nil的code参数会被跳过。双卡号卡会检查两个规则原本卡号；其他卡检查核心使用的决斗卡号。
description_en: Checks whether c's rule-original card code matches any supplied code.
Nil code arguments are skipped. For double-code cards, the core checks both rule-original codes; otherwise it checks the card's duel code.

functions.name: Card.IsOriginalEffectProperty

params.name: filter
params.description: filter(Effect)

description_zh: 检查c是否为记载满足过滤条件filter效果的卡
description_en: Checks whether c is originally a card with an effect matching filter.

functions.name: Card.IsOriginalSetCard
description_zh: 检查c的原本系列数据是否匹配任意给定系列代码。
description_en: Checks whether c's original set data matches any supplied set code.

functions.name: Card.IsPosition
description_zh: 判断c当前表示形式是否包含pos。
description_en: Checks whether c's current battle position includes pos.

functions.name: Card.IsPreviousControler
description_zh: 检查c的上一个控制者是否为player
description_en: Checks whether c's previous controller was player.

functions.name: Card.IsPreviousLocation
description_zh: 检查c之前的位置是否是location
description_en: Checks whether c's previous location included location.

functions.name: Card.IsPreviousPosition
description_zh: 判断c之前的表示形式是否包含pos。
description_en: Checks whether c's previous position included pos.

functions.name: Card.IsPreviousSetCard
description_zh: 检查c之前记录的卡号或附加系列数据是否匹配任意给定setcode。
nil的setcode参数会被跳过。该函数使用最近相关场上状态或表示形式更新前记录的状态，不检查c当前的系列。
description_en: Checks whether c's previous card-code or added previous set-code data matches any supplied setcode value.
Nil setcode arguments are skipped. This uses the previous state recorded before the last relevant field or position update, not c's current Set membership.

functions.name: Card.IsPublic
description_zh: 判断c当前是否为双方公开状态；在当前核心中表现为表侧表示。
description_en: Checks whether c is currently public to both players, represented by face-up position in this core.

functions.name: Card.IsRace
description_zh: 检查c是否属于种族race
description_en: Checks whether c currently has at least one Race flag from race.

functions.name: Card.IsRank
description_zh: 检查c:GetRank()是否等于任意给定rank值。
nil的rank参数会被跳过。该绑定直接比较数值阶级，不会额外要求c必须是超量怪兽，因此非超量卡会按阶级0参与比较。
description_en: Checks whether c:GetRank() equals any supplied rank value.
Nil rank arguments are skipped. The binding compares the numeric Rank directly; it does not separately require c to be an Xyz Monster, so non-Xyz cards compare as Rank 0.

functions.name: Card.IsRankAbove
description_zh: 检查c是否具有非0阶级，且阶级大于等于rank。
description_en: Checks whether c has a nonzero Rank greater than or equal to rank.

functions.name: Card.IsRankBelow
description_zh: 检查c是否具有非0阶级，且阶级小于等于rank。
description_en: Checks whether c has a nonzero Rank that is less than or equal to rank.

functions.name: Card.IsReason
description_zh: 检查c是否包含reason之中任何原因
description_en: Checks whether c's current reason flags include reason.

functions.name: Card.IsRelateToBattle
description_zh: 检查c是否和本次战斗关联
注：此效果通常用于伤害计算后伤害阶段结束前，用于检查战斗的卡是否离场过
description_en: Checks whether c is still related to the current battle, usually during the Damage Step or shortly after damage calculation.

functions.name: Card.IsRelateToCard
description_zh: 检查c1当前是否与c2保持关系。
description_en: Checks whether c1 currently has a relation to c2.

functions.name: Card.IsRelateToChain

params.name: chainc
params.description: default: 0

description_zh: 检查c是否和连锁chainc有联系
注：每次发动进入连锁的效果时，发动效果的卡，以及发动效果时指定的对象
（用Duel.SetTargetCard或者Duel.SelectTarget指定的，包括取对象和不取对象）
会自动与那个效果建立联系，一旦离场，联系会重置
description_en: Checks whether c is still related to chainc.

The activating card and cards selected as targets with Duel.SetTargetCard or Duel.SelectTarget automatically become related to that Chain. The relation is lost when the card leaves the expected place.

functions.name: Card.IsRelateToEffect

params.name: c
params.description: Card whose relation is checked.

params.name: e
params.description: Effect relation to test against.

returns.description: True if c still has relation to e.

description_zh: 检查c是否仍与效果e保持联系。
效果进入连锁时，其处理卡以及通过Duel.SetTargetCard或Duel.SelectTarget选中的卡会与该效果建立联系；卡离开预期位置后通常会失去该联系。
description_en: Checks whether c is still related to effect e.

When an effect enters the Chain, its handler and cards selected with Duel.SetTargetCard or Duel.SelectTarget are related to that effect. That relation is normally lost once the card leaves its expected place.

functions.name: Card.IsReleasable

params.name: reason
params.description: default: REASON_COST

description_zh: 检查c能否由当前原因玩家作为非召唤用途被解放。
reason默认REASON_COST。正在召唤中的卡、超量素材、墓地或除外的卡、手牌中的魔法/陷阱卡、玩家不能解放的卡，以及受EFFECT_UNRELEASABLE_NONSUM影响的卡会返回false。
description_en: Checks whether c can be Released for a non-Summon reason by the current reason player.

reason defaults to REASON_COST. The core rejects cards being Summoned, Xyz Materials, cards in the GY or banished, Spell/Trap Cards in the hand, cards the player cannot release, and cards affected by EFFECT_UNRELEASABLE_NONSUM.

functions.name: Card.IsReleasableByEffect
description_zh: 使用当前原因玩家和原因效果，检查c是否能被当前处理中的效果解放。
description_en: Checks whether c can be Released by the current resolving effect, using the current reason player and reason effect.

functions.name: Card.IsSetCard
description_zh: 检查c是否属于任意给定的系列代码。
description_en: Checks whether c belongs to any of the supplied set codes.

functions.name: Card.IsSpecialSummonable
description_zh: 检查c能否由当前原因玩家以sum_type特殊召唤；sum_type默认0。
description_en: Checks whether c can be Special Summoned by player under sum_type, defaulting to 0 and using the current reason player.

functions.name: Card.IsSpecialSummonableCard
description_zh: 检查c是否能以正规方法特殊召唤。
c必须有可特殊召唤的方式。
description_en: Checks whether c can be Special Summoned by a proper procedure.
c must have an available Special Summon procedure.

functions.name: Card.IsSpecialSummonSetCard
description_zh: 检查c是否被卡名含有setname的卡特殊召唤
description_en: Checks whether c was Special Summoned by a card whose name includes setname.

functions.name: Card.IsSSetable

params.name: ignore_field
params.description: default: false

description_zh: 检查c是否可以set到魔法陷阱区，ignore_field=true则无视魔陷区格子是否能使用的限制
description_en: Checks whether c can be Set in a Spell & Trap Zone. If ignore_field is true, available zone checks are ignored.

functions.name: Card.IsStatus

params.name: c
params.description: Card whose current status flags are checked.
params.description_zh: 要检查当前状态标志的卡。

params.name: status
params.description: Status flag or combined status mask, such as STATUS_BATTLE_DESTROYED.
params.description_zh: 状态标志或组合状态掩码，例如STATUS_BATTLE_DESTROYED。

returns.description: true if c has any flag included in status.
returns.description_zh: 若c具有status中的任意标志则为true。

description_zh: 判断c当前状态是否包含status中的至少一个标志。
常见合法性检查会用它判断STATUS_BATTLE_DESTROYED等临时核心状态，再决定伤害步骤的Quick效果能否发动。
description_en: Checks whether c currently has at least one status flag from status.
Common legality checks use this for temporary engine states such as STATUS_BATTLE_DESTROYED before allowing a Damage Step Quick Effect.

functions.name: Card.IsSummonable

params.name: min
params.description: default: 0

params.name: zone
params.description: default: 0x1f

description_zh: 检查c是否可以进行通常召唤（不包含通常召唤的set)，ignore_count=true则不检查召唤次数限制
e~=nil则检查c是否可以以效果e进行通常召唤，min表示至少需要的祭品数（用于区分妥协召唤与上级召唤）,zone 表示必须要召唤到的区域
description_en: Checks whether c can be Normal Summoned, excluding Normal Summon/Set.
If e is not nil, checks whether c can be Normal Summoned by that effect. min is the minimum number of Tributes, and zone restricts the zone it must be Summoned to.

functions.name: Card.IsSummonableCard
description_zh: 检查c的卡片数据是否属于按卡种可以通常召唤或盖放的怪兽。
非怪兽、额外卡组怪兽、仪式怪兽、特殊召唤怪兽和衍生物会返回false。该函数不检查当前费用、召唤次数、位置或玩家限制。
description_en: Checks whether c's card data represents a monster that is allowed to be Normal Summoned or Set by card kind.
This rejects non-monsters, Extra Deck monsters, Ritual Monsters, Special Summon-only monsters, and Tokens. It does not check current costs, Summon count, locations, or player restrictions.

functions.name: Card.IsSummonLocation

params.name: c
params.description: Card whose recorded Summon location is checked.

params.name: loc
params.description: Location mask to test against the stored Summon location, such as LOCATION_EXTRA or LOCATION_GRAVE.

returns.description: True if any bit in loc is present in c's recorded Summon location.

description_zh: 检查c记录的召唤位置是否包含loc。该函数读取召唤信息，不检查c的当前位置。
description_en: Checks whether c's recorded Summon location contains loc. This reads the Summon information, not c's current location.

functions.name: Card.IsSummonPlayer
description_zh: 判断player是否为召唤c的玩家。
description_en: Checks whether player was the player who Summoned c.

functions.name: Card.IsSummonType
description_zh: 判断c记录的召唤类型是否包含sumtype中的全部标志。
description_en: Checks whether c's recorded Summon type includes every flag in sumtype.

functions.name: Card.IsSynchroSummonable

params.name: min
params.description: default: 0

params.name: max
params.description: default: 0

description_zh: 判断c能否使用tuner以及可用素材组mg进行同调召唤。
tuner为nil时，相当于检查c通常的特殊召唤手续。
min和max限制该手续使用的非调整同调素材数量。
description_en: Checks whether c can be Synchro Summoned with tuner and the available material group mg.
If tuner is nil, this behaves like the regular Special Summon procedure check for c.
min and max restrict the number of non-Tuner Synchro Materials used by the procedure.

functions.name: Card.IsSynchroType
description_zh: 检查c作为同调素材使用时的类型是否包含type。
description_en: Checks whether c's type while used as Synchro Material contains type.

functions.name: Card.IsTuner
description_zh: 检查c是否为scard的调整怪兽。
除了检查TYPE_TUNER以外，还会检查其身上所有能让其变为调整怪兽的效果。
description_en: Checks whether c is a Tuner monster for scard.
Besides TYPE_TUNER, this also checks effects that can make c be treated as a Tuner.

functions.name: Card.IsType
description_zh: 检查c是否包含type中的任意类型。
description_en: Checks whether c has at least one of the type flags in type.

functions.name: Card.IsXyzLevel
description_zh: 检查c能否为超量怪兽xyzc提供超量用等级lv。
description_en: Checks whether c can provide Xyz Level lv for Xyz Monster xyzc.

functions.name: Card.IsXyzSummonable
description_zh: 检查超量怪兽c能否由当前原因玩家用可选素材组和min/max限制进行超量召唤。
description_en: Checks whether Xyz Monster c can be Xyz Summoned by the current reason player with an optional material group and min/max constraints.

functions.name: Card.IsXyzType
description_zh: 检查c作为超量素材使用时的类型是否包含type。
description_en: Checks whether c's type while used as Xyz Material contains type.

functions.name: Card.RegisterEffect
description_zh: 把效果e注册给c，成功时返回效果的场上编号，并设置e的Handler为c。
description_en: Registers effect e to card c and returns the generated effect field ID.
Registration also makes c the effect handler. If the card is unaffected by the current reason effect, registration can fail unless forced is true.

functions.name: Card.RegisterFlagEffect

params.name: c
params.description: Card that receives the marker.

params.name: code
params.description: Flag-effect code; the core masks it with MAX_CARD_ID and adds EFFECT_FLAG_EFFECT.

params.name: reset_flag
params.description: RESET_* mask controlling when the marker expires.

params.name: property
params.description: Effect property flags stored on the created marker; EFFECT_FLAG_CANNOT_DISABLE is always added.

params.name: reset_count
params.description: Reset counter for the created marker; 0 is treated as 1.

params.name: label
params.description: Optional integer payload stored on the marker.

params.name: desc
params.description: Optional client description id for marker hints.

returns.description: The created flag effect.

description_zh: 在c上登记单卡标记效果，并返回创建的Effect。
标记效果是脚本用的标记：其code与普通效果code分开保存，不能被无效，且count=0会按1处理。
description_en: Registers a special single-card flag effect on c and returns the created Effect.
Flag effects are script markers: their code is kept separate from regular effect codes, they cannot be disabled, and count=0 is treated as 1.

functions.name: Card.ReleaseEffectRelation
description_zh: 解除c与效果e之间的关系。
description_en: Releases c's relation to effect e.

functions.name: Card.ReleaseRelation
description_zh: 解除c1与卡c2之间的关系。
description_en: Releases c1's relation to card c2.

functions.name: Card.RemoveCounter
description_zh: 由player因reason从c上取除count个countertype类型的指示物。
countertype为0时，核心会清除c上的全部指示物且不返回Lua值。否则会让处理器取除指定指示物，并返回是否成功。
description_en: Removes count counters of countertype from c for reason, using player as the removing player.
When countertype is 0, the core clears every counter on c and returns no Lua value. Otherwise it yields and returns whether the requested counters were removed.

functions.name: Card.RemoveOverlayCard

returns.description: Number of Xyz Materials actually removed.

description_zh: 让player为了reason从c上取除min到max个超量素材，并返回实际取除数量。
核心会在选择素材前提供可适用的EFFECT_OVERLAY_REMOVE_REPLACE替代效果。
description_en: Lets player remove between min and max Xyz Materials from c for reason and returns the number actually removed.
The core also offers applicable EFFECT_OVERLAY_REMOVE_REPLACE effects before selecting materials.

functions.name: Card.ReplaceEffect

params.name: count
params.description: default: 1

description_zh: 用卡号code的效果替换c的效果，使用给定reset标志，并返回替换效果id。
count默认1；RESET_PHASE未指定自己/对方回合时会自动补上双方回合。
description_en: Replaces c's effects with the effects of card code under the given reset flags and returns the replacement id.
count defaults to 1; phase resets automatically include both players' turns when no turn side is specified.

functions.name: Card.ResetEffect
description_zh: 手动重置c上匹配code和reset_type的效果。
description_en: Manually resets effects on c that match code and reset_type.

functions.name: Card.ResetFlagEffect

params.name: c
params.description: Card whose matching flag effects are reset.

params.name: code
params.description: Flag-effect code to clear.

description_zh: 重置c上code对应的全部标志效果。
description_en: Resets all flag effects on c with code.

functions.name: Card.ResetNegateEffect
description_zh: 按每个给定的重置代码重置c上相关的无效效果。
description_en: Resets negate-related card effects on c for each supplied reset code.

functions.name: Card.ReverseInDeck
description_zh: 把位于Deck中的c标记为表侧。
如果c是当前主Deck最上方的卡，核心还会向客户端发送Deck顶更新。
description_en: Marks c face-up while it is in the Deck.
If c is the current top card of the Main Deck, the core also sends the top-of-Deck update to the client.

functions.name: Card.SetCardTarget
description_zh: 把c2登记为c1的持续卡片对象。
该函数保存的是供Card.GetCardTarget等函数以及相关卡无效检查使用的卡片对象关系，不是Duel.SelectTarget登记的连锁对象列表。
description_en: Registers c2 as a persistent card target of c1.
This stores a card-target relation used by functions such as Card.GetCardTarget and by related-card disable checks; it is separate from Duel.SelectTarget's Chain target list.

functions.name: Card.SetCounterLimit
description_zh: 为c添加countertype对应的EFFECT_COUNTER_LIMIT，数值为limit。
description_en: Adds an EFFECT_COUNTER_LIMIT for countertype to c with value limit.

functions.name: Card.SetFlagEffectLabel

params.name: c
params.description: Card whose matching flag effect is updated.

params.name: code
params.description: Flag-effect code to find.

params.name: label
params.description: New integer label stored on the first matching flag effect.

returns.description: True if a matching flag effect was updated; false if none exists.

description_zh: 把c上code对应的第一个标志效果Label设置为label，并返回是否找到标志效果。
description_en: Sets the first matching flag effect label for code on c to label and returns whether a flag effect was found.

functions.name: Card.SetHint
description_zh: 向客户端发送c的卡片提示消息，内容为提示type和值value；type大于等于CHINT_DESC_ADD时会被忽略。
description_en: Sends a client card-hint message for c with hint type and value; types at or above CHINT_DESC_ADD are ignored.

functions.name: Card.SetMaterial
description_zh: 把g设置为c本次召唤使用的素材组；g为nil时清除素材记录。
description_en: Sets g as c's material group for a Summon, or clears c's materials when g is nil.

functions.name: Card.SetReason
description_zh: 把c当前的原因位掩码设为reason。
description_en: Sets c's current reason bitmask to reason.

functions.name: Card.SetSPSummonOnce
description_zh: 将c标记为按spsummon_code共享每回合1次的特殊召唤限制。
具有相同非零spsummon_code的卡对每名玩家共享该限制。c正在复制其他卡效果时，该绑定不做处理。
description_en: Marks c as sharing a once-per-turn Special Summon limit under spsummon_code.
Cards with the same nonzero spsummon_code share the limit for each player. The binding does nothing while c is copying another card's effect.

functions.name: Card.SetStatus
description_zh: 设置或清除c上的status状态位。
这是内部状态辅助函数。c正在复制其他卡效果时，该绑定不做处理。
description_en: Sets or clears status on c.
This is an internal-status helper. The binding does nothing while c is copying another card's effect.

functions.name: Card.SetTurnCounter
description_zh: 设置c的回合计数器。
description_en: Sets c's turn counter.

functions.name: Card.SetUniqueOnField

params.name: unique_location
params.description: default: LOCATIOIN_ONFIELD

description_zh: 设置c以unique_code只能在场上[或怪兽区域或魔陷区域，由unique_location决定]只能存在1张,function 的返回值类型必须是int
s不为0会检查自己场上的唯一性，o不为0则检查对方场上的唯一性
description_en: Sets a uniqueness rule for c so only one card with unique_code can exist on the checked field, Monster Zone, or Spell & Trap Zone range.

functions.name: Debug.AddCard
description_zh: 创建卡号code的卡并放到指定测试场地位置；如果目标怪兽区域已被超量怪兽占用，则作为超量素材叠放；proc会标记正规手续完成。
description_en: Creates a card with code and places it in the requested test field location, or attaches it as Xyz Material if an occupied Monster Zone contains an Xyz Monster; proc marks its procedure complete.

functions.name: Debug.Message
description_zh: 把tostring(msg)发送到本地调试消息处理。
description_en: Sends tostring(msg) to the local debug message handler.

functions.name: Debug.PreAddCounter

params.name: count
params.description: default: 0

description_zh: 在场地设置阶段直接给c添加count个countertype指示物；count默认1。
description_en: Adds count counters of countertype directly to c for field setup; count defaults to 1.

functions.name: Debug.PreEquip
description_zh: 在场地设置阶段预先把equip_card装备给target，并返回是否建立成功。
description_en: Pre-equips equip_card to target during field setup and returns whether the relationship was created.

functions.name: Debug.PreSetTarget
description_zh: 在场地设置阶段把target加入c的持续卡片对象。
description_en: Adds target as a persistent card target of c during field setup.

functions.name: Debug.PreSummon

params.name: sum_location
params.description: default: 0

description_zh: 把c保存的召唤信息设为summon_type，并可把summon_location写入高16位。
description_en: Sets c's stored summon information to summon_type plus optional summon_location in the high word.

functions.name: Debug.ReloadFieldBegin
description_zh: 清空决斗并用决斗选项flag和可选rule开始重新载入场地；省略rule时，旧规则标志会使用规则1，否则使用当前规则。
description_en: Clears the duel and starts a field reload with duel option flag and optional rule; when rule is omitted, obsolete ruling flags choose rule 1, otherwise the current rule is used.

functions.name: Debug.ReloadFieldEnd
description_zh: 结束重新载入场地：关闭待处理洗切检查并重建场地信息。
description_en: Finishes a field reload by disabling pending shuffle checks and rebuilding field information.

functions.name: Debug.SetAIName
description_zh: 写入本地AI名称消息，长度会按核心AI名称缓冲区截断。
description_en: Writes the local AI name message, truncated to the core AI-name buffer size.

functions.name: Debug.SetPlayerInfo
description_zh: 设置玩家信息，基本分为lp，初始手卡为startcount张，每回合抽drawcount张
在残局当中， playerid ：自己=0,对方=1
description_en: Sets a player's LP, starting hand count, and cards drawn each Draw Phase.

functions.name: Debug.ShowHint
description_zh: 把tostring(msg)写成本地显示提示消息，长度会按核心提示缓冲区截断。
description_en: Writes tostring(msg) as a local show-hint message, truncated to the core hint buffer size.

functions.name: Duel.Activate
description_zh: 把效果e加入核心发动处理队列。
description_en: Queues e to be activated by the core activation processor.

functions.name: Duel.AddCustomActivityCounter

params.name: counter_id
params.description: Script-chosen identifier used later with Duel.GetCustomActivityCount.

params.name: activity_type
