params.description: ACTIVITY_* constant selecting which activity map receives the counter.

params.name: f
params.description: Filter callback. Returning false marks that activity as counted for the acting player.

description_zh: 为指定ACTIVITY_*类型登记编号为counter_id的自定义行动计数器。
召唤和攻击类计数器会以Card调用f，f返回false时计数增加。ACTIVITY_CHAIN会以effect, player, chain_id调用f，同样在返回false时计数。在此核心中，ACTIVITY_BATTLE_PHASE和未知行动类型不会登记自定义计数器。
description_en: Registers a custom activity counter with id counter_id for the selected ACTIVITY_* type.

For Summon and attack counters, f is called with a Card and the counter increases when f returns false. For ACTIVITY_CHAIN, f is called with effect, player, chain_id and also counts false results. ACTIVITY_BATTLE_PHASE and unknown activity types do not register a custom counter in this core.

functions.name: Duel.AdjustAll
description_zh: 立刻刷新场地信息
description_en: Immediately refreshes field information.

functions.name: Duel.AdjustInstantly
description_zh: 立即进行场上调整。
提供c时，核心会先刷新与c相关卡的无效关联，再调整场上状态。
description_en: Runs immediate field adjustment.
When c is supplied, the core refreshes disable relations for cards related to c before adjusting the field.

functions.name: Duel.AnnounceAttribute

returns.description: Selected Attribute bitmask.

description_zh: 让player从available属性位掩码中宣言count个属性，并返回所选属性位掩码。
available应为ATTRIBUTE_*常量的按位组合。
description_en: Lets player declare count Attributes from the available Attribute bitmask and returns the selected Attribute bitmask.
available should be a bitwise combination of ATTRIBUTE_* constants.

functions.name: Duel.AnnounceCard
description_zh: 让player宣言一个匹配可选opcode/filter表达式的卡号，并返回所选卡号。
description_en: Lets player declare a card code matching the optional opcode/filter expression and returns the selected code.

functions.name: Duel.AnnounceCoin

returns.description: Zero-based option index.

description_zh: 让player从内置硬币面选项中选择一个，并返回从0开始的选项索引。
description_en: Lets player choose one of the built-in coin-side options and returns the zero-based option index.

functions.name: Duel.AnnounceLevel

params.name: min
params.description: default: 1

params.name: max
params.description: default: 12

returns.description: Declared Level.
Zero-based option index.

description_zh: 让player宣言等级，并返回宣言的等级以及从0开始的选项索引。
min和max默认1与12；min大于max时会交换。额外的等级参数会从选项中排除；没有剩余等级时，该绑定不返回值。
description_en: Lets player declare a Level and returns the declared Level plus the zero-based option index.
min and max default to 1 and 12 and are swapped if min is greater than max. Extra level arguments are excluded from the options; if no Levels remain, the binding returns no value.

functions.name: Duel.AnnounceNumber

returns.description: Selected number.
0-based option index selected by the core.

description_zh: 让player从给定数字中选择1个。
返回被选择的数字，以及该数字在核心选项列表中的0基序号。
description_en: Lets player choose one of the supplied numbers.
Returns the selected number and the core's 0-based option index for that number.

functions.name: Duel.AnnounceRace
description_zh: 让player从available中宣言count个种族，并返回所选RACE_*位掩码。
description_en: Lets player declare count Races from available and returns the selected RACE_* bitmask.

functions.name: Duel.AnnounceType
description_zh: 让player从核心内置的怪兽/魔法/陷阱类型选项中选择，并返回从0开始的选项索引。
返回值是所选选项索引，不是TYPE_*位掩码。
description_en: Lets player choose one of the engine's built-in Monster/Spell/Trap type options and returns the zero-based option index.
The return value is the selected option index, not a TYPE_* bitmask.

functions.name: Duel.BreakEffect
description_zh: 中断当前效果，使之后的效果处理视为不同时处理，此函数会造成错时点
description_en: Separates the current resolving effect into a later timing window, then raises EVENT_BREAK_EFFECT.
Use this when card text says to do one action, then do another action afterward, so later triggers do not see both actions as simultaneous.

functions.name: Duel.CalculateDamage

params.name: new_attack
params.description: default: false

description_zh: 开始attacker与attack_target之间的伤害计算；attack_target为nil时表示直接攻击。
new_attack为可选参数，会传给伤害步骤处理器。attacker和attack_target是同一张卡时，该绑定不开始伤害计算且不返回值。
description_en: Starts damage calculation between attacker and attack_target, or a direct attack when attack_target is nil.
new_attack is optional and is passed to the damage-step processor. If attacker and attack_target are the same card, the binding returns no value and does not start damage calculation.

functions.name: Duel.ChainAttack
description_zh: 标记当前攻击怪兽，使其可以再次攻击；可选将攻击对象限制为卡c。
该绑定只设置连续攻击状态，不返回Lua值。没有当前攻击怪兽，或攻击怪兽不受当前处理效果影响时，不做处理。
description_en: Marks the current attacker so it can make another attack, optionally against card c.
The binding only sets chain-attack state. It returns no Lua value and does nothing if there is no current attacker or the attacker is not affected by the resolving effect.

functions.name: Duel.ChangeAttacker

params.name: ignore_count
params.description: default: false

description_zh: 把当前攻击怪兽改为attacker。
除非ignore_count为true，否则新的攻击怪兽会增加攻击宣言次数；在伤害阶段中还会记录已攻击次数和已攻击卡。
description_en: Changes the current attacking monster to attacker.
Unless ignore_count is true, the new attacker gains an attack announcement count, and during the Damage Phase also gains attacked-count and attacked-card records.

functions.name: Duel.ChangeAttackTarget
description_zh: 把当前攻击对象改为target；target为nil时改为直接攻击。返回是否成功变更。
当前攻击怪兽必须存在、可以攻击，且攻击未被取消。卡片对象必须是当前合法攻击对象之一；直接攻击要求攻击怪兽未被禁止直接攻击。
description_en: Changes the current attack target to target, or to a direct attack when target is nil, and returns whether the change succeeded.

The current attacker must exist, be able to attack, and not have its attack canceled. A card target must be one of the current legal attack targets; direct attack requires that the attacker is not forbidden from attacking directly.

functions.name: Duel.ChangeBattleDamage

params.name: check
params.description: default: true

description_zh: 把当前战斗中player受到的战斗伤害改为value。
check为true或省略时，原本已经是0的战斗伤害不会被改写。
description_en: Changes player battle damage for the current battle to value.
When check is true or omitted, existing 0 battle damage is left unchanged.

functions.name: Duel.ChangeChainOperation
description_zh: 把chainc连锁环的Operation函数替换为f。
description_en: Replaces the operation function of Chain Link chainc with f.

functions.name: Duel.ChangePosition

params.name: ad
params.description: default: au

params.name: du
params.description: default: au

params.name: dd
params.description: default: au

params.name: noflip
params.description: default: false

description_zh: 变更targets的表示形式，并返回实际变更表示形式的卡的数量。
au、ad、du、dd分别对应当前表侧攻击、里侧攻击、表侧守备、里侧守备的目标表示形式；省略时使用au。MDPro3核心不读取旧文档中的第7个setavailable参数。
description_en: Changes the battle position of targets and returns the number of cards whose position actually changed.

The position arguments map by current position: au for face-up Attack Position, ad for face-down Attack Position, du for face-up Defense Position, and dd for face-down Defense Position. Omitted values use au.

functions.name: Duel.ChangeTargetCard
description_zh: 把chainc连锁环记录的取对象卡组替换为g。
description_en: Replaces the target card group recorded for Chain Link chainc with g.

functions.name: Duel.ChangeTargetParam
description_zh: 把连锁环count记录的对象参数改为param。
description_en: Changes target parameter data for Chain Link count to param.

functions.name: Duel.ChangeTargetPlayer
description_zh: 改变连锁环count记录的对象玩家。
description_en: Changes the target player recorded for Chain Link count.

functions.name: Duel.CheckChainTarget
description_zh: 检查c是否是连锁chainc的效果的正确的对象
description_en: Checks whether c is a valid card related to chainc.

functions.name: Duel.CheckChainUniqueness
description_zh: 检查当前全部连锁环的处理对象卡号是否互不相同。
description_en: Checks whether all current Chain Links have different handler card codes.

functions.name: Duel.CheckEvent

params.name: get_info
params.description: default: false

returns.description: Event cards when get_info succeeds.
Event player.
Event value.
Reason effect.
Reason.
Reason player.

description_zh: 不传get_info时，返回当前事件状态中是否存在event。
get_info为true且找到事件时，返回true以及事件卡组、事件玩家、事件值、原因效果、原因、原因玩家；没有找到时只返回false。
description_en: Without get_info, returns whether event is present in the current event state.
With get_info true, returns true plus event cards, event player, event value, reason effect, reason, and reason player when found; otherwise returns false.

functions.name: Duel.CheckLocation
description_zh: 检查player能否使用location中的sequence位置。
description_en: Checks whether player can use the given sequence in location.

functions.name: Duel.CheckLPCost

params.name: player
params.description: Player checked for payment ability.
params.description_zh: 要检查支付能力的玩家。

params.name: cost
params.description: LP amount to check; values of 0 or less return false.
params.description_zh: 要检查的LP数值；0或更小的值会返回false。

params.name: must_pay
params.description: Passed through to the core LP-cost check; scripts use true when the player must be able to pay that exact amount.
params.description_zh: 传给核心LP Cost检查；脚本在玩家必须能够支付该确切数值时传true。

returns.description: True if the LP cost can be paid; false if it cannot or cost is nonpositive; nil if player is invalid.
returns.description_zh: 可以支付时为true；不能支付或cost不为正数时为false；player无效时为nil。

description_zh: 检查player是否可以支付指定LP Cost，但不会实际支付。
通常在Cost回调的chk==0分支使用。cost小于等于0时核心返回false；可选的must_pay标志会传给LP支付检查。
description_en: Checks whether player can pay the specified LP cost without paying it.
Use this in a Cost callback's chk==0 branch. The core returns false for nonpositive costs, and the optional must_pay flag is passed to the LP-cost check.

functions.name: Duel.CheckMustMaterial

params.name: ecode
params.description: for example, EFFECT_MUST_BE_FMATERIAL

description_zh: 检查卡片组是否满足必须作为素材的条件
description_en: Checks whether the card group satisfies mandatory material requirements.

functions.name: Duel.CheckPhaseActivity
description_zh: 返回当前阶段是否已经记录过行动。
description_en: Returns whether an action has been recorded for the current phase.

functions.name: Duel.CheckReleaseGroup
description_zh: 检查player是否能解放至少count张满足f且不在ex中的卡。
ex之后的额外参数会传给f。此辅助函数使用REASON_COST。
description_en: Checks whether player can release at least count cards matching f, excluding ex.
Extra arguments after ex are passed to f after the Card argument. This helper uses REASON_COST.

functions.name: Duel.CheckReleaseGroupEx
description_zh: 检查player是否能以指定reason解放至少count张满足f且不在ex中的卡，并可选择是否允许从手牌解放。
ex之后的额外参数会传给f。
description_en: Checks whether player can release at least count cards matching f, excluding ex, with an explicit reason and optional hand releases.
Extra arguments after ex are passed to f after the Card argument.

functions.name: Duel.CheckRemoveOverlayCard
description_zh: 检查player能否因reason从指定的己方/对方场上位置取除至少count个超量素材。
s表示从player视角看的己方场上位置，o表示对方场上位置。可适用的替代效果也能满足该检查。
description_en: Checks whether player can remove at least count Xyz Materials from the specified own/opponent field locations for reason.
s marks locations on player's own field and o marks locations on the opponent's field, from player's perspective. Applicable replacement effects can satisfy the check.

functions.name: Duel.CheckSummonedCount
description_zh: 检查当前原因玩家是否还有通常召唤/盖放次数，或c是否提供额外召唤次数效果。
description_en: Checks whether the current reason player has a Normal Summon/Set count available, or whether c provides an extra summon-count effect.

functions.name: Duel.CheckSynchroMaterial
description_zh: 检查scard是否存在合法的同调素材选择，可带调整/非调整筛选、数量限制、指定同调素材和素材Group。
description_en: Checks whether scard has a legal Synchro Material selection with optional tuner/non-tuner filters, count limits, required Synchro Material, and material group.

functions.name: Duel.CheckTiming
description_zh: 检查timing是否存在于任一玩家当前的hint timing掩码中。
description_en: Checks whether timing is present in either player's current hint timing mask.

functions.name: Duel.CheckTribute

params.name: max
params.description: default: min

params.name: toplayer
params.description: default: c's controller

params.name: zone
params.description: default: current extra-summon zone limit or 0x1f

description_zh: 检查是否存在可用于通常召唤或盖放c的合法祭品组合。
max默认等于min，mg可以限制候选素材池，toplayer默认c当前控制者，zone默认当前额外召唤区域限制，若没有限制则为0x1f。
description_en: Checks whether there is a valid Tribute set for Normal Summoning or Setting c.
max defaults to min, mg can restrict the candidate pool, toplayer defaults to c's current controller, and zone defaults to the current extra-summon zone limit when present or 0x1f otherwise.

functions.name: Duel.CheckTunerMaterial
description_zh: 检查tuner能否在给定调整/非调整筛选、数量限制和可选素材Group下与scard一起使用。
description_en: Checks whether tuner can be used with scard under the supplied tuner/non-tuner filters, count limits, and optional material group.

functions.name: Duel.CheckXyzMaterial
description_zh: 检查scard是否存在合法的超量素材选择，使用等级lv、素材数量范围、可选筛选函数和可选素材Group。
description_en: Checks whether scard has a legal Xyz Material selection for Level lv, material count range, optional filter, and optional material group.

functions.name: Duel.ClearOperationInfo
description_zh: 清除连锁ct的操作信息；该连锁环不存在时不做处理。
description_en: Clears operation info for chain ct; it is a no-op if that Chain Link does not exist.

functions.name: Duel.ClearTargetCard
description_zh: 清空当前连锁环记录的取对象卡组；没有记录时不处理。
description_en: Clears the target-card group recorded on the current Chain Link, if one exists.

functions.name: Duel.ConfirmCards

params.name: skip_panel
params.description: default: false

description_zh: 给玩家player确认targets
description_en: Reveals a Card or Group to player and waits for the client confirmation.
If skip_panel is true, the client skips the extra confirmation panel when possible.

functions.name: Duel.ConfirmDecktop
description_zh: 向客户端公开player卡组最上方最多count张卡。
count会被限制为剩余主卡组数量。函数会为公开等待而yield，不返回Lua值。
description_en: Reveals up to count cards from the top of player's Main Deck to the client.
count is clamped to the remaining Deck size. The function yields for the reveal wait and returns no Lua values.

functions.name: Duel.ConfirmExtratop
description_zh: 向客户端公开player额外卡组最上方count张卡，会跳过额外卡组顶端记录的表侧灵摆卡部分。
description_en: Reveals count cards from the top of player's Extra Deck to the client, skipping face-up Pendulum cards tracked at the Extra Deck top.

functions.name: Duel.CreateToken
description_zh: 为player创建卡号为code的衍生物并返回该Card。
返回的衍生物不会自动放到场上；脚本通常会随后把它传给Duel.SpecialSummon或其他处理。
description_en: Creates a Token card with card code code for player and returns it.
The returned Token is not placed on the field automatically; scripts normally pass it to Duel.SpecialSummon or another operation afterwards.

functions.name: Duel.Damage

params.name: is_step
params.description: default: false

description_zh: 以reason原因给与玩家player造成value的伤害，返回实际收到的伤害值
如果受到伤害变成回复等效果的影响时，返回值为0.
is_step为true则是伤害/恢复LP过程的分解，需要调用Duel.RDComplete()触发时点
description_en: Deals value effect damage to player for reason and returns the damage actually applied.
If damage is changed into LP recovery or prevented, the return value reflects the final applied damage. With is_step=true, finish the damage/recovery batch with Duel.RDComplete.

functions.name: Duel.Destroy
description_zh: 以reason原因破坏targets去dest，返回值是实际被破坏的数量
如果reason包含REASON_RULE，则破坏事件将不会检查卡片是否免疫效果，
不会触发代破效果并且无视“不能破坏”
如果设置reason_player，则视为被玩家reason_player移动
description_en: Destroys targets for reason and returns the number of cards actually destroyed.
dest defaults to LOCATION_GRAVE. reason_player defaults to the current Chain's reason player. Use REASON_EFFECT for normal card effects and reserve REASON_RULE for rule/procedure cleanup.

functions.name: Duel.DisableSelfDestroyCheck

params.name: disable
params.description: default: true

description_zh: 设置是否禁用核心的自毁检查；省略disable时表示禁用检查。
description_en: Sets whether the core's self-destruction check is disabled; omitting disable disables the check.

functions.name: Duel.DisableShuffleCheck

params.name: disable
params.description: default: true

description_zh: 使下一个操作不检查是否需要洗切卡组或手卡
注：如果不调用此函数，
除了调用Duel.DiscardDeck和Duel.Draw之外从卡组中取出卡或者把卡加入手卡
或者把卡加入卡组（非最上端或最底端）时，系统会自动在效果处理结束时洗切卡组或手卡
如果不希望如此，比如从卡组顶端除外一张卡等操作，那么需要调用此函数
此函数仅保证紧接着的一次操作不会进行洗卡检测
description_en: Disables the automatic shuffle check for the next Deck or hand operation.
Use this before operations that intentionally preserve Deck order or hand order.

functions.name: Duel.DiscardDeck
description_zh: 以原因reason把玩家player的卡组最上端count张卡送去墓地，返回实际转移的数量
description_en: Sends count cards from the top of player's Deck to the Graveyard for reason, and returns the number actually moved.

functions.name: Duel.DiscardHand
description_zh: 过滤函数让玩家player选择并以reason原因丢弃满足筛选条件f兵不等于ex的min-max张手卡
第7个参数开始为额外参数
description_en: Lets player choose and discard min to max matching cards from their hand for reason, then returns the number discarded.
Cards in ex are excluded. Extra arguments after ex are passed to filter f.

functions.name: Duel.Draw
description_zh: 让玩家player以原因reason抽count张卡，返回实际抽的卡的数量
如果reason含有REASON_RULE则此次抽卡不受“不能抽卡”的效果的影响
description_en: Makes player draw up to count cards for reason and returns the number actually drawn.
When reason includes REASON_RULE, effects that prevent drawing are ignored.

functions.name: Duel.EnableGlobalFlag
description_zh: 启用决斗中的指定core global_flag位，且不返回Lua值。
description_en: Enables the supplied core global_flag bit for the Duel and returns no Lua value.

functions.name: Duel.Equip

params.name: up
params.description: default: true

params.name: is_step
params.description: default: false

description_zh: 把c1作为玩家player的装备卡装备给c2，返回值表示是否成功
up=false则保持装备卡之前的表示形式
is_step=true则是装备过程的分解，需要配合Duel.EquipComplete使用
description_en: Equips c1 to c2 for player and returns true if the equip succeeds.
up defaults to true and makes the Equip Card face-up. When is_step is true, call Duel.EquipComplete after all step equips have been created.

functions.name: Duel.EquipComplete
description_zh: 在调用Duel.Equip时，若is_step参数为true，则需调用此函数触发时点
description_en: Completes a batch of step equips created with Duel.Equip(..., true) by enabling the equipped cards and raising the equip events.

functions.name: Duel.GetActivityCount

returns.description: Count for activity_type1.
Additional counts for each extra activity_type.

description_zh: 按传入的activity_type顺序返回player的行动次数。
内置支持ACTIVITY_SUMMON、ACTIVITY_NORMALSUMMON、ACTIVITY_SPSUMMON、ACTIVITY_FLIPSUMMON、ACTIVITY_ATTACK和ACTIVITY_BATTLE_PHASE。其他值在该绑定中返回0，包括ACTIVITY_CHAIN。
description_en: Returns activity counts for player in the same order as the requested activity_type values.

Supported built-in activity types are ACTIVITY_SUMMON, ACTIVITY_NORMALSUMMON, ACTIVITY_SPSUMMON, ACTIVITY_FLIPSUMMON, ACTIVITY_ATTACK, and ACTIVITY_BATTLE_PHASE. Other values, including ACTIVITY_CHAIN in this binding, return 0.

functions.name: Duel.GetAttacker
description_zh: 返回此次战斗攻击的卡
description_en: Returns the monster that is currently attacking, or nil if there is no current attacker.

functions.name: Duel.GetAttackTarget
description_zh: 返回此次战斗被攻击的卡，如果返回nil表示是直接攻击
description_en: Returns the monster currently being attacked, or nil for a direct attack.

functions.name: Duel.GetBattleDamage
description_zh: 返回当前为player记录的战斗伤害。
description_en: Returns the battle damage currently recorded for player.

functions.name: Duel.GetBattledCount
description_zh: 返回player在当前战斗阶段记录状态中的战斗次数。
description_en: Returns how many battles player has conducted in the current Battle Phase tracking state.

functions.name: Duel.GetBattleMonster

returns.description: Monster controlled by player.
Monster controlled by the opponent.

description_zh: 返回当前战斗中由player控制的怪兽，然后返回当前战斗中由对方控制的怪兽。
若对应控制者没有攻击怪兽或攻击对象，则对应返回值为nil。
description_en: Returns the monster controlled by player that is currently in battle, followed by the monster controlled by the opponent that is currently in battle.
Each return can be nil if there is no attacker or attack target for that controller.

functions.name: Duel.GetChainEvent

returns.description: Event cards.
Event player.
Event value.
Reason effect.
Reason flags.
Reason player.

description_zh: 返回连锁环count保存的事件Group、事件玩家、事件数值、原因效果、原因和原因玩家。
description_en: Returns the event group, event player, event value, reason effect, reason, and reason player stored on Chain Link count.

functions.name: Duel.GetChainInfo

params.name: chainc
params.description: Chain index/count to inspect; scripts commonly use 0 for the current Chain Link.
One or more CHAININFO_* constants. Each requested field produces one return value.

returns.description: Values corresponding to the requested CHAININFO_* constants. CHAININFO_TARGET_CARDS returns the Chain's target Group.

description_zh: 按请求的CHAININFO_*常量顺序，返回chainc对应连锁的信息字段。
chainc=0表示当前正在处理的连锁。未知字段返回nil；连锁不存在时不返回值。
description_en: Returns information fields from chainc in the same order as the requested CHAININFO_* constants.
Use chainc=0 for the currently resolving Chain. Unknown requested fields return nil, and no values are returned if the Chain does not exist.

functions.name: Duel.GetChainMaterial

params.name: player
params.description: Player checked for an applying EFFECT_CHAIN_MATERIAL effect.

returns.description: First applying EFFECT_CHAIN_MATERIAL effect; no Lua value is pushed if player is invalid or no such effect exists, which behaves as nil in normal assignment.

description_zh: 返回当前适用于player的第1个EFFECT_CHAIN_MATERIAL效果；没有时返回nil。
融合类脚本通常读取该效果的Target和Operation回调，用于处理连锁素材替代流程。
description_en: Returns the first EFFECT_CHAIN_MATERIAL effect currently applying to player, or nil if none applies.
Fusion-style scripts use the returned effect's target and operation callbacks to handle Chain Material alternatives.

functions.name: Duel.GetCoinResult

returns.description: One value per stored coin result.

description_zh: 返回当前投掷硬币事件保存的硬币结果；每枚硬币返回一个结果。
description_en: Returns the stored coin toss results for the current coin-toss event, one result per coin.

functions.name: Duel.GetControl

params.name: reset_phase
params.description: default: 0

params.name: reset_count
params.description: default: 0

params.name: zone
params.description: default: 0xff

description_zh: 把targets的控制权转移给player，并返回实际变更控制权的卡的数量。
临时获得控制权时传入reset_phase和reset_count，例如PHASE_END, 1；只想指定可用区域时传入0, 0, zone。
description_en: Moves control of targets to player and returns the number of cards whose control actually changed.
Use reset_phase and reset_count for temporary control, such as PHASE_END, 1. To pass only a zone mask, use 0, 0, zone.

functions.name: Duel.GetCounter

returns.description: Counter count, or nil if player is invalid.

description_zh: 返回player视角下s和o位置中countertype类型指示物的总数。
description_en: Returns the total number of countertype counters in player-relative locations s and o.

functions.name: Duel.GetCurrentChain
description_zh: 返回当前连锁中已记录的连锁环数量。
description_en: Returns the number of Chain Links currently stored in the active Chain.

functions.name: Duel.GetCurrentPhase
description_zh: 返回当前的阶段
description_en: Returns the current phase constant.

functions.name: Duel.GetCustomActivityCount

params.name: counter_id
params.description: Identifier previously registered with Duel.AddCustomActivityCounter.

params.name: player
params.description: Player whose count is read; use 0 or 1.

params.name: activity_type
params.description: ACTIVITY_* constant selecting which custom activity map is read.

returns.description: Stored count for that player, counter ID, and activity type, or 0 if no matching custom counter exists.

description_zh: 返回counter_id和指定ACTIVITY_*类型下，player对应的自定义计数。
计数每回合重置。在此核心中，多数以卡为对象的自定义计数器只记录该玩家是否至少进行过1次被计数行动；连锁计数器会随连锁建立和取消而增减。
description_en: Returns player 0's or player 1's count for the custom counter_id and ACTIVITY_* type.

Counts are reset each turn. In this core, most card-based custom counters only record whether that player has performed a counted activity at least once, while Chain counters can increase and decrease with Chain creation and cancellation.

functions.name: Duel.GetDecktopGroup

params.name: player
params.description: Player whose Deck is read.

params.name: count
params.description: Maximum number of cards to include from the top of the Deck.

returns.description: New Group containing the top Deck cards, or an empty Group if no cards are available.

description_zh: 返回玩家player卡组最上方最多count张卡组成的Group。
若count大于剩余卡组数量，只包含实际存在的卡。该读取函数本身不会确认或公开这些卡。
description_en: Returns a Group containing up to count cards from the top of player's Deck.
If count is larger than the remaining Deck size, only the available cards are included. This accessor does not confirm or reveal those cards by itself.

functions.name: Duel.GetDiceResult

returns.description: First dice result.
Second dice result.
Third dice result.
Fourth dice result.
Fifth dice result.

description_zh: 返回当前掷骰事件保存的5个骰子结果槽位。
description_en: Returns the five stored dice-result slots for the current dice event.

functions.name: Duel.GetDrawCount

returns.description: Draw count, or nil if player is invalid.

description_zh: 返回player当前抽卡阶段规则抽卡数量。
description_en: Returns player's current rule draw count for the Draw Phase.

functions.name: Duel.GetExtraTopGroup
description_zh: 返回player额外卡组最上方至多count张卡组成的Group，起点在表侧灵摆卡部分之后。
description_en: Returns a Group containing up to count cards from the top of player's Extra Deck, after the face-up Pendulum section.

functions.name: Duel.GetFieldCard
description_zh: 返回player的location中sequence位置的卡；该位置为空或无效时返回nil。
若该位置的卡正在召唤或处于特殊召唤步骤状态，该绑定也返回nil。场地区域使用sequence 0，灵摆区域只在sequence 0和1且该卡当前标记为灵摆区域卡时返回。
description_en: Returns the card at player, location, and sequence, or nil if that slot is empty or invalid.

The binding also returns nil while the card at that slot is in Summoning or Special Summon step status. Field Zone sequence 0 maps to the Field Zone, and Pendulum Zone sequences 0 and 1 only return cards currently marked as Pendulum Zone cards.

functions.name: Duel.GetFieldGroup
description_zh: 从player视角返回指定位置的卡组；s为自己一侧位置，o为对方一侧位置。
description_en: Returns the cards in the specified locations from player's viewpoint; s is player's side and o is the opponent's side.

functions.name: Duel.GetFieldGroupCount
description_zh: 同 Duel.GetFieldGroup ，只是返回的是卡的数量
description_en: Returns the number of cards in the specified locations from player's viewpoint.

functions.name: Duel.GetFirstMatchingCard
description_zh: 返回指定位置中第一张满足f且未被ex排除的卡。
f可以为nil。ex可以是Card、Group或nil，ex之后的额外参数会传给f。没有匹配卡时返回nil。
description_en: Returns the first card in the specified locations that satisfies f and is not excluded by ex.
f may be nil. ex may be a Card, a Group, or nil, and extra arguments after ex are passed to f. Returns nil when no matching card is found.

functions.name: Duel.GetFirstTarget

returns.description: First recorded target card, followed by any additional target cards as extra Lua return values. No value is returned when the current Chain has no target cards.

description_zh: 返回当前正在处理的连锁登记的第一张对象卡。
若登记了多张对象卡，其余对象卡会按登记顺序作为额外返回值返回。
description_en: Returns the first target card currently recorded for the resolving Chain.
If multiple target cards were recorded, the remaining target cards are returned as additional values in recorded order.

functions.name: Duel.GetFlagEffect

params.name: player
params.description: Player whose flag effects are counted.

params.name: code
params.description: Flag-effect code; the core masks it with MAX_CARD_ID and adds EFFECT_FLAG_EFFECT.

returns.description: Number of matching player flag effects, or nil if player is invalid.

description_zh: 返回player上编号为code的玩家标记效果数量。
description_en: Returns how many player flag effects with code are registered on player.

functions.name: Duel.GetFlagEffectLabel

params.name: player
params.description: Player whose player flag effects are inspected.

params.name: code
params.description: Flag-effect code; the core masks it with MAX_CARD_ID and adds EFFECT_FLAG_EFFECT.

returns.description: First matching label, or nil if player is invalid or no matching flag effect exists.
Additional matching labels; a matching effect with no label contributes 0.

description_zh: 返回player身上code对应标志效果保存的Label值。
没有对应标志效果时核心返回nil；存在多个对应标志效果时，会按每个效果返回一个Label值。匹配的标志效果没有Label时，该位置返回0。
description_en: Returns the label values stored on player flag effects with code.
If no matching flag effect exists, the core returns nil; if multiple matching flag effects exist, it returns one label value for each. A matching flag effect with no label returns 0 for that slot.

functions.name: Duel.GetFusionMaterial

params.name: player
params.description: Player whose Fusion Material pool is collected.

params.name: location
params.description: Location mask for the base pool; default: LOCATION_HAND + LOCATION_MZONE.

returns.description: All currently usable Fusion Material candidates, including extra Fusion Material effects.
Base material pool from the requested locations only.

description_zh: 返回player的两个Group：当前可用的全部融合素材候选，以及来自指定位置的基础素材池。
location默认LOCATION_HAND + LOCATION_MZONE。魔法与陷阱区域或墓地中受EFFECT_EXTRA_FUSION_MATERIAL影响的卡只加入第1个返回Group；第2个Group只包含location指定位置的卡。
description_en: Returns two Groups for player: all currently usable Fusion Material candidates, then the base material pool from the requested locations.

location defaults to LOCATION_HAND + LOCATION_MZONE. Extra Fusion Material effects in the Spell & Trap Zone or GY are added to the first returned Group, while the second Group contains only cards from location.

functions.name: Duel.GetLastSelectHint
description_zh: 返回上次给玩家player发送的HINT_SELECTMSG类型的提示内容
description_en: Returns the last HINT_SELECTMSG hint sent to player.

functions.name: Duel.GetLinkedGroup

returns.description: Linked cards, or nil if player is invalid.

description_zh: 返回player视角下s和o位置中处于连接状态区域的卡组成的Group。
description_en: Returns a Group of cards in player-relative locations s and o that are linked.

functions.name: Duel.GetLinkedGroupCount
description_zh: 返回与player视角位置s和o连接的卡数量。
description_en: Returns the number of cards linked to player-relative locations s and o.

functions.name: Duel.GetLinkedZone
description_zh: 返回从player视角看当前被连接标记指向的区域位掩码。
description_en: Returns the zone bitmask currently pointed to by Link Markers from player's perspective.

functions.name: Duel.GetLocationCount

params.name: player
params.description: Player whose field is checked.
params.description_zh: 要检查其场上的玩家。

params.name: location
params.description: Location to count, normally LOCATION_MZONE or LOCATION_SZONE.
params.description_zh: 要统计的位置，通常为LOCATION_MZONE或LOCATION_SZONE。

params.name: use_player
params.description: Player treated as placing the card. Defaults to the current reason player.
params.description_zh: 视为要放置卡的玩家。省略时使用当前原因玩家。

params.name: reason
params.description: Placement reason such as LOCATION_REASON_TOFIELD or LOCATION_REASON_CONTROL. Defaults to LOCATION_REASON_TOFIELD.
params.description_zh: 放置原因，例如LOCATION_REASON_TOFIELD或LOCATION_REASON_CONTROL。省略时为LOCATION_REASON_TOFIELD。

params.name: zone
params.description: Zone mask to restrict the count. Defaults to 0xff.
params.description_zh: 限制统计范围的区域掩码。省略时为0xff。

returns.description: Available zone count. The core comment notes this can be negative.
returns.description_zh: 可用区域数量。核心注释说明该值可能为负数。

returns.description: Usable zone mask.
returns.description_zh: 可用区域掩码。

description_zh: 返回player场上location中可用区域数量以及对应的可用区域掩码。
location通常为LOCATION_MZONE或LOCATION_SZONE。use_player、reason和zone用于会限制放置区域的效果，例如类似凯撒斗技场的限制。
数量可能为负数；因此会把区域作为Cost腾出的脚本有时检查ft > -1，而不是ft > 0。
description_en: Returns how many zones of location are available on player's field and the corresponding usable zone mask.
location is normally LOCATION_MZONE or LOCATION_SZONE. use_player, reason, and zone are used by effects that restrict where cards can be placed, such as Kaiser Colosseum-style restrictions.
The count can be negative, so scripts that free a zone as a cost sometimes check ft > -1 instead of ft > 0.

functions.name: Duel.GetLocationCountFromEx

returns.description: Number of usable Monster Zones.
Usable zone mask.

description_zh: 返回从额外卡组特殊召唤时可用的怪兽区域数量，并额外返回可用区域掩码。
reason_player省略时使用当前原因玩家。targets会在检查数量前视为将离场。
description_en: Returns the usable Monster Zone count for Special Summoning from the Extra Deck, followed by the usable zone mask.
reason_player defaults to the current reason player. targets are treated as leaving the field before the count is checked.

functions.name: Duel.GetLP
description_zh: 返回player当前LP。
description_en: Returns player's current LP.

functions.name: Duel.GetMatchingGroup

params.name: f
params.description: Filter callback; nil accepts cards that pass location and exclusion checks.

params.name: player
params.description: Reference player for the s and o location masks.

params.name: s
params.description: Location mask on player's side.

params.name: o
params.description: Location mask on the opponent's side from player's viewpoint.

params.name: ex
params.description: Card or Group excluded from the result; nil excludes nothing.
Extra values forwarded to f after the candidate Card.

returns.description: New Group containing every matching card.

description_zh: 返回指定位置中满足筛选函数f且不在ex中的卡组成的Group。
s是player视角下己方位置掩码，o是对方位置掩码；ex之后的额外参数会传给f。
description_en: Returns a Group containing cards from the specified locations that satisfy filter f and are not excluded by ex.
s is player's own location mask and o is the opponent's location mask from that player's viewpoint. Extra arguments after ex are passed to f.

functions.name: Duel.GetMatchingGroupCount
description_zh: 过滤函数，返回以player来看的指定位置满足过滤条件f并且不等于ex的卡的数量
s代表以player来看的自己的位置，o代表以player来看的对方的位置
第6个参数开始为额外参数
description_en: Counts cards in the specified locations that satisfy filter f and are not excluded by ex.
Extra arguments after ex are passed to f after the card argument.

functions.name: Duel.GetMustMaterial

params.name: ecode
params.description: for example, EFFECT_MUST_BE_FMATERIAL

description_zh: 返回必须作为素材的卡片组
description_en: Returns the group of cards that must be used as material.

functions.name: Duel.GetMZoneCount

params.name: player
params.description: Player whose Monster Zones are checked.
params.description_zh: 要检查其怪兽区域的玩家。

params.name: targets
params.description: Card or Group treated as leaving the field before the count is checked.
params.description_zh: 在统计前视为将离场的Card或Group。

params.name: use_player
params.description: Player treated as placing the monster. Defaults to the current reason player.
params.description_zh: 视为要放置怪兽的玩家。省略时使用当前原因玩家。

params.name: reason
params.description: Placement reason. Defaults to LOCATION_REASON_TOFIELD.
params.description_zh: 放置原因。省略时为LOCATION_REASON_TOFIELD。

params.name: zone
params.description: Monster Zone mask to restrict the count. Defaults to 0xff.
params.description_zh: 限制统计范围的怪兽区域掩码。省略时为0xff。

returns.description: Usable Monster Zone count after targets are ignored.
returns.description_zh: 忽略targets后的可用怪兽区域数量。

returns.description: Usable Monster Zone mask.
returns.description_zh: 可用怪兽区域掩码。

description_zh: 返回targets离场后player可用的怪兽区域数量，并额外返回可用区域掩码。
use_player、reason和zone用于会限制怪兽可放置区域的效果。
description_en: Returns the number of usable Monster Zones for player after targets leave, plus the usable zone mask.
use_player, reason, and zone are used by effects that restrict where monsters can be placed.

functions.name: Duel.GetOperatedGroup
description_zh: 返回最近一次卡片操作实际处理过的卡组。
description_en: Returns the group of cards actually processed by the most recent card operation.

functions.name: Duel.GetOperationCount
description_zh: 返回连锁chainc包含的操作分类的数量
description_en: Returns the number of operation categories recorded for chainc.

functions.name: Duel.GetOperationInfo

returns.description: may be nil
may be nil
may be nil
may be nil

description_zh: 返回连锁chainc的category分类的操作信息，存在的话，则返回值为5个， chainc=0 则是表示当前连锁
第一个返回值是false的话表示不存在该分类
后4个返回值对应Duel.SetOperationInfo的后4个参数：Card|Group targets, int count, int target_player, int target_param
description_en: Returns operation information recorded for category on chainc.
The first return value is false when that category is not recorded. Otherwise, the remaining values correspond to Duel.SetOperationInfo: targets, count, target_player, and target_param.

functions.name: Duel.GetOverlayCount

returns.description: Overlay count, or nil if player is invalid.

description_zh: 返回player视角下s和o位置中的超量素材数量。
description_en: Returns the number of Xyz Materials attached to cards in player-relative locations s and o.

functions.name: Duel.GetOverlayGroup

returns.description: Overlay group, or nil if player is invalid.

description_zh: 返回player视角下s和o位置中卡片叠放的超量素材Group。
description_en: Returns the Xyz Materials attached to cards in player-relative locations s and o.

functions.name: Duel.GetReadyChain
description_zh: 返回当前已执行Target函数的连锁个数
description_en: Returns the number of chains whose Target function has already been executed.

functions.name: Duel.GetReleaseGroup

params.name: use_hand
params.description: default: false

params.name: reason
params.description: default: REASON_COST

description_zh: 返回玩家player能以原因reason解放的卡片组， use_hand=true 则包括手卡
description_en: Returns the cards player can Tribute/Release for effect purposes. If use_hand is true, valid cards in the hand are included.

functions.name: Duel.GetReleaseGroupCount

params.name: use_hand
params.description: default: false

params.name: reason
params.description: default: REASON_COST

description_zh: 返回玩家player能以原因reason解放的卡片数量， use_hand=true 则包括手卡
description_en: Returns the number of cards player can Tribute/Release for effect purposes. If use_hand is true, valid cards in the hand are included.

functions.name: Duel.GetRitualMaterial
description_zh: 返回player可作为基础仪式素材使用的卡。
该组包含手牌或场上可被解放的卡，也包含仪式素材例外，例如合适的墓地卡。
这只是起始素材池。选定仪式怪兽后，仍应使用Card.IsCanBeRitualMaterial过滤，并继续检查素材合计是否正好相等或大于等于需求。
description_en: Returns the cards player can use as basic Ritual Material.
The group includes cards in the hand or field that can be Tributed, plus Ritual-material exceptions such as suitable cards in the Graveyard.
This is only the starting pool. After a Ritual Monster is chosen, filter the group with Card.IsCanBeRitualMaterial and then perform the exact or greater-or-equal material total check.

functions.name: Duel.GetRitualMaterialEx
description_zh: 返回扩展仪式素材池，其中包含没有等级的怪兽。
本地Drytron风格脚本在仪式手续比较普通等级以外的数值时使用它，例如基于攻击力的数值。
取得该组后，仍需继续套用脚本自身的种族、卡片文本以及仪式怪兽素材检查。
description_en: Returns an extended Ritual Material pool, including monsters without a Level.
Local Drytron-style scripts use this when the Ritual procedure compares something other than ordinary Levels, such as an ATK-based value.
After collecting the group, still apply the script's own race, card text, and Ritual Monster material checks.

functions.name: Duel.GetSynchroMaterial

params.name: facedown
params.description: default: false

description_zh: 返回player可作为同调素材使用的卡组。
怪兽区域中里侧表示的卡只有在facedown为true时才包含。
description_en: Gets the group of cards player can use as Synchro Material.
Face-down cards in the Monster Zone are omitted unless facedown is true.

functions.name: Duel.GetSZoneCount

params.name: player
params.description: Player whose Spell & Trap Zones are checked.
params.description_zh: 要检查其魔法与陷阱区域的玩家。

params.name: targets
params.description: Card or Group treated as leaving the field before the count is checked.
params.description_zh: 在统计前视为将离场的Card或Group。

params.name: use_player
params.description: Player treated as placing the card. Defaults to the current reason player.
params.description_zh: 视为要放置卡的玩家。省略时使用当前原因玩家。

params.name: reason
params.description: Placement reason. Defaults to LOCATION_REASON_TOFIELD.
params.description_zh: 放置原因。省略时为LOCATION_REASON_TOFIELD。

params.name: zone
params.description: Spell & Trap Zone mask to restrict the count. Defaults to 0xff.
params.description_zh: 限制统计范围的魔法与陷阱区域掩码。省略时为0xff。

returns.description: Usable Spell & Trap Zone count after targets are ignored.
returns.description_zh: 忽略targets后的可用魔法与陷阱区域数量。

returns.description: Usable Spell & Trap Zone mask.
returns.description_zh: 可用魔法与陷阱区域掩码。

description_zh: 返回targets离场后player可用的魔法与陷阱区域数量，并可用zone限制统计范围；不包含场地区域。
额外的use_player和reason参数用于会限制区域的效果，例如凯撒斗技场。
description_en: Returns the number of available Spell & Trap Zones for player after targets leave, optionally restricted by zone. The Field Zone is not included.
The additional use_player and reason parameters are used by effects that restrict zones, such as Kaiser Colosseum.

functions.name: Duel.GetTargetCount
description_zh: 统计给定场上位置中匹配filter且可作为效果对象的卡数量；提供exception时将其排除。
description_en: Counts cards matching filter in the given field locations that can be used as effect targets, excluding exception when supplied.

functions.name: Duel.GetTargetsRelateToChain

returns.description: New Group containing the current Chain targets whose Chain relation is still valid; empty when none qualify.

description_zh: 返回当前正在处理的连锁中仍与该连锁有关联的全部对象卡。
这是多对象操作常用的关联检查辅助函数；已经离开预期位置的对象不会包含在返回的Group中。
description_en: Returns all target cards currently related to the resolving Chain.
This is the relation-aware helper for multi-target operations; targets that left their expected place are omitted from the returned Group.

functions.name: Duel.GetTributeCount

params.name: ex
params.description: default: false

description_zh: 返回target可用的祭品候选数量，可选用mg和额外处理限制。
description_en: Returns the number of available Tribute candidates for target, optionally restricted to mg and extra handling.

functions.name: Duel.GetTributeGroup
description_zh: 返回可为target通常召唤/盖放而解放的卡组成的Group。
description_en: Returns the Group of cards that can be Tributed for a Normal Summon/Set of target.

functions.name: Duel.GetTurnCount
description_zh: 返回当前回合数。
不传player时返回整场决斗的回合数；传入player 0或1时返回该玩家经过的个人回合数。
description_en: Returns the current turn count.
With no player argument, this returns the duel-wide turn number; with player 0 or 1, it returns that player's personal turn count.

functions.name: Duel.GetTurnPlayer
description_zh: 返回当前的回合玩家
description_en: Returns the current turn player.

functions.name: Duel.GetUsableMZoneCount

params.name: use_player
params.description: default: current reason player

returns.description: Usable Monster Zone count, or nil if player is invalid.

description_zh: 返回player可用于怪兽进场的怪兽区域数量。
use_player省略时使用当前原因玩家，并用于涉及行动玩家的区域限制检查。
description_en: Returns how many Monster Zones player can use for a monster entering the field.
use_player defaults to the current reason player and is used for zone-limit checks involving the acting player.

functions.name: Duel.GrabSelectedCard
description_zh: 把当前必须选择的卡作为Group返回，并清空核心必须选择列表。
description_en: Returns the current must-select cards as a Group and clears the core must-select list.

functions.name: Duel.Hint
description_zh: 给玩家player发送hint_type类型的提示消息，提示内容为desc。
description_en: Sends a hint message of hint_type to player using desc as the message id.
For HINT_SELECTMSG, desc is also stored as that player's last selection hint. HINT_OPSELECTED is displayed to the other player.

functions.name: Duel.HintSelection
description_zh: 手动为g显示被选为对象的动画效果
description_en: Displays the selection animation for g and records those cards as selected for client feedback.

functions.name: Duel.IncreaseSummonedCount
description_zh: 消耗当前原因玩家的通常召唤/盖放次数；若c存在额外召唤次数效果，则调用该效果。
description_en: Consumes the current reason player's Normal Summon/Set count, or invokes c's extra summon-count effect when present.

functions.name: Duel.IsAbleToEnterBP
description_zh: 检查当前回合玩家是否仍能进入战斗阶段。
核心要求决斗允许先攻攻击或当前不是第1回合，当前阶段早于PHASE_BATTLE_START，并且回合玩家不受EFFECT_CANNOT_BP影响。
description_en: Checks whether the current turn player can still enter the Battle Phase.
The core requires the duel to allow first-turn attacks or not be turn 1, the current phase to be before PHASE_BATTLE_START, and the turn player not to be affected by EFFECT_CANNOT_BP.

functions.name: Duel.IsBattlePhase
description_zh: 返回当前的阶段是否为战斗阶段
description_en: Returns whether the current phase is the Battle Phase.

functions.name: Duel.IsCanAddCounter
description_zh: 只提供player时，检查player是否未被禁止放置指示物。
提供countertype、count和c时，检查player能否在c上放置该数量的countertype指示物。
description_en: With only player, checks whether player is not forbidden from placing counters.
With countertype, count, and c, checks whether player can place that many counters of countertype on c.

functions.name: Duel.IsCanRemoveCounter
description_zh: 检查player能否因reason从指定场上位置取除count个countertype类型的指示物。
s表示从player视角看的己方场上位置，o表示对方场上位置。
description_en: Checks whether player can remove count counters of countertype for reason from the selected field locations.
s marks locations on player's own field and o marks locations on the opponent's field, from player's perspective.

functions.name: Duel.IsChainDisablable
description_zh: 检查chainc的效果能否被无效。
连锁处理中会询问核心该连锁环节当前能否被无效；不在连锁处理中时返回true。
description_en: Checks whether chainc's effect can be negated.
While a Chain is resolving, this asks the core whether that Chain link can currently be disabled; outside Chain resolution it returns true.

functions.name: Duel.IsChainDisabled
description_zh: 检查连锁chainc是否已被无效
description_en: Checks whether chainc has already been negated.

functions.name: Duel.IsChainNegatable

params.name: chainc
params.description: Chain Link number to test, commonly the ev argument in an EVENT_CHAINING condition.
params.description_zh: 要检查的连锁序号，通常是EVENT_CHAINING条件中的ev参数。

returns.description: true when this binding considers that Chain Link's activation negatable.
returns.description_zh: 若当前绑定认为该连锁环节的发动可以被无效则为true。

description_zh: 用于兼容的连锁发动可否被无效检查。
在当前MDPro3核心绑定中，此函数对任意连锁序号都会返回true。
本地脚本仍会在无效发动的条件中调用它，用来表达预期的发动合法性检查。
description_en: Compatibility check for whether chainc's activation can be negated.
In this MDPro3 core binding, the function currently returns true for any chain count.
Local scripts still call it in negation conditions so the script expresses the intended activation-legality check.

functions.name: Duel.IsChainSolving
description_zh: 检查当前是处于连锁处理中，还是不入连锁的效果处理中
description_en: Checks whether the game is currently resolving a Chain or resolving an effect that does not start a Chain.

functions.name: Duel.IsDamageCalculated

returns.description: true after damage calculation has been performed in the current battle timing.
returns.description_zh: 当前战斗时点已经进行过伤害计算时为true。

description_zh: 返回当前战斗/伤害步骤状态中是否已经进行过伤害计算。
在伤害步骤条件中可与Duel.GetCurrentPhase搭配使用，尤其适用于伤害计算后不能再发动的ATK/DEF变更效果。
description_en: Returns whether damage calculation has been performed in the current battle/damage-step state.
Use it with Duel.GetCurrentPhase in Damage Step conditions, especially for ATK/DEF-changing effects that stop being legal after damage calculation.

functions.name: Duel.IsEnvironment

params.name: player
params.description: default: PLAYER_ALL

params.name: loc
params.description: default: LOCATION_ONFIELD

description_zh: 检查code当前是否被视为环境卡，或是否在请求的位置中存在匹配的表侧表示卡。
player默认PLAYER_ALL，loc默认LOCATION_ONFIELD。核心会先检查场地区域；若没有表侧场地区域卡，也可以匹配最新的EFFECT_CHANGE_ENVIRONMENT效果。
description_en: Checks whether code is currently treated as the environment card or as a matching face-up card in the requested locations.

player defaults to PLAYER_ALL and loc defaults to LOCATION_ONFIELD. The core checks Field Zones first; if no face-up Field Zone card exists, it can also match the latest EFFECT_CHANGE_ENVIRONMENT effect.

functions.name: Duel.IsExistingMatchingCard
description_zh: 过滤函数；检查以player来看指定位置是否存在至少count张满足f且不等于ex的卡。
description_en: Checks whether the specified locations contain at least count cards that satisfy filter f and are not excluded by ex.
s is player's own location mask and o is the opponent's location mask from that player's viewpoint. Extra arguments after ex are passed to f.

functions.name: Duel.IsExistingTarget

params.name: f
params.description: Filter called with each candidate card first, then any extra arguments after ex.

params.name: player
params.description: Viewpoint player for s and o.

params.name: s
params.description: Locations on player's side to search.

params.name: o
params.description: Locations on the opponent's side to search.

params.name: count
params.description: Minimum number of legal targets required.

params.name: ex
params.description: Card or Group excluded from the search.
Extra values passed to f after the candidate card.

returns.description: True if at least count matching cards can be targeted by the current effect.

description_zh: 检查指定位置中是否存在至少count张满足筛选函数f、未被ex排除、且可以成为当前处理效果对象的卡。
当卡需要成为正式效果对象时，在Target回调中使用此函数。
description_en: Checks whether the specified locations contain at least count cards that satisfy filter f, are not excluded by ex, and can be targeted by the currently handled effect.
Use this in Target callbacks when the card must become an official effect target.

functions.name: Duel.IsMainPhase
description_zh: 返回当前的阶段是否为主要阶段
description_en: Returns whether the current phase is a Main Phase.

functions.name: Duel.IsPhase
description_zh: 返回当前的阶段是否为phase
description_en: Returns whether the current phase is phase.

functions.name: Duel.IsPlayerAffectedByEffect
description_zh: 检查player是否受到种类为code的效果影响，如果有就返回该效果，没有则返回nil
description_en: Returns an effect affecting player with code, or nil if no matching effect exists. Some effects may return additional values.

functions.name: Duel.IsPlayerCanAdditionalSummon
description_zh: 当player在core.extra_summon中没有待处理的额外通常召唤标记时返回true。
description_en: Returns true when player has no pending extra Normal Summon marker in core.extra_summon.

functions.name: Duel.IsPlayerCanDiscardDeck
description_zh: 检查玩家player是否可以把卡组顶端count张卡送去墓地
description_en: Checks whether player can send count cards from the top of the Deck to the Graveyard.

functions.name: Duel.IsPlayerCanDiscardDeckAsCost
description_zh: 检查玩家player是否能作为Cost把count张卡送去墓地。
description_en: Checks whether player can send count cards from the top of the Deck to the Graveyard as a cost.

functions.name: Duel.IsPlayerCanDraw

params.name: count
params.description: default: 0

description_zh: 检查玩家player是否可以效果抽[count张]卡
description_en: Checks whether player can draw count cards.

functions.name: Duel.IsPlayerCanFlipSummon
description_zh: 检查player是否能进行反转召唤，或检查player能否反转召唤c。
description_en: Checks whether player can Flip Summon at all, or whether player can Flip Summon c.

functions.name: Duel.IsPlayerCanMSet
description_zh: 检查player是否能盖放怪兽，或检查player能否以召唤类型sumtype盖放c。
description_en: Checks whether player can Set monsters at all, or whether player can Set c with summon type sumtype.

functions.name: Duel.IsPlayerCanRelease

params.name: reason
params.description: default: REASON_COST

description_zh: 检查player是否能进行解放，或检查player能否以reason解放c。
提供c但省略reason时，核心使用REASON_COST。
description_en: Checks whether player can release cards at all, or whether player can release c for reason.
When c is supplied and reason is omitted, the core uses REASON_COST.

functions.name: Duel.IsPlayerCanRemove

params.name: reason
params.description: default: REASON_EFFECT

description_zh: 只提供player时，检查player是否未被禁止除外。
提供c时，检查player能否因reason除外c；reason默认REASON_EFFECT。
description_en: With only player, checks whether player is not forbidden from banishing.
With c, checks whether player can banish c for reason; reason defaults to REASON_EFFECT.

functions.name: Duel.IsPlayerCanSendtoDeck
description_zh: 检查player是否能把卡送去Deck，或检查player能否把c送去Deck。
description_en: Checks whether player can send cards to the Deck at all, or whether player can send c to the Deck.

functions.name: Duel.IsPlayerCanSendtoGrave
description_zh: 检查玩家是否能把c送去墓地
description_en: Checks whether player can send c to the Graveyard.

functions.name: Duel.IsPlayerCanSendtoHand
description_zh: 检查player是否能把卡送去手牌，或检查player能否把c送去手牌。
description_en: Checks whether player can send cards to the hand at all, or whether player can send c to the hand.

functions.name: Duel.IsPlayerCanSpecialSummon
description_zh: 只提供player时，检查player是否允许进行特殊召唤，且仍有可用的特殊召唤次数。
提供可选的卡片相关参数时，使用当前原因效果检查player能否以sumtype和sumpos把c特殊召唤到target_player场上。
description_en: With only player, checks whether player is allowed to perform a Special Summon and still has Special Summon count available.
With the optional card-specific arguments, checks whether player can Special Summon c to target_player in sumpos with sumtype, using the current reason effect.

functions.name: Duel.IsPlayerCanSpecialSummonCount
description_zh: 检查player在当前剩余特殊召唤次数限制下，能否进行count次特殊召唤。
核心会检查EFFECT_LEFT_SPSUMMON_COUNT效果以及该玩家的特殊召唤计数器。
description_en: Checks whether player can perform count Special Summons under the current remaining Special Summon-count limits.
The core checks EFFECT_LEFT_SPSUMMON_COUNT effects and the player's Special Summon counter.

functions.name: Duel.IsPlayerCanSpecialSummonMonster

returns.description: true if the virtual monster can be Special Summoned.

description_zh: 检查player能否特殊召唤一只由传入卡片数据构造的虚拟怪兽。
可选参数会覆盖读取到的卡片数据，之后用pos、target_player和sumtype描述召唤方式与位置。当前MDPro3绑定不会读取zone参数。
description_en: Checks whether player can Special Summon a virtual monster with the supplied card data.
Optional arguments override the loaded card data, then pos, target_player, and sumtype describe how and where the monster would be Summoned. This MDPro3 binding does not read a zone argument.

functions.name: Duel.IsPlayerCanSSet
description_zh: 检查player是否能盖放魔法/陷阱，或检查player能否把c作为魔法/陷阱盖放。
description_en: Checks whether player can Set Spell/Trap Cards at all, or whether player can Set c as a Spell/Trap Card.

functions.name: Duel.IsPlayerCanSummon
description_zh: 只提供player时，检查player是否未被无目标的EFFECT_CANNOT_SUMMON禁止通常召唤。
提供sumtype和c时，检查player对c以该sumtype通常召唤时受到的EFFECT_CANNOT_SUMMON限制。该绑定不检查召唤次数、费用、解放可用性或区域可用性。
description_en: With only player, checks whether player is not forbidden from performing a Normal Summon by an untargeted EFFECT_CANNOT_SUMMON.

With sumtype and c, checks player EFFECT_CANNOT_SUMMON restrictions for Normal Summoning c with that sumtype. This binding does not check Summon count, costs, tribute availability, or zone availability.

functions.name: Duel.IsSummonCancelable
description_zh: 返回当前召唤选择的核心可取消标志。
description_en: Returns the core summon-cancelable flag for the current Summon selection.

functions.name: Duel.IsTurnPlayer
description_zh: 返回当前的回合玩家是否为playerid
description_en: Returns whether playerid is the current turn player.

functions.name: Duel.LinkSummon

params.name: minc
params.description: default: 0

params.name: maxc
params.description: default: 0

description_zh: 为player开始对c进行规则连接召唤。
materials、lcard、minc、maxc会成为临时连接召唤限制；该绑定交给核心处理并且不返回Lua值。
description_en: Starts a rule Link Summon of c for player.
materials, lcard, minc, and maxc become temporary Link Summon limits; the binding yields to the core and returns no Lua value.

functions.name: Duel.MajesticCopy
description_zh: 把copy_target的怪兽initial_effect复制给c，持续到结束阶段。
它复制连锁环怪兽效果，跳过超量素材效果，把强制诱发/快速效果改成任意发动版本，并且不复制魔法/陷阱效果。
description_en: Copies monster initial effects from copy_target onto c until the End Phase.
It copies chain-link monster effects, skips Xyz Material effects, converts mandatory trigger/quick effects to optional versions, and does not copy Spell/Trap effects.

functions.name: Duel.MoveSequence
description_zh: 若c受当前处理中的原因效果影响，将c在其当前控制者与当前位置内移动到序号seq。
核心会对移动的卡引发EVENT_MOVE，且不返回Lua值。
description_en: Moves c to sequence seq within its current controller and location if c is affected by the resolving reason effect.
The core raises EVENT_MOVE for the moved card and returns no Lua values.

functions.name: Duel.MoveToField
description_zh: 让玩家move_player把c移动的target_player的场上，返回值表示是否成功
dest只能是LOCATION_MZONE或者LOCATION_SZONE，pos表示可选表示形式， enable 表示是否立刻适用c的效果
description_en: Moves c onto target_player's field and returns true if the move succeeds.
dest is normally LOCATION_MZONE or LOCATION_SZONE. LOCATION_FZONE and LOCATION_PZONE are accepted and converted to the matching Spell & Trap Zone handling by the core.

functions.name: Duel.MSet

params.name: min
params.description: default: 0

params.name: zone
params.description: default: 0x1f

description_zh: 让玩家 player 以效果e对c[在区域 zone]进行通常召唤的Set，至少使用min个祭品
如果e=nil,那么就按照一般的通常召唤规则进行通常召唤
如果ignore_count=true，则忽略每回合的通常召唤次数限制
description_en: Makes player Set c by a Normal Summon procedure, optionally using effect e and requiring at least min Tributes.
If e is nil, regular Normal Summon/Set rules are used. If ignore_count is true, the once-per-turn Normal Summon limit is ignored.

functions.name: Duel.NegateActivation
description_zh: 尝试把chainc的发动无效，并返回是否成功。
description_en: Attempts to negate the activation of chainc and returns true if it succeeds.

functions.name: Duel.NegateAttack
description_zh: 尝试无效当前攻击，并返回是否成功无效该次攻击。
没有有效攻击怪兽、攻击怪兽离场或field ID变化、攻击怪兽不能攻击、伤害步骤状态不允许无效攻击，或攻击怪兽不受当前处理效果影响时，核心返回false。
description_en: Attempts to negate the current attack and returns whether the attack was successfully negated.

The core fails if there is no valid current attacker, if the attacker moved or changed field ID, if the attacker cannot attack, if the Damage Step state blocks attack negation, or if the attacker is not affected by the resolving effect.

functions.name: Duel.NegateEffect
description_zh: 尝试把chainc的效果无效，并返回是否成功。forced表示请求强制无效。
description_en: Attempts to negate the effect of chainc and returns true if it succeeds. forced requests a forced disable.

functions.name: Duel.NegateRelatedChain

params.name: c
params.description: Card whose related earlier Chain Links should receive EFFECT_DISABLE_CHAIN.

params.name: reset_flag
params.description: Additional reset mask ORed with RESET_CHAIN and RESET_EVENT on each generated disable effect.

description_zh: 对当前连锁中由c发动且仍与c保持关联的连锁，给c登记临时的EFFECT_DISABLE_CHAIN效果。
该无效效果以RESET_CHAIN、RESET_EVENT和传入的reset标志重置；若没有可处理的早前连锁，或c不受当前处理效果影响，核心不做处理。
description_en: For each current Chain Link whose triggering effect is handled by c and still related to c, registers a temporary EFFECT_DISABLE_CHAIN effect on c.

The generated disable effect resets with RESET_CHAIN, RESET_EVENT, and the supplied reset flags. The core does nothing if there is no earlier Chain Link to disable or if c is unaffected by the resolving effect.

functions.name: Duel.NegateSummon
description_zh: 无效targets正在进行的通常召唤、反转召唤或特殊召唤。
targets可以是Card或Group。通常召唤与反转召唤的无效要求只有1张卡；特殊召唤无效可以处理Group，并且只无效当前原因效果可以无效其召唤的卡。核心会引发对应的*_SUMMON_NEGATED事件，且不返回Lua值。
description_en: Negates a current Normal Summon, Flip Summon, or Special Summon for targets.

targets may be a Card or Group. Normal and Flip Summon negation require a single card; Special Summon negation can process a group and only negates cards whose Summon is negatable by the current reason effect. The core raises the matching *_SUMMON_NEGATED event and returns no Lua value.

functions.name: Duel.Overlay

params.name: adjust
params.description: default: true

description_zh: 把ocard作为c的叠放卡叠放
description_en: Overlays ocard under c as Xyz Material.
By default the field is adjusted after the overlay. Pass adjust=false only when a larger procedure will adjust afterward.

functions.name: Duel.PayLPCost

params.name: player
params.description: Player who pays the LP cost.
params.description_zh: 支付LP Cost的玩家。

params.name: cost
params.description: LP amount to pay.
params.description_zh: 要支付的LP数值。

params.name: must_pay
params.description: Passed through to the core LP-cost payment processor.
params.description_zh: 传给核心LP Cost支付处理器。

description_zh: 使player支付指定LP Cost。
只应在实际Cost分支调用；chk==0分支应先使用Duel.CheckLPCost或等价检查确认可以支付。
description_en: Makes player pay the specified LP cost.
Call this only in the real Cost branch after the chk==0 branch has used Duel.CheckLPCost or an equivalent legality check.

functions.name: Duel.RaiseEvent
description_zh: 以给定效果、原因、原因玩家、事件玩家和事件值，对Card或Group引发事件code。
核心在引发事件后处理即时事件并yield，不返回Lua值。
description_en: Raises event code for a Card or Group with the supplied effect, reason, reason player, event player, and event value.
The core processes instant events after raising the event and yields without returning Lua values.

functions.name: Duel.RaiseSingleEvent
description_zh: 以code、re、r、rp、ep、ev为ec引发单卡事件，然后处理单卡事件。
description_en: Raises a single-card event for ec with code, re, r, rp, ep, and ev, then processes single-card events.

functions.name: Duel.RDComplete
description_zh: 在Duel.Damage或Duel.Recover以is_step=true调用后，完成保留的分步伤害/恢复处理。
description_en: Completes reserved step damage/recover processing after Duel.Damage or Duel.Recover is called with is_step=true.

functions.name: Duel.Readjust
description_zh: 为当前原因效果的处理对象请求场地重新调整。
同一处理对象在当前追踪表中请求超过3次时，核心会把它因规则送去墓地。
description_en: Requests a field readjust for the current reason effect's handler.
If the same handler requests readjustment more than three times in the current tracking map, the core sends it to the Graveyard by rule instead.

functions.name: Duel.Recover

params.name: is_step
params.description: default: false

description_zh: 为player恢复LP并返回处理的数值。
效果可以把恢复反转为伤害。is_step=true时，需要用Duel.RDComplete完成本批伤害/恢复处理。
description_en: Gives player LP for reason and returns the amount processed.
Effects can reverse recovery into damage. With is_step=true, finish the damage/recovery batch with Duel.RDComplete.

functions.name: Duel.RegisterEffect
description_zh: 把效果e作为玩家player的效果注册给全局环境
description_en: Registers e as a player/global effect for player.

functions.name: Duel.RegisterFlagEffect

params.name: player
params.description: Player that receives the marker; invalid players make the core return no values.

params.name: code
params.description: Flag-effect code; the core masks it with MAX_CARD_ID and adds EFFECT_FLAG_EFFECT.

params.name: reset_flag
params.description: RESET_* mask controlling when the marker expires.

params.name: property
params.description: Effect property flags stored on the created marker; player-target, field-only, and cannot-disable flags are always added.

params.name: reset_count
params.description: Reset counter for the created marker; 0 is treated as 1.

params.name: label
params.description: Optional integer payload stored on the marker.

returns.description: The created flag effect, or nil if player is invalid.

description_zh: 为player登记玩家/全局标记效果，并返回创建的Effect。
该标记效果以玩家为对象、只作为场地效果存在、不能被无效，且count=0会按1处理。
description_en: Registers a player/global flag effect on player and returns the created Effect.
The flag effect is player-targeted, field-only, cannot be disabled, and count=0 is treated as 1.

functions.name: Duel.Release
description_zh: 以reason原因解放targets ，返回值是实际解放的数量
如果reason含有REASON_COST，则不会检查卡片是否不受效果影响
如果设置reason_player，则视为被玩家reason_player移动
description_en: Tributes/Releases targets for reason and returns the number of cards actually released.
Use REASON_COST when paying a cost and REASON_EFFECT or REASON_SPSUMMON when the release is part of an effect or Summon procedure.

functions.name: Duel.ReleaseRitualMaterial
description_zh: 按照仪式素材规则移动g中选定的仪式素材。
通常的手牌或场上素材会被解放，而合适的墓地仪式素材等会改为除外。
调用此函数前应先调用Card.SetMaterial；之后以SUMMON_TYPE_RITUAL特殊召唤，并在召唤成功后调用Card.CompleteProcedure。本函数不返回数量。
description_en: Moves the selected Ritual Materials in g using Ritual-material rules.
Standard hand or field materials are Tributed, while materials such as suitable Graveyard Ritual Materials are banished instead.
Call Card.SetMaterial before this function, then Special Summon with SUMMON_TYPE_RITUAL and call Card.CompleteProcedure after the Summon succeeds. The function does not return a count.

functions.name: Duel.Remove
description_zh: 以reason原因，pos表示形式除外targets，返回值是实际被操作的数量
如果reason包含REASON_TEMPORARY，那么视为是暂时除外，可以通过Duel.ReturnToField返回到场上
如果设置reason_player，则视为被玩家reason_player移动
description_en: Banishes targets in position pos for reason and returns the number of cards actually banished.
If reason includes REASON_TEMPORARY, the banish is treated as temporary and the card can later be returned with Duel.ReturnToField.

functions.name: Duel.RemoveCounter
description_zh: 让player因reason从指定场上位置取除count个countertype类型的指示物，并返回是否成功取除。
s表示从player视角看的己方场上位置，o表示对方场上位置。核心会在取除指示物前提供可适用的指示物取除替代效果。
description_en: Lets player remove count counters of countertype from the selected field locations for reason and returns whether removal succeeded.

s marks locations on player's own field and o marks locations on the opponent's field, from player's perspective. The core can offer applicable counter-removal replacement effects before removing counters.

functions.name: Duel.RemoveOverlayCard
description_zh: 让player因reason从指定的己方/对方场上位置取除min到max个超量素材。
s表示从player视角看的己方场上位置，o表示对方场上位置。返回值为实际取除的素材数量。
description_en: Lets player remove between min and max Xyz Materials from the specified own/opponent field locations for reason.
s marks locations on player's own field and o marks locations on the opponent's field, from player's perspective. The return value is the number of materials removed.

functions.name: Duel.ResetFlagEffect

params.name: player
params.description: Player whose matching flag effects are reset.

params.name: code
params.description: Flag-effect code to clear.

description_zh: 重置player持有的code对应全部玩家标志效果。
description_en: Resets all player flag effects with code for player.

functions.name: Duel.ReturnToField

params.name: pos
params.description: default: previous position

params.name: zone
params.description: default: 0xff

returns.description: Success flag, or nil if c was not temporarily removed from the field.

description_zh: 把临时离场的卡返回到其之前的控制者和之前的位置。
pos默认之前的表示形式，zone默认0xff。若c不是因REASON_TEMPORARY离场，该绑定不返回Lua值；否则会yield并返回移动是否成功。
description_en: Returns a card temporarily removed from the field to its previous controller and previous location.

pos defaults to the previous position and zone defaults to 0xff. If c was not removed for REASON_TEMPORARY, the binding returns no Lua value; otherwise it yields and returns whether the move succeeded.

functions.name: Duel.RevealSelectDeckSequence

params.name: enabled
params.description: default: true

description_zh: 启用选择卡组时显示真实序号
description_en: Enables showing the real sequence when selecting cards from the Deck.

functions.name: Duel.RockPaperScissors

params.name: repeat
params.description: default: true

returns.description: Winning player.

description_zh: 执行猜拳选择并返回胜方玩家；repeat默认true。
description_en: Runs the Rock-Paper-Scissors selector and returns the winning player; repeat defaults to true.

functions.name: Duel.SelectDisableField

params.name: player
params.description: Player who selects zones and whose viewpoint defines the returned mask.
params.description_zh: 选择区域的玩家；返回掩码也以该玩家视角表示。

params.name: count
params.description: Number of zones to select. The core reduces this to the number of available zones if needed.
params.description_zh: 要选择的区域数量；必要时核心会把该值限制到可用区域数量。

params.name: location1
params.description: Selectable locations on player's field, usually LOCATION_MZONE and/or LOCATION_SZONE.
params.description_zh: player场上可选择的位置，通常为LOCATION_MZONE和/或LOCATION_SZONE。

params.name: location2
params.description: Selectable locations on the opponent's field, usually LOCATION_MZONE and/or LOCATION_SZONE.
params.description_zh: 对方场上可选择的位置，通常为LOCATION_MZONE和/或LOCATION_SZONE。

params.name: filter
params.description: Player-relative mask of zones that cannot be selected.
params.description_zh: 以player视角表示的不可选择区域掩码。

returns.description: Selected zone bitmask, or no return value if no zone can be selected.
returns.description_zh: 所选区域掩码；没有可选区域时不返回值。

description_zh: 让player从请求的己方与对方位置中选择count个可用场地区域，并返回所选区域位掩码。
location1应用于player场上，location2应用于对方场上。核心会把count限制为可用区域数量；没有可选区域时不返回值。
返回掩码使用player视角位：己方怪兽区域为seq，己方魔法与陷阱区域为seq+8，对方怪兽区域为seq+16，对方魔法与陷阱区域为seq+24。
description_en: Lets player select count available field zones from the requested own-side and opponent-side locations, then returns the selected zone bitmask.
location1 applies to player's field and location2 applies to the opponent's field. The core clamps count to the available number of zones and returns no value if no zone can be selected.
The returned mask uses player-relative bits: own Monster Zone seq, own Spell & Trap Zone seq+8, opponent Monster Zone seq+16, and opponent Spell & Trap Zone seq+24.

functions.name: Duel.SelectEffectYesNo

params.name: desc
params.description: default: 95

description_zh: 询问player是否使用c的效果，提示描述编号为desc，省略时默认为95。
description_en: Asks player whether to use c's effect with description id desc, defaulting to 95.

functions.name: Duel.SelectField

returns.description: Selected zone bitmask, or nil if player is invalid.

description_zh: 让player从location1/location2对应的场地区域中选择count个区域，并把filter视为不可选择区域。
提供desc时，核心会显示该选择提示。返回值是从player视角表示已选区域的位掩码。
description_en: Lets player select count field zones from location1/location2 after applying filter as unavailable zones.
When desc is supplied, the core shows it as a selection hint. The return value is a bitmask of selected zones from player's viewpoint.

functions.name: Duel.SelectFusionMaterial

params.name: chkf
params.description: default: PLAYER_NONE

params.name: not_material
params.description: default: false

description_zh: 让player从g中为融合怪兽c选择有效的融合素材组，并返回选中的Group。
提供gc时，所选素材必须包含gc；返回的Group也会包含gc，与核心选择行为一致。
description_en: Lets player select a valid Fusion Material group for Fusion Monster c from g and returns the selected Group.
gc, when supplied, must be included. The returned Group also contains gc, matching the core selection behavior.

functions.name: Duel.SelectMatchingCard

params.name: sel_player
params.description: Player who makes the selection; invalid players make the core return no values.

params.name: f
params.description: Filter callback; nil accepts cards that pass location and exclusion checks.

params.name: player
params.description: Reference player for the s and o location masks.

params.name: s
params.description: Location mask on player's side.

params.name: o
params.description: Location mask on the opponent's side from player's viewpoint.

params.name: min
params.description: Minimum number of cards to select.

params.name: max
params.description: Maximum number of cards to select.

params.name: ex
params.description: Card or Group excluded from selectable cards; nil excludes nothing.
Extra values forwarded to f after the candidate Card.

returns.description: New Group containing the selected cards, or nil if sel_player is invalid.

description_zh: 让sel_player从指定位置中选择min到max张满足筛选函数f且不在ex中的卡。
s是player视角下己方位置掩码，o是对方位置掩码；ex之后的额外参数会传给f。
description_en: Lets sel_player choose min to max cards from the specified locations that satisfy filter f and are not excluded by ex.
s is player's own location mask and o is the opponent's location mask from that player's viewpoint. Extra arguments after ex are passed to f.

functions.name: Duel.SelectOption
description_zh: 让player从一组描述编号中选择1项，并返回所选项从0开始的序号。
所选描述编号也会作为客户端提示显示。
description_en: Shows player a list of description ids and returns the zero-based index of the selected option.
The selected description id is also announced to the client.

functions.name: Duel.SelectPosition
description_zh: 让player为c从允许的表示形式中选择一个，并返回所选POS_*数值。
description_en: Lets player choose one of the allowed positions for c and returns the selected POS_* value.

functions.name: Duel.SelectReleaseGroup
description_zh: 让player选择min到max张满足f且不在ex中的可解放卡，并返回选中的Group。
ex之后的额外参数会传给f。
description_en: Lets player select min to max releasable cards matching f, excluding ex, and returns the selected Group.
Extra arguments after ex are passed to f after the Card argument.

functions.name: Duel.SelectReleaseGroupEx
description_zh: 过滤函数，让玩家player从场上选择min-max张满足过滤条件f并且不等于ex的能以原因reason解放的卡，use_hand则包括手卡
第6个参数开始为额外参数
description_en: Lets player select min to max cards that can be Tributed/Released for effect purposes, optionally excluding ex and applying filter f.

functions.name: Duel.SelectSequence
description_zh: 此核心中的空操作存根；只检查动作权限，不返回值。
description_en: No-op stub in this core; it only checks action permission and returns no values.

functions.name: Duel.SelectSynchroMaterial
description_zh: 让player为c选择同调素材，并返回选中的Group。
f1筛选调整素材，f2筛选非调整素材，min和max限制非调整数量，smat指定必须包含的素材，mg提供可选的素材范围。
description_en: Lets player select Synchro Materials for c and returns the selected Group.
f1 filters the Tuner material, f2 filters non-Tuner materials, min and max restrict the non-Tuner count, smat forces a required material, and mg supplies an optional material pool.

functions.name: Duel.SelectTarget

params.name: sel_player
params.description: Player who makes the selection.

params.name: f
params.description: Filter called with each candidate card first, then any extra arguments after ex.

params.name: player
params.description: Viewpoint player for s and o.

params.name: s
params.description: Locations on player's side to search.

params.name: o
params.description: Locations on the opponent's side to search.

params.name: min
params.description: Minimum number of cards to select.

params.name: max
params.description: Maximum number of cards to select.

params.name: ex
params.description: Card or Group excluded from the selection.
Extra values passed to f after the candidate card.

returns.description: Group of cards selected by sel_player and registered as current Chain targets. If there is no current Chain or sel_player is invalid, the core returns no value.

description_zh: 让sel_player选择min到max张满足筛选函数f、未被ex排除、且可以成为当前处理效果对象的卡。
选择的卡会登记为当前连锁的对象卡。对于非永续效果，核心还会建立供IsRelateToEffect等函数使用的连锁关联。
description_en: Lets sel_player choose min to max cards that satisfy filter f, are not excluded by ex, and can be targeted by the currently handled effect.
The selected cards are registered as the current Chain's target cards. For non-continuous effects, the core also creates Chain relations used by IsRelateToEffect and related helpers.

functions.name: Duel.SelectTribute

params.name: toplayer
params.description: default: player

description_zh: 让player为通常召唤或盖放c选择min到max只祭品，并返回选择的Group。
mg可以限制候选素材池。toplayer默认player；toplayer不同于player时，核心会构建用于向该玩家场上解放的额外候选列表。
description_en: Lets player select min to max Tribute candidates for Normal Summoning or Setting c and returns the selected Group.
mg can restrict the candidate pool. toplayer defaults to player; when toplayer differs, the core builds the extra release list for Tributing to that player's field.

functions.name: Duel.SelectTunerMaterial
description_zh: 让player以固定tuner、可选筛选、数量限制和可选素材Group为scard选择同调素材。
description_en: Lets player select Synchro Materials for scard using the fixed tuner, optional filters, count limits, and optional material group.

functions.name: Duel.SelectXyzMaterial
description_zh: 让player为scard选择等级lv和素材数量范围对应的超量素材，可带可选筛选函数和素材Group。
description_en: Lets player select Xyz Materials for scard for Level lv and material count range, with optional filter and material group.

functions.name: Duel.SelectYesNo
description_zh: 让玩家player选择是或否
description_en: Asks player a yes/no prompt using description id desc and returns true for Yes.

functions.name: Duel.SendtoDeck
description_zh: 以reason原因把targets送去玩家player的卡组，返回值是实际被操作的数量
如果player是nil则返回卡的持有者的卡组
如果seq=0，则是返回卡组最顶端；seq=1则是返回卡组最底端；
其余情况则是返回最顶端并且标记需要洗卡组
如果设置reason_player，则视为被玩家reason_player移动
如果设置send_activating，则可以移动发动中的魔法陷阱卡
description_en: Returns targets to the Deck or Extra Deck for reason and returns the number of cards moved.
If player is nil, each card returns to its owner. seq=0 places cards on top of the Deck, seq=1 places them on the bottom, and other values use the default shuffle/return handling.

functions.name: Duel.SendtoExtraP
description_zh: 因reason把卡以表侧送去player方额外卡组，并返回实际移动的卡数量。
description_en: Sends cards to player-side Extra Deck face-up for reason and returns the number of cards moved.

functions.name: Duel.SendtoGrave

params.name: targets
params.description: Card or Group to send to the Graveyard.

params.name: reason
params.description: REASON_* flags recorded for the move.

params.name: reason_player
params.description: Player recorded as the reason player; defaults to the core's current reason player.

returns.description: Number of cards actually sent to the Graveyard.

description_zh: 因reason将targets送去墓地，可选指定reason_player作为执行该移动的玩家，并返回实际移动的数量。
description_en: Sends targets to the Graveyard for reason, optionally treating reason_player as the player that moved them, and returns the number actually moved.

functions.name: Duel.SendtoHand
description_zh: 以reason原因把targets送去玩家player的手卡，返回值是实际被操作的数量
如果player是nil则返回卡的持有者的手卡
如果设置reason_player，则视为被玩家reason_player移动
description_en: Sends targets to a hand for reason and returns the number of cards actually moved.
Pass nil for player to use the normal return destination. Pass a specific player only when the effect says the cards go to that player's hand.

functions.name: Duel.SetChainLimit
description_zh: 为当前连锁窗口登记临时连锁限制回调。
该回调会与当前原因玩家一起保存，之后以f(e, chain_player, activating_player)调用；返回false时，该效果不能连锁。
description_en: Registers a temporary chain-limit callback for the current Chain window.
The callback is stored with the current reason player and is later called as f(e, chain_player, activating_player). If it returns false, that effect cannot be chained.

functions.name: Duel.SetChainLimitTillChainEnd

params.name: f
params.description: callback: f(e, chain_player, activating_player)

description_zh: 登记持续到当前连锁结束的连锁限制回调。
description_en: Registers a chain-limit callback that persists until the current chain ends.

functions.name: Duel.SetCoinResult
description_zh: 设置核心保存的硬币结果槽；只有0和1会保留，其他值会按0保存。
description_en: Sets the stored coin results in the core result slots; only 0 and 1 are preserved, and other values are stored as 0.

functions.name: Duel.SetDiceResult
description_zh: 设置5个骰子结果槽位；缺少或超出范围的值会被保存为1。
description_en: Sets the five stored dice-result slots; missing or out-of-range values are stored as 1.

functions.name: Duel.SetFlagEffectLabel

params.name: player
params.description: Player whose matching flag effect is updated.

params.name: code
params.description: Flag-effect code to find.

params.name: label
params.description: New integer label stored on the first matching player flag effect.

returns.description: True if a matching flag effect was updated; false if none exists; nil if player is invalid.

description_zh: 把player身上第一个匹配的标志效果Label设为label，并返回是否找到该效果。
description_en: Sets the first matching player flag effect's label to label and returns whether one was found.

functions.name: Duel.SetFusionMaterial
description_zh: 用g中的卡替换核心当前保存的融合素材组。
融合素材手续的操作函数在选出合法素材组后使用它，使之后的融合召唤操作可以读取所选素材。
本函数只记录选择；不会移动素材，也不返回值。
description_en: Replaces the core's current Fusion Material set with the cards in g.
Fusion Material procedure operations use this after selecting a legal group so the later Fusion Summon operation can read the selected materials.
This function records the selection only; it does not move the materials or return a value.

functions.name: Duel.SetLP
description_zh: 将player的LP设为lp；lp为负数时限制为0，并发送LP更新消息。
description_en: Sets player's LP to lp, clamping negative lp values to 0, and sends the LP update message.

functions.name: Duel.SetOperationInfo

params.name: chainc
params.description: Chain index/count passed to the core chain lookup; scripts commonly use 0 for the current Chain Link.

params.name: category
params.description: CATEGORY_* operation category to record.

params.name: targets
params.description: Known affected cards. Card or Group values are cloned into a read-only Group; nil records only count, player, and param.

params.name: count
params.description: Expected number of affected cards.

params.name: player
params.description: Target player stored in the operation info.

params.name: param
params.description: Category-specific value, commonly a destination location, amount, or other operation parameter.

description_zh: 为chainc对应的连锁记录category的操作信息。
已知受影响卡时传入具体targets和count；未确定对象的非取对象移动效果，可传nil targets并填写预计数量、目标玩家和目标位置。
这些信息会被类似星尘龙的响应检查使用。
description_en: Records operation information for category on chainc.
Use concrete targets and count when the affected cards are known. For unresolved non-targeting movement effects, pass nil targets with the expected count, target player, and target location.
This information is used by response checks such as Stardust Dragon-style effects.
