functions.name: Duel.SetSelectedCard
description_zh: 把核心必须选择列表设置为一张Card，或设置为Group中的全部卡，供之后的选择辅助函数使用。
description_en: Sets the core must-select list to a Card or all cards in a Group for later selection helpers.

functions.name: Duel.SetSynchroMaterial
description_zh: 把g保存为当前召唤手续使用的同调素材组。
description_en: Stores g as the Synchro Material group for the current Summon procedure.

functions.name: Duel.SetTargetCard

params.name: targets
params.description: Card or Group to record as current Chain target cards.

description_zh: 把targets保存为当前处理连锁的对象卡。
对于非永续效果，核心会为这些卡建立连锁关联；若效果带有EFFECT_FLAG_CARD_TARGET，还会发送成为对象的消息。
此函数用于登记广义操作对象；它本身不会检查这些卡是否可以合法成为效果对象。
description_en: Stores targets as the target cards for the currently handled Chain.
For non-continuous effects, the core creates Chain relations for those cards and sends the become-target message when the effect has EFFECT_FLAG_CARD_TARGET.
This records broad operation targets; it does not by itself check whether the cards are legal effect targets.

functions.name: Duel.SetTargetParam

params.name: param
params.description: Integer target parameter stored on the current Chain.
params.description_zh: 保存到当前连锁上的整数对象参数。

description_zh: 把param保存为当前处理连锁的对象参数。
Operation回调通常用Duel.GetChainInfo(0, CHAININFO_TARGET_PARAM)读取它，并常与CHAININFO_TARGET_PLAYER一起使用。
description_en: Stores param as the target parameter for the currently handled Chain.
Operations commonly read it with Duel.GetChainInfo(0, CHAININFO_TARGET_PARAM), often together with CHAININFO_TARGET_PLAYER.

functions.name: Duel.SetTargetPlayer

params.name: player
params.description: Player value stored on the current Chain.
params.description_zh: 保存到当前连锁上的玩家值。

description_zh: 把player保存为当前处理连锁的对象玩家。
Operation回调通常用Duel.GetChainInfo(0, CHAININFO_TARGET_PLAYER)读取它，并常与CHAININFO_TARGET_PARAM一起使用。
description_en: Stores player as the target player for the currently handled Chain.
Operations commonly read it with Duel.GetChainInfo(0, CHAININFO_TARGET_PLAYER), often together with CHAININFO_TARGET_PARAM.

functions.name: Duel.ShuffleDeck
description_zh: 手动洗切玩家player的卡组
注：会重置洗卡检测的状态
description_en: Shuffles player's Deck and resets shuffle-check state.

functions.name: Duel.ShuffleExtra
description_zh: 洗切player的额外卡组。
description_en: Shuffles player's Extra Deck.

functions.name: Duel.ShuffleHand
description_zh: 手动洗切玩家player的手卡
注：会重置洗卡检测的状态
description_en: Shuffles player's hand and resets shuffle-check state.

functions.name: Duel.ShuffleSetCard
description_zh: 洗切覆盖的卡片组 g （实例：魔术礼帽），若g中有表侧表示的卡，则此函数无效
此函数现在可以洗切魔陷区的覆盖卡
description_en: Randomly reorders the Set cards in g, used for effects such as Magical Hats.

functions.name: Duel.SkipPhase

params.name: value
params.description: default: 0

description_zh: 适用一个临时场上效果，使player跳过phase阶段。
phase必须是PHASE_DRAW、PHASE_STANDBY、PHASE_MAIN1、PHASE_BATTLE、PHASE_MAIN2或PHASE_END之一。reset_count小于等于0时按1处理，value会保存在生成的跳过阶段效果上。
description_en: Applies a temporary field effect that makes player skip phase.

The phase must be one of PHASE_DRAW, PHASE_STANDBY, PHASE_MAIN1, PHASE_BATTLE, PHASE_MAIN2, or PHASE_END. reset_count values of 0 or less are treated as 1, and value is stored on the generated skip effect.

functions.name: Duel.SortDecktop
description_zh: 让sort_player重新排列target_player主卡组最上方count张卡。
两名玩家都必须有效，且count至少为1。count大于剩余卡组数量时，处理器只排列实际存在的最上方卡。
description_en: Lets sort_player reorder the top count cards of target_player's Main Deck.
Both players must be valid and count must be at least 1. If count is larger than the remaining Deck size, the processor only sorts the available top cards.

functions.name: Duel.SpecialSummon

params.name: targets
params.description: Card or Group to Special Summon.

params.name: sumtype
params.description: Summon type value recorded for the Summon.

params.name: sumplayer
params.description: Player treated as performing the Special Summon.

params.name: target_player
params.description: Player whose field receives the Summoned cards.

params.name: nocheck
params.description: If true, skips Summoning-condition checks.

params.name: nolimit
params.description: If true, skips revive-limit checks.

params.name: pos
params.description: POS_* position mask for the Summon.

params.name: zone
params.description: Allowed Monster Zone bitmask; default: 0xff.

returns.description: Number of cards successfully Special Summoned.

description_zh: 以pos表示形式把targets特殊召唤到target_player场上，并返回成功特殊召唤的数量。
sumplayer是执行召唤的玩家，sumtype记录召唤类型；nocheck跳过召唤条件检查，nolimit跳过苏生限制检查。
description_en: Special Summons targets to target_player's field in position pos and returns the number of cards successfully Summoned.
sumplayer is the player performing the Summon and sumtype records the Summon type. nocheck skips Summoning-condition checks; nolimit skips revive-limit checks.

functions.name: Duel.SpecialSummonComplete
description_zh: 完成由Duel.SpecialSummonStep开始的特殊召唤处理，触发召唤相关事件，并返回完成的特殊召唤数量。
description_en: Completes a batch of successful Duel.SpecialSummonStep calls, raises the Summon events, and returns the number of completed Summons.

functions.name: Duel.SpecialSummonRule

params.name: sumtype
params.description: default: 0

description_zh: 为player按规则特殊召唤c，可带召唤类型sumtype；核心处于效果伤害步骤处理时不会执行。
description_en: Performs a rule Special Summon of c for player with optional summon type sumtype, unless the core is in effect damage step processing.

functions.name: Duel.SpecialSummonStep

params.name: zone
params.description: default: 0xff

description_zh: 此函数是Duel.SpecialSummon的分解过程，只特殊召唤一张卡c ，其他参数用法和 Duel.SpecialSummon 一样
此函数用于一个效果同时特殊召唤多张参数不同的卡
此函数必须和Duel.SpecialSummonComplete一起使用
返回值表示是否特殊召唤成功
description_en: Special Summons one card as part of a multi-step Summon procedure and returns true if that step succeeds.
Every successful step batch must finish with Duel.SpecialSummonComplete.

functions.name: Duel.SSet

params.name: target_player
params.description: default: player

params.name: confirm
params.description: default: true

description_zh: 让玩家player把targets盖放到target_player的魔法陷阱区， confirm 表示是否需要确认
若targets为Group，则返回成功操作的数量
description_en: Makes player Set targets to target_player's Spell & Trap Zone. If targets is a Group, returns the number of cards successfully Set.

functions.name: Duel.Summon

params.name: min
params.description: default: 0

params.name: zone
params.description: default: 0x1f

description_zh: 让玩家 player 以效果e对c[在区域 zone]进行通常召唤(非set)，至少使用min个祭品
如果e=nil,那么就按照一般的通常召唤规则进行通常召唤
如果ignore_count=true，则忽略每回合的通常召唤次数限制
description_en: Makes player Normal Summon c, not Set it, optionally by effect e and requiring at least min Tributes.
If e is nil, regular Normal Summon rules are used. If ignore_count is true, the once-per-turn Normal Summon limit is ignored.

functions.name: Duel.SwapControl

params.name: reset_phase
params.description: default: 0

params.name: reset_count
params.description: default: 0

description_zh: 交换两张Card或两组Group的控制权，并返回交换处理器是否成功。
reset_phase和reset_count是可选的临时控制权重置设置。
description_en: Swaps control between two Cards or between two Groups and returns whether the swap processor succeeded.
reset_phase and reset_count are optional temporary-control reset settings.

functions.name: Duel.SwapDeckAndGrave
description_zh: 现世与冥界的逆转专用。把玩家player的卡组和墓地交换
description_en: For Exchange of the Spirit-style effects, swaps player's Deck and Graveyard.

functions.name: Duel.SwapSequence
description_zh: 当c1和c2由同一玩家控制、都在怪兽区域且都受当前原因效果影响时，交换它们的怪兽区域序号。
交换成功时，核心会为这两张卡引发移动事件。
description_en: Swaps the Monster Zone sequences of c1 and c2 when both are controlled by the same player, both are affected by the current reason effect, and both are in the Monster Zone.
The core raises move events for the swapped cards when the swap occurs.

functions.name: Duel.SynchroSummon

params.name: minc
params.description: default: 0

params.name: maxc
params.description: default: 0

description_zh: 为player进行c的同调召唤；可以指定必须使用的tuner，并可从mg中选择素材。
minc和maxc可以限制该手续使用的非调整素材数量。
description_en: Performs a Synchro Summon of c for player, optionally requiring tuner and selecting materials from mg.
minc and maxc can restrict the number of non-Tuner materials used by the procedure.

functions.name: Duel.TossCoin

returns.description: First coin result, 0 or 1.
Additional coin results.

description_zh: 为player投掷count枚硬币，并为每次投掷返回1个整数结果。
结果为0或1。通常脚本用法传入正数count且不超过MAX_COIN_COUNT；该绑定拒绝0和小于-1的值，并将过大的正数限制为核心最大值。
description_en: Tosses count coins for player and returns one integer result per toss.
Results are 0 or 1. Normal script use passes a positive count up to MAX_COIN_COUNT; the binding rejects 0 and values below -1, and clamps large positive counts to the core maximum.

functions.name: Duel.TossDice

params.name: count2
params.description: default: 0

returns.description: First die result.
Additional die results.

description_zh: 为player投掷count1个骰子；提供count2时，为对方再投掷count2个骰子。
有效骰子结果为1到6的整数。通常脚本用法应保持count1 + count2不超过5；核心会拒绝count1 <= 0和count2 < 0。
description_en: Tosses count1 dice for player and, when count2 is supplied, count2 dice for the opponent.
Valid dice results are integers from 1 to 6. Normal script use should keep count1 + count2 at 5 or less; the core rejects count1 <= 0 and count2 < 0.

functions.name: Duel.Win
description_zh: 把player设置为因reason获得决斗胜利；如果核心已经记录胜者，则不会覆盖。
description_en: Sets player as the duel winner with reason, but only if no winner has already been set.

functions.name: Duel.XyzSummon
description_zh: 为player和c执行规则超量召唤，可使用可选素材组和min/max限制。
description_en: Performs a rule Xyz Summon for player and c using an optional material group and min/max constraints.

functions.name: Effect.CheckCountLimit

params.name: e
params.description: Effect whose remaining count is checked.
params.description_zh: 要检查剩余次数的效果。

params.name: p
params.description: Player whose local or shared count map is checked.
params.description_zh: 要检查本地或共享次数表的玩家。

returns.description: True if e has no exhausted count limit for p; false when the count is already spent.
returns.description_zh: 如果e对p没有耗尽次数限制则返回true；次数已经用尽时返回false。

description_zh: 检查效果e对玩家p是否仍有可用次数。
通常的发动检查已经会执行核心次数限制检查；此函数主要用于脚本手动检查另一个Effect对象。
description_en: Checks whether e's count limit is still available for player p.
Normal activation checks already use the core count-limit check; this helper is mainly for scripts that manually inspect another Effect object.

functions.name: Effect.Clone
description_zh: 新建一个效果e的副本
description_en: Creates and returns a new Effect object copied from e.

functions.name: Effect.CreateEffect
description_zh: 新建一个空效果，并把效果的Owner设为c。
description_en: Creates a new empty Effect object owned by card c.

functions.name: Effect.GetActivateLocation
description_zh: 返回效果e发动时所在的位置。
description_en: Returns the location from which effect e was activated.

functions.name: Effect.GetActivateSequence
description_zh: 返回效果e发动时所在的位置序号。
description_en: Returns the sequence where e was activated.

functions.name: Effect.GetActiveType
description_zh: 返回e的效果类型（怪兽·魔法·陷阱）
与发动该效果的卡的类型不一定相同，比如灵摆效果视为魔法卡的效果
description_en: Returns the active effect type, such as monster, Spell, or Trap. This can differ from the type of the card that activated the effect, such as Pendulum effects being treated as Spell effects.

functions.name: Effect.GetCategory
description_zh: 返回e的Category位掩码。
description_en: Returns e's category bitmask.

functions.name: Effect.GetCode
description_zh: 返回e的效果编号。
description_en: Returns e's effect code.

functions.name: Effect.GetCondition
description_zh: 返回e的Condition回调；没有设置Condition时返回nil。
description_en: Returns e's condition callback, or nil when no condition is set.

functions.name: Effect.GetCost
description_zh: 返回e的费用函数；未设置费用函数时返回nil。
description_en: Returns e's cost function, or nil when no cost function is set.

functions.name: Effect.GetDescription
description_zh: 返回e的描述编号。
description_en: Returns e's description id.

functions.name: Effect.GetFieldID

params.name: e
params.description: Effect whose internal field ID is returned.

returns.description: Internal effect ID stored in e.

description_zh: 返回效果e的内部field ID。
description_en: Returns e's internal field ID.

functions.name: Effect.GetHandler
description_zh: 返回效果e当前在哪张卡上生效。
description_en: Returns the card currently handling e, usually the card that registered it with Card.RegisterEffect.

functions.name: Effect.GetHandlerPlayer
description_zh: 返回当前玩家，一般是Handler的控制者
description_en: Returns the current controller of e's handler.

functions.name: Effect.GetLabel

returns.description: integer

description_zh: 返回Label属性
description_en: Returns e's stored integer labels. If no label was set, returns 0.

functions.name: Effect.GetLabelObject
description_zh: 返回LabelObject属性
description_en: Returns e's stored label object, or nil if none is stored or the object is no longer valid.

functions.name: Effect.GetOperation
description_zh: 返回e的Operation回调函数；未设置时返回nil。
description_en: Returns e's operation callback, or nil if no operation callback is set.

functions.name: Effect.GetOwner
description_zh: 返回持有e的卡。
description_en: Returns the card that owns e.

functions.name: Effect.GetOwnerPlayer
description_zh: 返回效果e记录的拥有者玩家。
description_en: Returns the player stored as e's owner player.

functions.name: Effect.GetProperty

returns.description: flag1.
flag2.

description_zh: 返回e的两个属性标志字段flag1和flag2。
description_en: Returns e's two property flag fields, flag1 and flag2.

functions.name: Effect.GetRange
description_zh: 返回效果e的Range位掩码。
description_en: Returns e's range bitmask.

functions.name: Effect.GetTarget
description_zh: 返回e的Target回调函数；未设置时返回nil。
description_en: Returns e's target callback, or nil if no target callback is set.

functions.name: Effect.GetType
description_zh: 返回e的效果类型掩码，例如EFFECT_TYPE_SINGLE、EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD或EFFECT_TYPE_TRIGGER_O。
description_en: Returns e's effect type mask, such as EFFECT_TYPE_SINGLE, EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD, or EFFECT_TYPE_TRIGGER_O.

functions.name: Effect.GetValue
description_zh: 返回e的Value字段。函数值效果返回保存的回调函数；否则返回保存的整数值。
description_en: Returns e's value field. For function-valued effects this is the stored callback; otherwise it is the stored integer value.

functions.name: Effect.GlobalEffect
description_zh: 创建一个由决斗临时卡拥有、效果拥有者为玩家0的新效果。
description_en: Creates a new effect owned by the duel temporary card with effect owner player 0.

functions.name: Effect.IsActivatable
description_zh: 检查e当前能否由player发动，并可用可选布尔值忽略位置检查和对象检查。
description_en: Checks whether e can currently be activated by player, with optional booleans to ignore location and target checks.

functions.name: Effect.IsActivated
description_zh: 检查效果e是否具有EFFECT_TYPES_CHAIN_LINK中的类型位。
description_en: Checks whether e has one of the EFFECT_TYPES_CHAIN_LINK type bits.

functions.name: Effect.IsActiveType
description_zh: 检查e的效果类型（怪兽·魔法·陷阱）是否有type
description_en: Checks whether e's active card type contains at least one flag from type.

functions.name: Effect.IsCostChecked
description_zh: 检查效果e是否检查过cost，即是否是被复制的
description_en: Checks whether e's cost has already been checked, which indicates whether it was copied.

functions.name: Effect.IsHasCategory
description_zh: 检查e的category位掩码是否包含cate。
description_en: Checks whether e's category bitmask contains cate.

functions.name: Effect.IsHasProperty

params.name: e
params.description: Effect whose property words are checked.

params.name: prop1
params.description: Mask checked against the first property word. Use 0 to ignore this word.

params.name: prop2
params.description: Mask checked against the second property word. Omitted or 0 means this word passes.

returns.description: True when every nonzero requested property mask is present on e.

description_zh: 检查效果e是否包含指定的效果Property标志。
prop1检查第1个Property字段，可选的prop2检查第2个Property字段；某个字段传0时该字段视为通过。
description_en: Checks whether e contains the requested effect property flags.
prop1 is checked against the first property word and optional prop2 against the second property word. Passing 0 for a word makes that word pass.

functions.name: Effect.IsHasRange
description_zh: 检查效果是否含有区域range
description_en: Checks whether the effect includes range.

functions.name: Effect.IsHasType
description_zh: 检查效果是否属于类型type
description_en: Checks whether e's effect type contains at least one flag from type.

functions.name: Effect.Reset
description_zh: 当e仍附着在有效持有者和处理对象上时，将其从对应卡片或场地效果列表中移除。
description_en: Removes e from its registered card or field effect list when e is still attached to a valid owner and handler.

functions.name: Effect.SetAbsoluteRange
description_zh: 以绝对玩家视角设置效果e的Target Range属性。playerid为1时，s_range和o_range会在核心中交换保存。
description_en: Sets e's target range from an absolute player viewpoint and marks the effect with EFFECT_FLAG_ABSOLUTE_TARGET.
If playerid is 1, the supplied ranges are swapped internally so the stored ranges still line up with player 0/player 1 absolute handling.

functions.name: Effect.SetCategory
description_zh: 设置效果e的Category属性，用于声明效果可能包含的操作类别。
description_en: Sets e's operation category flags, such as CATEGORY_DESTROY, CATEGORY_TOHAND, or CATEGORY_SPECIAL_SUMMON.
Categories describe what the effect may do; known operation details should still be recorded with Duel.SetOperationInfo in the Target callback.

functions.name: Effect.SetCode
description_zh: 设置效果e的Code属性。
description_en: Sets e's code. For triggered effects this is usually an event code; for continuous effects it is the effect code being applied.

functions.name: Effect.SetCondition
description_zh: 设置效果e的Condition函数。
description_en: Sets e's condition callback. The callback decides whether the effect can apply or be activated in the current context.

functions.name: Effect.SetCost

params.name: e
params.description: Effect whose cost callback is replaced.
params.description_zh: 要替换Cost回调的效果。

params.name: cost_func
params.description: Callback usually shaped as cost_func(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp,chk).
params.description_zh: 回调通常写作cost_func(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp,chk)。

description_zh: 设置e的Cost回调。对于发动型效果，该回调用于检查Cost能否支付，并在实际发动时支付Cost。
chk为0时Cost回调只应检查合法性；不可逆的支付动作应放在chk非0的分支。
description_en: Sets e's cost callback. For activated effects, the callback checks whether the cost can be paid and then pays it.
Cost callbacks should only test legality when chk is 0; irreversible payment belongs in the nonzero chk branch.

functions.name: Effect.SetCostCheck
description_zh: 设置效果e的cost检查标记为b
description_en: Sets e's cost-check flag to b.

functions.name: Effect.SetCountLimit

params.name: e
params.description: Effect whose count limit is set.
params.description_zh: 要设置次数限制的效果。

params.name: count
params.description: Maximum uses before the count is spent; 0 is normalized to 1 by the core.
params.description_zh: 次数耗尽前的最大使用次数；核心会将0按1处理。

params.name: code
params.description: Shared count-limit code. Effects with the same nonzero code share usage for the checked player; combine a card id with EFFECT_COUNT_CODE_OATH, EFFECT_COUNT_CODE_DUEL, or EFFECT_COUNT_CODE_SINGLE when that special behavior is needed. Passing exactly EFFECT_COUNT_CODE_CHAIN stores it together with EFFECT_COUNT_CODE_SINGLE in this core.
params.description_zh: 共享次数限制代码。同一个非0代码的效果会对被检查的玩家共用使用次数；需要特殊行为时可将卡号与EFFECT_COUNT_CODE_OATH、EFFECT_COUNT_CODE_DUEL或EFFECT_COUNT_CODE_SINGLE组合。传入的代码正好是EFFECT_COUNT_CODE_CHAIN时，此核心会同时保存EFFECT_COUNT_CODE_SINGLE。

description_zh: 设置效果e在次数限制耗尽前可以使用的次数。
count为0时核心按1处理。共享同一个非0 code的效果会对被检查的玩家共用使用次数。
EFFECT_COUNT_CODE_OATH在发动被无效或手续失败时使用誓约式次数回退；EFFECT_COUNT_CODE_DUEL使用决斗内次数表；EFFECT_COUNT_CODE_SINGLE按处理者实例共享次数；EFFECT_COUNT_CODE_CHAIN使用连锁次数表。
description_en: Sets how many times e can be used before its count limit is spent.
If count is 0, the core treats it as 1. Effects that share a nonzero code share the same usage count for the checked player.

EFFECT_COUNT_CODE_OATH uses oath-style rollback on negated activations and failed procedure attempts; EFFECT_COUNT_CODE_DUEL uses the duel-long count map; EFFECT_COUNT_CODE_SINGLE shares usage by handler instance; EFFECT_COUNT_CODE_CHAIN uses the chain count map.

functions.name: Effect.SetDescription
description_zh: 设置效果e的描述编号。
description_en: Sets e's description id, usually produced with Auxiliary.Stringid for card text choices.

functions.name: Effect.SetHintTiming

params.name: s_time
params.description: Hint timing mask for the handler's controller.
params.description_zh: 处理者控制者侧的提示时机掩码。

params.name: o_time
params.description: Hint timing mask for the opponent. Defaults to s_time.
params.description_zh: 对手侧的提示时机掩码；默认等于s_time。

description_zh: 设置客户端应在何时向处理者的控制者提示或高亮e，也可以单独设置对手侧提示。
该函数只控制提示与显示时机；不能替代Condition、Cost或Target回调中的发动合法性检查。
description_en: Sets when the client should offer or highlight e for the handler's controller and, optionally, the opponent.
This controls prompting and display timing only; it does not replace activation legality checks in the effect's condition, cost, or target callbacks.

functions.name: Effect.SetLabel
description_zh: 设置Label属性
description_en: Stores one or more integer label values on e, replacing any previous labels.

functions.name: Effect.SetLabelObject
description_zh: 设置LabelObject属性
description_en: Stores a Card, Group, Effect, or nil as e's label object.

functions.name: Effect.SetOperation

params.name: e
params.description: Effect whose operation callback is replaced or cleared.
params.description_zh: 要替换或清除Operation回调的效果。

params.name: op_func
params.description: Operation callback, or nil to clear it.
params.description_zh: Operation回调；传nil表示清除。

description_zh: 设置e的Operation回调；传入nil会清除Operation。
对于发动型效果，该回调会在连锁处理到此连锁环时结算，因此应重新检查对象、位置、关联以及发动后可能变化的状态。
description_en: Sets e's operation callback. Passing nil clears the operation.
For activated effects, this callback resolves after the Chain reaches this Link, so it should re-check targets, locations, relation, and other state that may have changed since activation.

functions.name: Effect.SetOwnerPlayer
description_zh: 将效果e的拥有者玩家设为player。
只接受0和1作为player；其他值不会改变该效果。
description_en: Sets e's owner player to player.
Only player values 0 and 1 are accepted; any other value leaves the effect unchanged.

functions.name: Effect.SetProperty

params.name: e
params.description: Effect whose property flags are set.
params.description_zh: 要设置Property标志的效果。

params.name: prop1
params.description: Primary effect property bitmask.
params.description_zh: 主要效果性质位掩码。

params.name: prop2
params.description: Optional second property bitmask for flags stored in the second property word.
params.description_zh: 可选的第二组性质位掩码，用于保存在第二个Property字段中的标志。

description_zh: 设置e的Property标志。prop1保存常规效果性质标志；需要第二组性质标志时使用prop2。
替换prop1时会保留内部标志。
学习时常见的标志包括：EFFECT_FLAG_CARD_TARGET用于正式取对象，EFFECT_FLAG_DAMAGE_STEP与EFFECT_FLAG_DAMAGE_CAL用于伤害步骤时点，EFFECT_FLAG_PLAYER_TARGET用于影响玩家的效果。
description_en: Sets e's property flags. prop1 holds the normal effect property flags; prop2 is used for the second property word when needed.
Internal flags are preserved when prop1 is replaced.

Learner-facing flags include EFFECT_FLAG_CARD_TARGET for official targets, EFFECT_FLAG_DAMAGE_STEP and EFFECT_FLAG_DAMAGE_CAL for Damage Step timing, and EFFECT_FLAG_PLAYER_TARGET for effects that apply to players.

functions.name: Effect.SetRange
description_zh: 设置效果e的生效或可发动位置。
description_en: Sets the location range where e applies or can be activated.

functions.name: Effect.SetReset
description_zh: 设置效果e的reset参数和可选的reset次数。
description_en: Sets when e resets and how many reset checks it can survive.
If reset_count is 0 or omitted, the core stores 1. When a phase reset is used without an explicit turn side, the core applies both RESET_SELF_TURN and RESET_OPPO_TURN.

functions.name: Effect.SetTarget

params.name: e
params.description: Effect whose target callback is replaced.

params.name: targ_func
params.description: Callback function stored on e.

description_zh: 设置e的Target回调。对于发动型效果，该回调用于检查发动合法性，并登记对象或操作信息。
Target回调通常在chk==0分支只回答是否合法；实际发动分支再用Duel.SelectTarget选择正式对象、用Duel.SetTargetCard登记广义对象，或用Duel.SetOperationInfo声明操作信息。
description_en: Sets e's target callback. For activated effects, this callback performs activation legality checks and records target or operation information.

Target callbacks normally use chk==0 only to answer legality, then use the real activation branch to select official targets with Duel.SelectTarget, record broad targets with Duel.SetTargetCard, or announce operation details with Duel.SetOperationInfo.

functions.name: Effect.SetTargetRange
description_zh: 设置效果e的Target Range属性。
description_en: Sets e's target range fields and clears EFFECT_FLAG_ABSOLUTE_TARGET.

For most field effects, s_range is the affected locations on the handler's controller's side and o_range is the affected locations on the opponent's side. With EFFECT_FLAG_SPSUM_PARAM, they store Special Summon destination player and position.

functions.name: Effect.SetType
description_zh: 设置效果e的Type属性。
description_en: Sets e's effect type flags.
The core normalizes some type combinations: Spell/Trap activation effects become field activation effects, Flip Effects receive EVENT_FLIP handling, and ignition/Quick Effects gain field behavior.

functions.name: Effect.SetValue
description_zh: 设置效果e的Value属性。
description_en: Sets e's value field. The value can be a number, boolean, or callback function depending on the effect code.

functions.name: Effect.UseCountLimit

params.name: e
params.description: Effect whose count is manually consumed.
params.description_zh: 要手动消耗次数的效果。

params.name: p
params.description: Player whose local or shared count is consumed.
params.description_zh: 要消耗本地或共享次数的玩家。

params.name: count
params.description: Number of uses to consume; default: 1.
params.description_zh: 要消耗的使用次数；默认值为1。

params.name: oath_only
params.description: If true, consume only when e's count code includes EFFECT_COUNT_CODE_OATH; default: false.
params.description_zh: 若为true，则仅在e的次数代码包含EFFECT_COUNT_CODE_OATH时消耗次数；默认值为false。

description_zh: 手动消耗玩家p对效果e的count次次数限制。
count默认1。oath_only为true时，只有e的次数代码包含EFFECT_COUNT_CODE_OATH才会消耗次数；否则该绑定会直接减少次数限制。
description_en: Manually consumes count uses of e's count limit for player p.
count defaults to 1. If oath_only is true, the count is consumed only when e's count code includes EFFECT_COUNT_CODE_OATH; otherwise the binding decrements the count limit directly.

functions.name: Group.__add

returns.description: A new group containing cards from both operands.

description_zh: 返回包含两个操作数中卡的新Group；每个操作数都可以是Card或Group。
description_en: Returns a new Group containing cards from both operands, where each operand may be a Card or Group.

functions.name: Group.__band

returns.description: A new group containing cards present in both operands.

description_zh: 返回同时存在于两个操作数中的卡组成的新Group。
description_en: Returns a new Group containing cards present in both operands.

functions.name: Group.__bor

returns.description: A new group containing cards from both operands.

description_zh: 返回包含两个操作数中卡的新Group；它与Group.__add使用同一个核心处理。
description_en: Returns a new Group containing cards from both operands; this uses the same core handler as Group.__add.

functions.name: Group.__bxor

returns.description: A new group containing cards present in exactly one operand.

description_zh: 返回只存在于其中一个操作数中的卡组成的新Group。
description_en: Returns a new Group containing cards present in exactly one operand.

functions.name: Group.__len

returns.description: The number of cards in g.

description_zh: 返回g中的卡片数量。
description_en: Returns the number of cards in g.

functions.name: Group.__sub

returns.description: A new group with cards from left that are not in right.

description_zh: 返回左操作数中有、右操作数中没有的卡组成的新Group。
description_en: Returns a new Group containing cards from the left operand that are not in the right operand.

functions.name: Group.AddCard
description_zh: 若g可修改，则把c加入g。
description_en: Adds c to g if g is mutable.

functions.name: Group.CancelableSelect
description_zh: 让玩家player从g中选择min-max张不等于ex的卡，可以取消并返回nil
description_en: Lets player select min to max cards from g, excluding ex; the selection can be canceled and return nil.

functions.name: Group.CheckWithSumEqual
description_zh: 检查g的某个子集（包括所有必须选择的卡）能否用min到max张卡使f的合计正好等于acc。
description_en: Checks whether a subset of g, including any must-select cards, can make the f-sum exactly acc using between min and max cards.

functions.name: Group.CheckWithSumGreater
description_zh: 检查g是否能满足f的合计值至少为acc。
先前用Duel.SetSelectedCard设置的卡会强制计入合计，且必须选择列表会在返回前清空。
description_en: Checks whether g can satisfy an f-sum of at least acc.
Cards previously set with Duel.SetSelectedCard are forced into the sum and the must-select list is cleared before returning.

functions.name: Group.Clear
description_zh: 清空g；若g为只读Group则不会清空。
description_en: Clears g unless it is a read-only group.

functions.name: Group.Clone
description_zh: 新建卡片组g的副本
description_en: Creates and returns a new Group containing the same cards as g.

functions.name: Group.CreateGroup
description_zh: 新建并返回一个空Group。
description_en: Creates and returns a new empty Group.

functions.name: Group.DeleteGroup
description_zh: 释放之前通过Group.KeepAlive保留的Group，使其重新交由Lua正常管理。
对普通Group调用此函数没有效果。
description_en: Releases a Group previously preserved with Group.KeepAlive so Lua can manage it normally again.
Calling this on an ordinary Group has no effect.

functions.name: Group.Equal
description_zh: 检查g1和g2是否以相同内部顺序包含完全相同的卡。
description_en: Checks whether g1 and g2 contain exactly the same cards in the same internal order.

functions.name: Group.Filter

params.name: g
params.description: Group to filter; it is not modified.

params.name: f
params.description: Filter callback called for each candidate card.

params.name: ex
params.description: Card or Group excluded before filtering; nil excludes nothing.
Extra values forwarded to f after the candidate Card.

returns.description: New Group containing cards that passed f.

description_zh: 返回由g中满足筛选函数f且不在ex中的卡组成的新Group。
ex之后的额外参数会在Card参数之后传给f。
description_en: Returns a new Group containing cards from g that satisfy filter f and are not excluded by ex.
Extra arguments after ex are passed to f after the card argument.

functions.name: Group.FilterCount
description_zh: 统计g中满足f且不在ex中的卡数量。
ex之后的额外参数会传给f。
description_en: Counts cards in g that satisfy f, excluding ex.
Extra arguments after ex are passed to f after the Card argument.

functions.name: Group.FilterSelect
description_zh: 让player从g中选择min到max张满足筛选函数f且不在ex中的卡，并返回选中的Group。
ex之后的额外参数会在Card参数之后传给f。
description_en: Lets player choose min to max cards from g that satisfy filter f, excluding ex, and returns the selected Group.
Extra arguments after ex are passed to f after the Card argument.

functions.name: Group.FromCards
description_zh: 创建并返回包含所有非nil Card参数的新Group。
description_en: Creates and returns a new Group containing the non-nil Card arguments.

functions.name: Group.GetBinClassCount
description_zh: 对g中的每张卡调用f，把返回的整数值按位或合并，然后返回结果中置位的数量。
description_en: Calls f for each card in g, ORs the returned integer values together, and returns the number of set bits in the result.

functions.name: Group.GetClassCount
description_zh: 计算g中所有卡的种类数量，f为分类的依据，返回相同的值视为同一种类，从第3个参数开始为额外参数
比如 g:GetClassCount(Card.GetCode()) 就是计算g中卡名不同的卡的数量
description_en: Counts distinct classes among cards in g according to f. Cards with the same return value from f count as the same class; extra arguments are passed to f.

functions.name: Group.GetCount
description_zh: 返回g中的卡片数量。
description_en: Returns the number of cards in g.

functions.name: Group.GetFirst
description_zh: 返回g中的第一张卡，并把g的迭代指针重置到第一张卡。
description_en: Returns the first card in g and resets g's internal iterator to that card. Returns nil when g is empty.

functions.name: Group.GetMaxGroup

returns.description: Cards tied for maximum value.
Maximum value.

description_zh: 对g中的每张卡调用f，转发额外参数，并返回所有最大值并列卡组成的Group。
第二个返回值是最大整数值。g为空时，该绑定不返回Lua值。
description_en: Calls f for each card in g, forwards any extra arguments, and returns a Group containing every card tied for the maximum value.
The second return is the maximum integer value. If g is empty, this binding returns no Lua values.

functions.name: Group.GetMinGroup

returns.description: Cards tied for the minimum value.
Minimum value.

description_zh: 对g中的每张卡调用f，转发额外参数，并返回所有最小值并列卡组成的Group。
第二个返回值是最小整数值。g为空时，该绑定不返回Lua值。
description_en: Calls f for each card in g, forwards any extra arguments, and returns a Group containing every card tied for the minimum value.
The second return is the minimum integer value. If g is empty, this binding returns no Lua values.

functions.name: Group.GetNext
description_zh: 把g的迭代指针移动到下一张卡并返回该卡。
description_en: Advances g's internal iterator and returns the next card, or nil when there are no more cards.

functions.name: Group.GetSum
description_zh: 对g中的每张卡调用f，转发额外参数，并返回各次整数结果的总和。
description_en: Calls f for each card in g, forwards any extra arguments, and returns the sum of the integer values produced.

functions.name: Group.IsContains
description_zh: 检查g中是否存在卡片c
description_en: Checks whether g contains card c.

functions.name: Group.IsExists
description_zh: 检查g中是否存在至少count张满足f且不等于ex的卡。
description_en: Checks whether at least count cards in g satisfy filter f and are not excluded by ex.
Extra arguments after ex are passed to f after the card argument.

functions.name: Group.KeepAlive
description_zh: 阻止g被Lua自动释放，直到调用Group.DeleteGroup。
description_en: Prevents g from being automatically released by Lua until Group.DeleteGroup is called.

functions.name: Group.Merge
description_zh: 把g2中的所有卡合并到g1，若g1中原本就有属于g2的卡，那些卡将不会重复
注：g2本身不会发生变化
description_en: Adds every card from g2 into g1. g2 itself is not changed.

functions.name: Group.RandomSelect
description_zh: 返回一个新Group，包含从g中随机选出的count张卡。
count会被限制为g的数量。player参数会写入随机选择消息，但不影响随机结果。
description_en: Returns a new Group containing count randomly chosen cards from g.
count is clamped to g's size. The player argument is written to the random-selection message but does not influence the random choice.

functions.name: Group.Remove
description_zh: 从可修改的Group g中移除满足f且不等于ex的卡，并把额外参数传给f。
description_en: Removes cards from mutable group g that satisfy f and are not ex, passing any extra arguments to f.

functions.name: Group.RemoveCard
description_zh: 从g中移除c。除非g为只读Group，否则会直接修改g；不返回Lua值。
description_en: Removes c from g. The function mutates g unless g is read-only and returns no Lua value.

functions.name: Group.SearchCard
description_zh: 返回g中第一张满足f和额外参数的卡；没有则返回nil。
description_en: Returns the first card in g that satisfies f with any extra arguments, or nil if none does.

functions.name: Group.Select

params.name: g
params.description: Selectable card pool.

params.name: player
params.description: Player who makes the selection; invalid players make the core return no values.

params.name: min
params.description: Minimum number of cards to select.

params.name: max
params.description: Maximum number of cards to select.

params.name: ex
params.description: Card or Group excluded from selectable cards; nil excludes nothing.

returns.description: New Group containing selected cards, or nil if player is invalid.

description_zh: 让player从g中选择min到max张卡，可选排除ex，并返回选中的Group。
description_en: Lets player choose min to max cards from g, optionally excluding ex, and returns the selected Group.

functions.name: Group.SelectUnselect

params.name: finishable
params.description: default: false

params.name: cancelable
params.description: default: false

params.name: min
params.description: default: 1

params.name: max
params.description: default: 1

returns.description: Chosen card, or nil if the selection is canceled.

description_zh: 让player从cg中选择1张卡加入当前选择，或从sg中选择1张卡移出当前选择，并返回被选择的那张卡。
sg可以为nil。finishable控制当前数量下能否结束选择，cancelable允许取消；取消时返回nil。min和max默认均为1。
description_en: Lets player choose one card from cg to add to the current selection or one card from sg to remove from it, then returns the card that was chosen.
sg may be nil. finishable controls whether the selection can finish at its current size, cancelable allows cancellation, and cancellation returns nil. min and max default to 1.

functions.name: Group.SelectWithSumEqual

returns.description: Selected optional cards, or nil for invalid player.

description_zh: 让player从g中选择若干卡，使f的合计值等于acc，选择数量在min到max之间。
先前用Duel.SetSelectedCard设置的卡会强制计入合计、从可选池移除、处理后清空，且不会包含在返回的Group中。
description_en: Lets player select cards from g whose f-sum equals acc using between min and max cards.
Cards previously set with Duel.SetSelectedCard are forced into the sum, removed from the selectable pool, cleared afterward, and are not included in the returned Group.

functions.name: Group.SelectWithSumGreater
description_zh: 让player从g中选择一个子集，使f的取值合计按核心的精确大于等于规则达到sum；没有合法子集时返回空Group。
description_en: Lets player select a subset of g whose f-value sum reaches or exceeds sum according to the core's exact greater-sum selection rule; returns an empty Group if no valid subset exists.

functions.name: Group.Sub
description_zh: 从g1中移除g2包含的每张卡。除非g1只读，否则会直接修改g1；g2不会改变。
description_en: Removes every card in g2 from g1. g1 is mutated unless it is read-only; g2 is not changed.

functions.name: Card.branded_fusion_check
description_zh: 素材检查（烙印融合）
description_en: Material check for Branded Fusion.

functions.name: Card.cyber_fusion_check
description_zh: 素材检查（电子负载融合）
description_en: Material check for Cyberload Fusion.

functions.name: Card.destruction_swordsman_fusion_check
description_zh: 素材检查（破坏剑士融合）
description_en: Material check for Destruction Swordsman Fusion.

functions.name: Card.hero_fusion_check
description_zh: 素材检查（至爱接触）
description_en: Material check for Favorite Contact.

functions.name: Card.mat_filter
description_zh: 仪式怪兽的解放过滤条件
description_en: Release filter condition for Ritual Monsters.

functions.name: Card.mat_group_check
description_zh: 仪式怪兽的解放过滤条件
description_en: Release group check condition for Ritual Monsters.

functions.name: Card.red_eyes_fusion_check
description_zh: 素材检查（真红眼融合）
description_en: Material check for Red-Eyes Fusion.

functions.name: Card.synchro_fusion_check
description_zh: 素材检查（奇迹同调融合）
description_en: Material check for Miracle Synchro Fusion.

functions.name: Card.ultimate_fusion_check
description_zh: 素材检查（究极融合）
description_en: Material check for Ultimate Fusion.

functions.name: Card.zw_equip_monster
description_zh: 当作装备卡装备（异热同心武器）
description_en: Equips this card as an Equip Card for ZW - monsters.

functions.name: Group.ForEach
description_zh: 工具存根：对g中的每张卡以任意额外参数调用一次f。
description_en: Utility stub for calling f once for each card in g with any extra arguments.

functions.name: Auxiliary.AddBanishRedirect

params.name: condition
params.description: default: face-up condition

description_zh: 登记EFFECT_LEAVE_FIELD_REDIRECT效果，使condition为真时离场的c改为除外；默认条件为c表侧表示。
description_en: Registers an EFFECT_LEAVE_FIELD_REDIRECT effect that banishes c when condition is true, defaulting to face-up c.

functions.name: Auxiliary.AddCodeList
description_zh: 为c登记1个或多个卡名编号，供Auxiliary.IsCodeListed等函数判断这些编号是否被c列名。复制效果时不处理。
description_en: Registers one or more card codes as codes listed by c, so later checks such as Auxiliary.IsCodeListed can find them. Skipped while c is copying an effect.

functions.name: Auxiliary.AddDrytronSpSummonEffect
description_zh: 为c添加「龙辉巧」共通的从手牌或墓地特殊召唤自身的起动效果。
该效果使用共通的解放费用、目标、操作包装函数以及特殊召唤限制计数器。
description_en: Adds the shared Drytron ignition effect that Special Summons c from the hand or Graveyard.
The effect uses the common Drytron release cost, target, operation wrapper, and custom activity counter.

functions.name: Auxiliary.AddEquipSpellEffect

params.name: pause
params.description: default: false

params.name: skip_target
params.description: default: false

returns.description: Created activation effect.

description_zh: 为c创建装备魔法发动效果，并登记对应的EFFECT_EQUIP_LIMIT。
返回创建的发动效果；pause为true时只创建该效果，不立即登记到c上。
description_en: Creates an Equip Spell activation effect for c and registers the matching EFFECT_EQUIP_LIMIT.
The activation effect is returned; when pause is true it is created but not registered on c.

functions.name: Auxiliary.AddMaterialCodeList
description_zh: 为c登记1个或多个素材卡名编号，并同时把这些编号加入c的列名编号表。
融合怪兽通常不需要使用此辅助函数。
description_en: Registers one or more material card codes for c and also adds each code to c's listed-code table.
Fusion Monsters normally do not need this helper.

functions.name: Auxiliary.AddSetNameMonsterList
description_zh: 为c登记其文本中列名的怪兽系列编号，供Auxiliary.IsSetNameMonsterListed等函数之后判断。复制效果时不处理。
description_en: Registers set codes of monsters listed by c, so Auxiliary.IsSetNameMonsterListed can check them later. Skipped while c is copying an effect.

functions.name: Auxiliary.AddThisCardInGraveAlreadyCheck
description_zh: 为c登记一个持续效果，用于记录把c送去墓地的效果。
这样后续的墓地条件可以区分此卡原本就在墓地，还是被当前正在处理的效果送去墓地。
description_en: Registers a continuous effect on c that records the effect that sent c to the Graveyard.
This lets later Graveyard-condition checks distinguish a card that was already in the Graveyard from one sent there by the currently resolving effect.

functions.name: Auxiliary.AddUrsarcticSpSummonEffect
description_zh: 为c添加「北极天熊」共通的手牌快速效果，在主要阶段特殊召唤自身。
费用为解放手牌中1只7星以上怪兽，或从墓地除外可代替费用的对应卡。
description_en: Adds the shared Ursarctic hand Quick Effect that Special Summons c during the Main Phase.
The cost releases a Level 7 or higher monster from the hand, or banishes a valid replacement card from the Graveyard.

functions.name: Auxiliary.AdjacentFilter
description_zh: 检查c的全局场地坐标是否与(i, j)直接相邻；只计算上下左右，不计算斜向。
description_en: Returns whether c's global field coordinate is directly adjacent to (i, j), sharing an edge rather than a diagonal.

functions.name: Auxiliary.AND
description_zh: 返回组合条件函数；调用时会用相同参数依次执行传入的函数，并在第一个假值处停止。
description_en: Returns a composed predicate that calls each function with the same arguments and stops at the first falsy result.

functions.name: Auxiliary.ArcanaCoinOperation
description_zh: 处理「秘仪之力」共通的投掷硬币操作。
通常投掷1次硬币；若受对应替代效果影响，则让玩家选择结果，然后把结果以标记和客户端提示记录在c上。
description_en: Performs the shared Arcana Force coin-toss operation.
It tosses a coin, or lets the player choose the result while affected by the relevant replacement effect, then stores the result on c with client hints.

functions.name: Auxiliary.ArcanaCoinTarget
description_zh: 声明「秘仪之力」共通效果会为tp进行1次投掷硬币。
description_en: Declares that the shared Arcana Force effect will perform one coin toss for tp.

functions.name: Auxiliary.ArcanaCondition
description_zh: 「秘仪之力」条件辅助函数，检查处理对象是否保存有秘仪硬币结果标志。
description_en: Arcana Force condition helper that checks whether the handler has a stored Arcana coin-result flag.

functions.name: Auxiliary.AtkEqualsDef
description_zh: 判断c是否为攻击力和守备力相同的非连接怪兽；在场上使用当前数值，其他位置要求原本数值可确认。
description_en: Returns true for a non-Link Monster whose ATK equals DEF, using current values on the field or known printed values elsewhere.

functions.name: Auxiliary.BanishRedirectCondition
description_zh: 除外重定向效果的默认条件；处理对象表侧表示时返回true。
description_en: Default condition for banish-redirect effects; returns true while the handler is face-up.

functions.name: Auxiliary.bdcon
description_zh: 战斗破坏条件辅助函数：处理对象仍与战斗相关时返回true。
description_en: Battle-destroying condition helper that returns true while the handler is still related to battle.

functions.name: Auxiliary.bdgcon
description_zh: 战斗破坏条件辅助函数：处理对象的战斗对象是墓地中的怪兽时返回true。
description_en: Battle-destroying condition helper for a handler whose battle target is a monster in the Graveyard.

functions.name: Auxiliary.bdocon
description_zh: EVENT_BATTLE_DESTROYING效果常用的条件辅助函数；处理者仍与战斗关联并且和对方怪兽战斗时返回true。
description_en: Condition helper for EVENT_BATTLE_DESTROYING effects; it returns true when the handler is still related to battle and battled an opponent's monster.

functions.name: Auxiliary.bdogcon
description_zh: 战斗破坏用条件辅助函数：处理对象仍与战斗相关，和对方怪兽进行过战斗，且该战斗对象是墓地中的怪兽。
description_en: Condition helper for a battle-destroying monster: the handler is still related to battle, battled an opponent's monster, and that battle target is a monster in the GY.

functions.name: Auxiliary.BecomeOriginalCode

params.name: reset
params.description: defult: RESET_EVENT+RESETS_STANDARD+RESET_PHASE+PHASE_END

description_zh: 给c登记EFFECT_CHANGE_CODE效果，使其卡号变为tc按规则使用的原本卡号直到reset；reset默认持续到结束阶段并使用标准事件重置。
description_en: Registers an EFFECT_CHANGE_CODE effect on c so its code becomes tc's original rule code until reset; reset defaults to standard event reset through the End Phase.

functions.name: Auxiliary.BeginPuzzle
description_zh: 设置解谜决斗处理：跳过玩家0的抽卡阶段和准备阶段，并在结束阶段让玩家0失败。
description_en: Sets up puzzle-duel handling by skipping player 0's Draw and Standby Phases and making player 0 lose at the End Phase.

functions.name: Auxiliary.BESRemoveCondition
description_zh: B.E.S.共通战斗后维持效果的条件；处理对象仍与该次战斗关联时返回true。
description_en: Condition for the shared B.E.S. maintenance effect after battle; returns true if the handler is still related to that battle.

functions.name: Auxiliary.BESRemoveOperation
description_zh: 处理B.E.S.共通战斗后维持效果：能取除1个0x1f指示物则取除，否则破坏自身。
description_en: Resolves the shared B.E.S. maintenance effect by removing one 0x1f counter from the handler, or destroying it if no counter can be removed.

functions.name: Auxiliary.BESRemoveTarget
description_zh: B.E.S.共通战斗后维持效果的目标处理；若不能取除1个0x1f指示物，则登记破坏自身的信息。
description_en: Sets destruction operation info for the shared B.E.S. maintenance effect when the handler cannot remove one 0x1f counter.

functions.name: Auxiliary.bfgcost
description_en: Shared cost function that checks whether the handler can be banished as cost, then banishes it face-up as REASON_COST.

functions.name: Auxiliary.bpcon
description_zh: 判断玩家是否可以进入战斗阶段，或当前阶段是否已经处于战斗阶段范围内。
description_en: Returns true if the player can enter the Battle Phase, or if the current phase is already within the Battle Phase window.

functions.name: Auxiliary.chainreg
description_zh: 若效果e的处理者还没有FLAG_ID_CHAINING，则给其登记该标记效果。
该标记按标准事件重置，但不因回合盖放重置，并会在连锁结束时重置。
description_en: Registers FLAG_ID_CHAINING on e's handler if that flag is not already present.
The flag resets by the standard event reset, except turn Set reset, and also at the end of the Chain.

functions.name: Auxiliary.ChangeBattleDamage
description_zh: 返回用于EFFECT_CHANGE_BATTLE_DAMAGE的Value函数。player=0时改写效果持有者受到的战斗伤害，player=1时改写对方受到的战斗伤害；其他情况返回-1表示不改写。
description_en: Returns a value function for EFFECT_CHANGE_BATTLE_DAMAGE. player=0 changes damage taken by the effect owner, player=1 changes damage taken by the opponent; otherwise it returns -1 to keep the damage unchanged.

functions.name: Auxiliary.CheckGroupRecursive
description_zh: Group.CheckSubGroup使用的内部递归辅助函数；尝试把c加入sg，遵守Auxiliary.GCheckAdditional，并寻找数量在min到max之间且满足f的子组。
description_en: Internal recursive helper for Group.CheckSubGroup. It tries adding c to sg, respects Auxiliary.GCheckAdditional, and searches for a subgroup between min and max that satisfies f.

functions.name: Auxiliary.CheckGroupRecursiveCapture
description_zh: Group.SelectSubGroup使用的内部递归辅助函数；按Auxiliary.CheckGroupRecursive的方式搜索，并把找到的一个有效子组保存到Auxiliary.SubGroupCaptured。
description_en: Internal recursive helper for Group.SelectSubGroup. It searches like Auxiliary.CheckGroupRecursive and stores one valid subgroup in Auxiliary.SubGroupCaptured.

functions.name: Auxiliary.CheckGroupRecursiveEach
description_zh: Group.CheckSubGroupEach和Group.SelectSubGroupEach使用的内部递归辅助函数；每张被选卡必须满足checks中对应位置的筛选函数，最终组再交给f检查。
description_en: Internal recursive helper for Group.CheckSubGroupEach and Group.SelectSubGroupEach. Each selected card must satisfy the filter at the matching position in checks before the final group is tested by f.

functions.name: Auxiliary.CheckUnionEquip
description_zh: 检查同盟怪兽uc与对象tc之间的同盟装备数量兼容性，可选择忽略部分新式同盟数量。
description_en: Checks Union equip count compatibility between Union Monster uc and target tc, optionally ignoring some modern Union count.

functions.name: Auxiliary.CreateChecks
description_zh: 返回一组单卡检查函数；每个函数调用f(c, list[i])。
description_en: Returns a table of one-card check functions where each function calls f(c, list[i]).

functions.name: Auxiliary.CreateMaterialReasonCardRelation
description_zh: 为c登记EVENT_BE_MATERIAL持续效果；当c作为素材使用时，让召唤出的怪兽与te建立效果关联。
description_en: Registers an EVENT_BE_MATERIAL continuous effect on c so that, when c is used as material, the Summoned monster creates an effect relation with te.

functions.name: Auxiliary.dabcheck
description_zh: 判断g中的每张卡是否具有不同属性。
description_en: Returns true if every card in g has a different Attribute.

functions.name: Auxiliary.damcon1
description_zh: 用于判断玩家tp是否会受到效果伤害的条件辅助函数。
它检查操作信息中对tp造成的伤害，或被反转成伤害的对tp恢复，并会考虑EFFECT_REVERSE_DAMAGE、EFFECT_REVERSE_RECOVER和EFFECT_NO_EFFECT_DAMAGE。
description_en: Condition helper for effects that would make player tp take effect damage.
It checks the operation info for damage to tp, or recovery to tp that is reversed into damage, and respects EFFECT_REVERSE_DAMAGE, EFFECT_REVERSE_RECOVER, and EFFECT_NO_EFFECT_DAMAGE.

functions.name: Auxiliary.DimensionalFissureTarget
description_zh: 「次元裂缝」类替代效果使用的目标筛选；匹配原本种类包含怪兽的卡，但排除超量素材以及当前作为魔法/陷阱处理的卡。
description_en: Target filter for Dimensional Fissure-style replacement effects. It matches cards whose original type includes Monster, excluding Xyz Materials and cards currently treated as Spell/Trap Cards.

functions.name: Auxiliary.dlkcheck
description_zh: 判断g中的每张卡是否具有不同连接数值。
description_en: Returns true if every card in g has a different Link Rating.

functions.name: Auxiliary.dlvcheck
description_zh: 判断g中的每张卡是否具有不同等级。
description_en: Returns true if every card in g has a different Level.

functions.name: Auxiliary.dncheck
description_zh: 判断g中的每张卡是否具有不同卡名编号。
description_en: Returns true if every card in g has a different card code.

functions.name: Auxiliary.dogcon
description_zh: EVENT_TO_GRAVE条件辅助函数，检查处理对象先前由tp控制且被对方破坏。
description_en: EVENT_TO_GRAVE condition helper that checks whether the handler was previously controlled by tp and destroyed by the opponent.

functions.name: Auxiliary.dogfcon
description_zh: EVENT_TO_GRAVE触发条件：处理对象之前在tp场上，被破坏，且原因玩家是对方时返回true。
description_en: Condition for EVENT_TO_GRAVE triggers: true when the handler was previously on the field under tp's control, was destroyed, and the opponent was the reason player.

functions.name: Auxiliary.DragonXyzSpSummonType
description_zh: 仅在c是「魂吸收龙」时返回true，用作特殊召唤手续类型辅助函数。
description_en: Returns true only for Soul Drain Dragon, used as a Special Summon procedure-type helper.

functions.name: Auxiliary.drccheck
description_zh: 判断g中的每张卡是否具有不同种族。
description_en: Returns true if every card in g has a different Race.

functions.name: Auxiliary.drkcheck
description_zh: 判断g中的每张卡是否具有不同阶级。
description_en: Returns true if every card in g has a different Rank.

functions.name: Auxiliary.DrytronCostFilter
description_zh: 「龙辉巧」共通特殊召唤效果的费用筛选；匹配可以从手牌或场上解放、且解放后会给tp留下可用怪兽区域的「龙辉巧」怪兽或仪式怪兽。
description_en: Cost filter for the shared Drytron Special Summon effect. It accepts Drytron monsters and Ritual Monsters that can be Tributed from the hand or field while leaving tp an open Monster Zone.

functions.name: Auxiliary.DrytronCounterFilter
description_zh: 「龙辉巧」共通特殊召唤效果的活动计数筛选；对不能通常召唤/盖放的卡返回true，从而让计数器判断tp本回合是否特殊召唤过可以通常召唤/盖放的怪兽。
description_en: Activity-counter filter for the shared Drytron Special Summon effect. It returns true for cards that cannot be Normal Summoned/Set, so the counter can detect whether tp Special Summoned a monster that can be Normal Summoned/Set this turn.

functions.name: Auxiliary.DrytronExtraCostFilter
description_zh: 判断c是否可以由tp通过编号89771220的效果作为代替费用从墓地除外。
description_en: Checks whether c can be banished by tp as a replacement cost through effect code 89771220.

functions.name: Auxiliary.DrytronSpSummonCost
description_zh: 检查并支付「龙辉巧」共通的自身特殊召唤费用。
玩家本回合不能已经特殊召唤过可以通常召唤/盖放的怪兽。支付时登记对应的特殊召唤誓约，然后解放1张可用费用卡，或除外1张可用的代替费用卡。
description_en: Checks and pays the shared Drytron self-Summon cost.

The player must not have Special Summoned a monster that can be Normal Summoned/Set this turn. On payment, it applies the matching Special Summon oath, then either Tributes one valid cost card or banishes one valid replacement-cost card.

functions.name: Auxiliary.DrytronSpSummonLimit
description_zh: 「龙辉巧」共通费用登记的誓约目标；阻止特殊召唤可以通常召唤/盖放的怪兽，但排除原本种类为魔法/陷阱或陷阱怪兽的卡。
description_en: Oath target for the shared Drytron cost; it prevents Special Summoning monsters that can be Normal Summoned/Set, excluding cards whose original type is Spell/Trap or Trap Monster.

functions.name: Auxiliary.DrytronSpSummonOperation
description_zh: 返回「龙辉巧」共通的操作包装函数；将处理对象守备表示特殊召唤，完成正规手续，然后调用func(e,tp)。
description_en: Returns the shared Drytron operation wrapper. It Special Summons the handler in face-up Defense Position, completes its procedure, then calls func(e,tp).

functions.name: Auxiliary.DrytronSpSummonTarget
description_zh: 「龙辉巧」共通自身特殊召唤效果的目标处理；检查怪兽区域需求，确认处理对象能以表侧守备表示特殊召唤，并登记特殊召唤信息。
description_en: Target function for the shared Drytron self-Summon effect. It checks the Monster Zone requirement, confirms the handler can be Special Summoned in face-up Defense Position, and sets Special Summon operation info.

functions.name: Auxiliary.DrytronSpSummonType
description_zh: 检查c是否是特殊召唤手续怪兽，供「龙辉巧」特殊召唤辅助函数使用。
description_en: Returns whether c is a Special Summon procedure monster, used by Drytron Special Summon helpers.

functions.name: Auxiliary.dscon
description_zh: 改变攻击力/守备力的快速效果条件；不在伤害阶段时为true，或在伤害阶段且尚未进行伤害计算时为true。
description_en: Condition for Quick Effects that change ATK/DEF; true outside the Damage Phase, or during the Damage Phase before damage calculation has been performed.

functions.name: Auxiliary.dsercon
description_zh: EVENT_DAMAGE_STEP_END效果的条件；处理对象仍与战斗关联，或已被战斗破坏时返回true。
description_en: Condition for EVENT_DAMAGE_STEP_END effects; true if the handler is still related to battle or was battle destroyed.

functions.name: Auxiliary.EffectCategoryFilter
description_zh: 返回谓词函数，用于判断Effect是否包含category类别。
description_en: Returns a predicate that checks whether an Effect has category.

functions.name: Auxiliary.EffectPropertyFilter
description_zh: 返回谓词函数，用于判断Effect是否包含flag属性。
description_en: Returns a predicate that checks whether an Effect has property flag.

functions.name: Auxiliary.EnableArcanaCoin
description_zh: 为c在event1以及额外事件上登记「秘仪之力」式强制投掷硬币触发效果。
共用操作会把硬币结果记录为FLAG_ID_ARCANA_COIN；受「逆转命运」影响时改为由玩家选择结果。
description_en: Registers Arcana Force-style mandatory coin-toss trigger effects on c for event1 and any extra events.
The shared operation records the coin result as FLAG_ID_ARCANA_COIN; Reversal of Fate replaces the toss with a player choice.

functions.name: Auxiliary.EnableBESRemove
description_zh: 为c登记B.E.S.共通维持触发效果；战斗后能取除1个0x1f指示物则取除，否则破坏c。
description_en: Registers the shared B.E.S. maintenance trigger on c. After c battles, it removes one 0x1f counter if possible; otherwise it destroys c.

functions.name: Auxiliary.EnableChangeCode
description_zh: 把code登记为c的列名编号，并给c登记取该值的EFFECT_CHANGE_CODE效果。
省略location时，怪兽默认在怪兽区域适用，非怪兽默认在魔法与陷阱区域适用。省略condition时，该卡名变更始终适用。
description_en: Registers code as a listed code for c and gives c an EFFECT_CHANGE_CODE effect with that value.
If location is omitted, monsters use the Monster Zone and non-monsters use the Spell & Trap Zone. If condition is omitted, the code change is always active.

functions.name: Auxiliary.EnableExtraDeckSummonCountLimit
description_zh: 初始化共通的额外卡组召唤次数表，双方各为1次，并登记每个抽卡阶段开始时重置的全局效果。此辅助函数只管理计数，具体卡片脚本仍需自行检查并扣除次数。
description_en: Initializes the shared Extra Deck Summon count table with one count for each player and registers a global Draw Phase Start reset. The helper only manages the counter; individual card scripts still check and decrement it.

functions.name: Auxiliary.EnableNeosReturn
description_zh: 为c登记「元素英雄 新宇侠」融合怪兽共通的结束阶段返回效果；会创建强制返回效果，以及受编号42015635效果影响时使用的可选版本，并返回这两个效果。
description_en: Registers the shared Elemental HERO Neos Fusion End Phase return effects on c. It creates a mandatory return effect and an optional version used while c is affected by effect code 42015635, then returns both effects.

functions.name: Auxiliary.EnableSpiritReturn
description_zh: 为c登记灵魂怪兽回手设置。
任意列出的事件发生时，会在怪兽区域创建结束阶段回到手牌的效果，并遵守EFFECT_SPIRIT_DONOT_RETURN和EFFECT_SPIRIT_MAYNOT_RETURN。
description_en: Registers Spirit return setup for c.
When any listed event happens, it creates End Phase return-to-hand effects in the Monster Zone, respecting EFFECT_SPIRIT_DONOT_RETURN and EFFECT_SPIRIT_MAYNOT_RETURN.

functions.name: Auxiliary.EnableUnionAttribute
description_zh: 为c登记标准现代同盟怪兽组件。
该辅助函数会添加装备卡破坏代替、使用filter的EFFECT_UNION_LIMIT、从怪兽区域把c装备给合法怪兽的起动效果，以及从魔法与陷阱区域特殊召唤c的起动效果。
description_en: Registers the standard modern Union Monster package on c.

The helper adds equipped-card destruction substitution, an EFFECT_UNION_LIMIT using filter, an ignition effect to equip c from the Monster Zone to a valid monster, and an ignition effect to Special Summon c from the Spell & Trap Zone.

functions.name: Auxiliary.EPDestroyOperation
description_zh: 延迟到结束阶段破坏的操作函数；破坏保存在e的label object中的Card或Group。
description_en: Operation for delayed End Phase destruction effects. It destroys the Card or Group stored as e's label object.

functions.name: Auxiliary.EquipSpellOperation
description_zh: 返回共通装备魔法操作函数；若处理对象与第一个目标仍与效果关联、目标表侧表示且eqlimit允许，则把处理对象装备给该目标。
description_en: Returns the shared Equip Spell operation. It equips the handler to the first target if both cards are still related to the effect, the target is face-up, and eqlimit allows it.

functions.name: Auxiliary.EquipSpellTarget
description_zh: 返回共通装备魔法目标函数；is_self和is_opponent决定可选择哪一方怪兽区域，filter选择有效目标，eqlimit会在连锁中改选目标和处理时再次检查。
description_en: Returns the shared Equip Spell target function. is_self and is_opponent choose which Monster Zones can be targeted, filter selects a valid target, and eqlimit is rechecked for chained target changes and resolution.

functions.name: Auxiliary.evospcon
description_zh: 进化龙式效果以及0x304e系列怪兽特殊召唤用的特殊召唤条件辅助函数。
description_en: Special Summon condition helper for Evolsaur-style effects and set 0x304e monster Special Summons.

functions.name: Auxiliary.exccon
description_zh: 用于“送去墓地的当回合不能发动”类效果的条件辅助函数；处理者不是本回合送去墓地，或处理者因返回而记录原因时返回true。
description_en: Condition helper for effects that cannot be activated during the same turn their handler was sent to the GY, unless that handler was returned.

functions.name: Auxiliary.ExceptThisCard

returns.description: e's handler if it is still related to the current Chain; otherwise nil.

description_zh: 当效果e的处理者仍与当前连锁保持关联时返回该卡；否则返回nil。
description_en: Returns e's handler while that card is still related to the current Chain; otherwise returns nil.

functions.name: Auxiliary.ExtraDeckSummonCountLimitReset
description_zh: 把共通额外卡组召唤次数表重置为双方各1次。
description_en: Resets the shared Extra Deck Summon count table to one count for each player.

functions.name: Auxiliary.ExtraReleaseFilter
description_zh: 判断c是否为对方控制、且对tp具有EFFECT_EXTRA_RELEASE_NONSUM效果的卡。
description_en: Returns true for an opponent's card that has EFFECT_EXTRA_RELEASE_NONSUM available to tp.

functions.name: Auxiliary.FALSE
description_zh: 返回false。
description_en: Returns false.

functions.name: Auxiliary.FilterBoolFunction
description_en: Returns a filter function that calls f(target, ...) with the extra arguments captured now.
Use this when another API expects a one-argument Card filter but the real filter needs fixed extra values.

functions.name: Auxiliary.FilterEqualFunction
description_zh: 返回卡片筛选函数：对该卡和额外参数调用f，并检查结果是否等于value。
description_en: Returns a card filter that calls f on the card and extra arguments, then checks whether the result equals value.

functions.name: Auxiliary.gbspcon
description_zh: 剑斗兽式返回以及0x1019系列怪兽特殊召唤用的特殊召唤条件辅助函数。
description_en: Special Summon condition helper for Gladiator Beast-style returns and set 0x1019 monster Special Summons.

functions.name: Auxiliary.GCheckAdditional
description_zh: Group.CheckSubGroup及相关选择辅助函数使用的全局额外子组检查钩子。
默认实现返回true。召唤和选择手续会临时替换该函数以施加额外组限制，之后再恢复。
description_en: Global additional subgroup-check hook used by Group.CheckSubGroup and related selection helpers.
The default implementation returns true. Summon and selection procedures temporarily replace this function to enforce extra group constraints, then restore it.

functions.name: Auxiliary.GetAdjacentGroup
description_zh: 返回location1/location2中与全局场地坐标(i, j)正交相邻的卡。
description_en: Returns cards from location1/location2 that are orthogonally adjacent to the global field coordinate (i, j).

functions.name: Auxiliary.GetAttributeCount
description_zh: 返回g中包含的不同属性数量；空Group返回0。
description_en: Returns how many different Attributes are represented among the cards in g; an empty group returns 0.

functions.name: Auxiliary.GetCappedAttack
description_zh: 返回c的当前攻击力，但最高限制为MAX_PARAMETER。
description_en: Returns c's current ATK, capped at MAX_PARAMETER.

functions.name: Auxiliary.GetCappedLevel
description_zh: 返回c的当前等级，但最高限制为MAX_PARAMETER。
description_en: Returns c's current Level, capped at MAX_PARAMETER.

functions.name: Auxiliary.GetCappedXyzLevel
description_zh: 返回c的当前等级，但最高限制为MAX_XYZ_LEVEL。
description_en: Returns c's current Level, capped at MAX_XYZ_LEVEL.

functions.name: Auxiliary.GetColumn

params.name: c
params.description: Card whose field column is checked.
params.description_zh: 要检查所在纵列的卡。

params.name: p
params.description: Viewpoint player. Defaults to 0.
params.description_zh: 视角玩家。省略时为0。

returns.description: Column index from p's viewpoint, or NULL_VALUE if c has no field column.
returns.description_zh: 从p视角看的纵列编号；若c没有场上纵列则为NULL_VALUE。

description_zh: 从玩家p视角返回c所在纵列编号；c没有场上纵列时返回NULL_VALUE。
本地辅助函数把通常怪兽区域、魔法与陷阱区域映射为0-4列；额外怪兽区域序号5和6分别映射为1列和3列。
description_en: Returns c's column index from player p's viewpoint, or NULL_VALUE when c has no field column.
The local helper maps ordinary Monster Zones and Spell & Trap Zones to columns 0-4; Extra Monster Zone sequences 5 and 6 map to columns 1 and 3.

functions.name: Auxiliary.GetFieldIndex
description_zh: 从玩家0的场地视角返回c的全局行号和列号。
description_en: Returns c's global row and column indexes from player 0's field viewpoint.

functions.name: Auxiliary.GetGlobalColumn

returns.description: The global column index, or NULL_VALUE for invalid input.

description_zh: 从玩家0视角返回location和sequence对应的列编号。若p为玩家1，则会把本地列镜像；无效位置或序号返回NULL_VALUE。
description_en: Returns the column index for location and sequence from player 0's viewpoint. For player 1, the local column is mirrored. Invalid locations/sequences return NULL_VALUE.

functions.name: Auxiliary.GetGlobalRow

returns.description: The global row index, or NULL_VALUE for invalid input.

description_zh: 从玩家0视角返回location和sequence对应的行编号。若p为玩家1，则会把本地行镜像；无效位置或序号返回NULL_VALUE。
description_en: Returns the row index for location and sequence from player 0's viewpoint. For player 1, the local row is mirrored. Invalid locations/sequences return NULL_VALUE.

functions.name: Auxiliary.GetLocalColumn

returns.description: The local column index, or NULL_VALUE for invalid input.

description_zh: 返回魔法与陷阱区域或怪兽区域序号对应的本地列编号。额外怪兽区域序号5和6分别对应列1和列3；无效输入返回NULL_VALUE。
description_en: Returns the local column index for a Spell & Trap Zone or Monster Zone sequence. Extra Monster Zone sequences 5 and 6 map to columns 1 and 3; invalid inputs return NULL_VALUE.

functions.name: Auxiliary.GetLocalRow

returns.description: The local row index, or NULL_VALUE for invalid input.

description_zh: 返回魔法与陷阱区域或怪兽区域序号对应的本地行编号。主要怪兽区域为行1，额外怪兽区域为行2；无效输入返回NULL_VALUE。
description_en: Returns the local row index for a Spell & Trap Zone or Monster Zone sequence. Main Monster Zones are row 1, Extra Monster Zones are row 2, and invalid inputs return NULL_VALUE.

functions.name: Auxiliary.GetMaterialListCount

returns.description: Minimum material count.
Maximum material count.

description_zh: 返回c登记的素材数量下限和上限。若c没有material_count表，则返回0,0。
description_en: Returns c's stored minimum and maximum material counts. If c has no material_count table, returns 0,0.

functions.name: Auxiliary.GetMultiLinkedZone

returns.description: Zone mask for zones linked by at least two Link Monsters.

description_zh: 返回tp的怪兽区域中，被任意场上至少2只表侧连接怪兽连接到的区域掩码。
description_en: Returns the zone mask of tp's Monster Zones that are linked by at least two face-up Link Monsters on either field.

functions.name: Auxiliary.GetValueType
description_zh: 普通值返回Lua的type字符串；Card、Group、Effect userdata返回对应名称。
description_en: Returns Lua's type string for ordinary values, or Card, Group, or Effect for those userdata objects.

functions.name: Auxiliary.GetXyzNumber

returns.description: Registered Xyz Number value, if any.

description_zh: 返回v对应的已登记「No.」数值；v可以是Card或数字卡名编号。未登记时返回nil。
description_en: Returns the stored Xyz Number value for v, where v can be a Card or a numeric card code. Returns nil when no value is registered.

functions.name: Auxiliary.gfcheck

returns.description: true if the two cards satisfy the filter in either order.

description_zh: 检查2张卡的Group是否能按任意顺序满足同一个筛选：一张满足f(c,a1)，另一张满足f(c,a2)。
description_en: Checks a 2-card group against one filter in either order: one card must satisfy f(c,a1) and the other f(c,a2).

functions.name: Auxiliary.gffcheck

returns.description: true if the two cards satisfy both filters in either order.

description_zh: 检查2张卡的Group是否能按任意顺序满足两个筛选：一张满足f1(c,a1)，另一张满足f2(c,a2)。
description_en: Checks a 2-card group against two filters in either order: one card must satisfy f1(c,a1) and the other f2(c,a2).

functions.name: Auxiliary.GiveUpNormalDraw
description_zh: 让tp放弃当前抽卡阶段的通常抽卡：登记EFFECT_DRAW_COUNT为0，并登记FLAG_ID_NO_NORMAL_DRAW。
description_en: Makes tp give up the normal draw for the current Draw Phase by setting EFFECT_DRAW_COUNT to 0 and registering FLAG_ID_NO_NORMAL_DRAW.

functions.name: Auxiliary.GoldenAllureQueenFilter
description_zh: 检查c的原本系列代码是否为0x3，供Golden Allure Queen快速效果处理使用。
description_en: Returns true for cards whose original set code is 0x3, used by Golden Allure Queen quick-effect handling.

functions.name: Auxiliary.imval1
description_zh: EFFECT_CANNOT_BE_BATTLE_TARGET默认Value辅助函数；c不免疫e时返回true。
description_en: Default value helper for EFFECT_CANNOT_BE_BATTLE_TARGET; it returns true when c is not immune to e.

functions.name: Auxiliary.indoval
description_zh: 对方效果破坏耐性使用的Value辅助函数；当rp是效果e处理者玩家的对方时返回true。
description_en: Value helper for indestructibility against opponent's effects; it returns true when rp is the opponent of e's handler player.

functions.name: Auxiliary.indsval
description_zh: 自身效果破坏保护用Value辅助函数；原因玩家是处理对象玩家时返回true。
description_en: Value helper for self-protection from effect destruction; it returns true when the reason player is the handler's player.

functions.name: Auxiliary.IsCanBeQuickEffect
description_zh: 检查玩家tp是否受code影响、code是否登记了快速效果筛选，并且该筛选是否接受c。
description_en: Checks whether player tp is affected by code, code has a registered quick-effect filter, and that filter accepts c.

functions.name: Auxiliary.IsCodeListed

returns.description: true if code is listed by c; nil otherwise.

description_zh: 检查code是否已通过Auxiliary.AddCodeList或相关辅助函数登记在c的card_code_list中。
该Lua辅助函数在列名时返回true，否则返回nil，通常作为真假判断使用。
description_en: Checks whether code is registered in c's card_code_list by Auxiliary.AddCodeList or a related helper.
The Lua helper returns true for a listed code and nil otherwise, so it is normally used as a truthy check.

functions.name: Auxiliary.IsCodeOrListed

returns.description: true if c has or lists code.

description_zh: 判断c的当前卡名是否为code，或code是否已登记在c的列名编号表中。
description_en: Returns true if c's current code matches code or code is registered in c's listed-code table.

functions.name: Auxiliary.IsCounterAdded

returns.description: true if counter is registered on c.

description_zh: 判断counter是否已登记在c.counter_add_list中。
description_en: Returns true if counter is registered in c.counter_add_list.

functions.name: Auxiliary.IsInGroup

returns.description: true if g contains c.

description_zh: 判断g是否包含c。
description_en: Returns true if g contains c.

functions.name: Auxiliary.IsMaterialListCode
description_zh: 检查code是否存在于c.material中；该表通常由AddMaterialCodeList填充。返回true或nil。
description_en: Checks whether code is present in c.material, normally populated by AddMaterialCodeList; returns true or nil.

functions.name: Auxiliary.IsMaterialListSetCard
description_zh: 检查c的material_setcode元数据是否列有setcode，并支持打包子系列匹配。
description_en: Checks whether c lists setcode in its material_setcode metadata, including packed sub-set matching.

functions.name: Auxiliary.IsMaterialListType

returns.description: true if c's material type mask contains type.

description_zh: 判断c登记的素材种类掩码是否包含type。
description_en: Returns true if c's stored material type mask contains type.

functions.name: Auxiliary.IsPlayerCanNormalDraw
description_zh: 判断tp是否可以进行通常抽卡：抽卡数量大于0，卡组不为空，且没有FLAG_ID_NO_NORMAL_DRAW。
description_en: Checks whether tp can perform a normal draw: draw count is positive, the Deck is not empty, and FLAG_ID_NO_NORMAL_DRAW is not set.

functions.name: Auxiliary.IsSelfEquip
description_zh: 检查c是否有带标志效果id的装备卡，用于判断由该卡自身效果装备的卡。
description_en: Checks whether c has an equipped card carrying flag effect id, which marks equipment created by that card's own effect.

functions.name: Auxiliary.IsSetNameMonsterListed

returns.description: true if c lists a matching monster set code.

description_zh: 判断setcode是否匹配c登记的怪兽系列编号；比较规则与系列判断辅助函数一致。
description_en: Returns true if setcode matches one of the monster set codes registered for c, using the same set-code comparison rules as set membership helpers.

functions.name: Auxiliary.IsTypeInText

returns.description: true if c's text type mask contains type.

description_zh: 判断c文本登记的种类掩码是否包含type。
description_en: Returns true if c's text-registered type mask contains type.

functions.name: Auxiliary.IsUnionState

returns.description: Equipped target when truthy.

description_zh: 当effect的处理对象具有EFFECT_UNION_STATUS且正在装备时，返回其装备对象。
该Lua表达式成功时返回可作为真值使用的Card；没有同盟状态效果时返回false；没有装备对象时返回nil。
description_en: Returns the equipped Union target for effect's handler when it has EFFECT_UNION_STATUS and is equipped.
The Lua expression returns a truthy Card on success, false when the status effect is missing, or nil when no equip target exists.

functions.name: Auxiliary.LabrynthDestroyOp
description_zh: 「白银之迷宫城」共通的追加破坏处理；非从手牌发动的「拉比林斯迷宫欢迎」通常陷阱处理后，可破坏场上1张卡，并使用场地效果的次数限制。
description_en: Shared extra destroy operation for the Labrynth field effect. After a non-hand-activated Welcome Labrynth Normal Trap resolves, it can destroy one card on the field and consumes the field effect's count limit.

functions.name: Auxiliary.MaterialReasonCardReg
description_zh: Auxiliary.CreateMaterialReasonCardRelation使用的EVENT_BE_MATERIAL回调；让召唤出的怪兽与保存的效果对象建立效果关联。
description_en: EVENT_BE_MATERIAL callback used by Auxiliary.CreateMaterialReasonCardRelation. It creates an effect relation between the Summoned monster and the stored effect object.

functions.name: Auxiliary.MergedDelayEventCheck1
description_zh: Auxiliary.RegisterMergedDelayedEvent使用的内部回调；收集事件卡，若当前不在连锁中，则立刻触发EVENT_CUSTOM加保存编号的事件。
description_en: Internal callback for Auxiliary.RegisterMergedDelayedEvent. It collects event cards and, if not inside a Chain, raises EVENT_CUSTOM plus the stored code immediately.

functions.name: Auxiliary.MergedDelayEventCheck1_ToSingleCard
description_zh: 单卡合并延迟事件使用的内部回调；收集事件卡，若持有者自身移动则清空，并在可立即处理时触发保存的自定义事件。
description_en: Internal callback for single-card merged delayed events. It collects event cards, clears them if the owner card moved, and raises the stored custom event immediately when possible.

functions.name: Auxiliary.MergedDelayEventCheck2
description_zh: Auxiliary.RegisterMergedDelayedEvent使用的内部回调；在连锁结束时，对已收集的卡只触发1次合并后的自定义事件，然后清空保存的Group。
description_en: Internal callback for Auxiliary.RegisterMergedDelayedEvent. At Chain End, it raises one merged custom event for all collected cards, then clears the stored group.

functions.name: Auxiliary.MergedDelayEventCheck2_ToSingleCard
description_zh: 单卡合并延迟事件使用的连锁结束内部回调；清理因公开移动而失效的记录，对收集到的卡触发保存的自定义事件，然后清空Group。
description_en: Internal Chain End callback for single-card merged delayed events. It clears stale public-move entries, raises the stored custom event for collected cards, then clears the group.

functions.name: Auxiliary.MimighoulFlipCondition

returns.description: true during either Main Phase.

description_zh: 当前处于任一主要阶段时返回true。
description_en: Returns true during either Main Phase.

functions.name: Auxiliary.MonsterEffectPropertyFilter
description_zh: 返回谓词函数，用于判断Effect是否包含flag属性，且效果范围不在灵摆区域。
description_en: Returns a predicate that checks whether an Effect has property flag and is not ranged to the Pendulum Zone.

functions.name: Auxiliary.mzctcheck

returns.description: true if tp has an open Monster Zone after releasing g.

description_zh: 判断tp在解放g之后是否会有可用怪兽区域。
description_en: Returns true if tp would have an open Monster Zone after releasing g.

functions.name: Auxiliary.mzctcheckrel

params.name: reason
params.description: default: REASON_COST

description_zh: 检查因reason解放g后是否留下怪兽区域，并且g是否是tp可用的有效解放组。
description_en: Checks whether releasing group g by reason leaves a Monster Zone and g is a valid release group for tp.

functions.name: Auxiliary.MZoneSequence
description_zh: 从控制者视角返回怪兽区域序号seq对应的本地纵列编号。
description_en: Returns the local column index for Monster Zone sequence seq from that controller's viewpoint.

functions.name: Auxiliary.nbcon

returns.description: true if the activation can be negated and the card can be banished if needed.

description_zh: 「把发动无效并除外」类效果的条件辅助函数；要求tp可以除外，且发动的卡不再与其效果关联，或仍关联但可以被除外。
description_en: Condition helper for effects that negate an activation and banish the activating card. It requires tp to be able to banish, and the activating card must either no longer be related to its effect or be able to be banished.

functions.name: Auxiliary.nbtg
description_zh: 「把发动无效并除外」类效果的目标辅助函数；登记无效信息，发动的卡仍与效果关联时登记除外信息，并在效果从墓地发动时标记CATEGORY_GRAVE_ACTION。
description_en: Target helper for effects that negate an activation and banish the activating card. It sets negate operation info, adds banish info when the activating card is still related, and marks CATEGORY_GRAVE_ACTION for effects activated in the Graveyard.

functions.name: Auxiliary.ndcon

returns.description: true if the activation can be negated and the card can be returned to the Deck if needed.

description_zh: 「把发动无效并回到卡组」类效果的条件辅助函数；魔法/陷阱的发动、已不与效果关联的卡，或仍关联且可以回到卡组的卡均满足。
description_en: Condition helper for effects that negate an activation and return the activating card to the Deck. It accepts Spell/Trap activations, unrelated cards, or related cards that can be returned to the Deck.

functions.name: Auxiliary.NecroValleyFilter
description_en: Returns a wrapper filter that requires f(target, ...) and also rejects cards currently protected by Necrovalley while the Chain is disablable.

functions.name: Auxiliary.NecroValleyNegateCheck

returns.description: true if the current effect was negated by the Necrovalley check.

description_zh: 检查v这个Card或Group中是否包含受「王家长眠之谷」影响的卡。若当前连锁可被无效且找到匹配卡，则无效当前效果并返回true。
description_en: Checks whether v, a Card or Group, contains a card affected by Necrovalley. If the current Chain is disablable and a matching card is found, it negates the current effect and returns true.

functions.name: Auxiliary.NegateAnyFilter

returns.description: true if c is a valid card to have its effects negated.

description_zh: 用于无效表侧卡效果的筛选。陷阱怪兽只需表侧表示，魔法/陷阱卡需表侧表示且尚未被无效，怪兽则使用Auxiliary.NegateMonsterFilter。
description_en: Filter for effects that negate a face-up card. Trap Monsters only need to be face-up, Spell/Trap Cards must be face-up and not already disabled, and monsters use Auxiliary.NegateMonsterFilter.

functions.name: Auxiliary.NegateEffectMonsterFilter

returns.description: true if c is a valid Effect Monster to have its effects negated.

description_zh: 用于无效效果怪兽效果的筛选，例如「效果遮蒙者」；c必须表侧表示、尚未被无效，且当前为效果怪兽。
description_en: Filter for effects that negate an Effect Monster, such as Effect Veiler: c must be face-up, not already disabled, and currently an Effect Monster.

functions.name: Auxiliary.NegateMonsterFilter

returns.description: true if c is a valid face-up monster to have its effects negated.

description_zh: 用于无效表侧怪兽效果的筛选，例如「无限泡影」；c必须表侧表示、尚未被无效，且当前或原本为效果怪兽。
description_en: Filter for effects that negate a face-up monster, such as Infinite Impermanence: c must be face-up, not already disabled, and be or originally be an Effect Monster.

functions.name: Auxiliary.NegateSummonCondition

returns.description: true when no Chain is ready.

description_zh: 没有待处理连锁时返回true，用于无效召唤的效果。
description_en: Returns true when no Chain is ready, for effects that negate a Summon.

functions.name: Auxiliary.NeosReturnConditionForced

returns.description: true if the forced Neos return effect should apply.

description_zh: 「元素英雄 新宇侠」融合怪兽结束阶段强制返回效果的条件；处理对象未受编号42015635（「新宇宙」）效果影响时返回true。
description_en: Condition for the mandatory Elemental HERO Neos Fusion End Phase return effect; true while the handler is not affected by Neo Space's effect code 42015635.

functions.name: Auxiliary.NeosReturnConditionOptional

returns.description: true if the optional Neos return effect should apply.

description_zh: 「元素英雄 新宇侠」融合怪兽结束阶段可选返回效果的条件；处理对象受编号42015635（「新宇宙」）效果影响时返回true。
description_en: Condition for the optional Elemental HERO Neos Fusion End Phase return effect; true while the handler is affected by Neo Space's effect code 42015635.

functions.name: Auxiliary.NeosReturnTargetForced

returns.description: Target function for the mandatory return effect.

description_zh: 返回「元素英雄 新宇侠」融合怪兽强制结束阶段返回效果的目标函数；始终允许处理，登记回到卡组信息，并在提供set_category时调用它。
description_en: Returns the mandatory End Phase return target function for Elemental HERO Neos Fusions. It always allows targeting, sets to-Deck operation info, and calls set_category when provided.

functions.name: Auxiliary.NeosReturnTargetOptional

returns.description: Target function for the optional return effect.

description_zh: 返回「元素英雄 新宇侠」融合怪兽可选结束阶段返回效果的目标函数；要求处理对象可以回到额外卡组，登记回到卡组信息，并在提供set_category时调用它。
description_en: Returns the optional End Phase return target function for Elemental HERO Neos Fusions. It requires the handler to be able to return to the Extra Deck, sets to-Deck operation info, and calls set_category when provided.

functions.name: Auxiliary.Next

returns.description: Iterator function for generic for loops.

description_zh: 返回用于generic for循环遍历g的迭代器，内部使用Group.GetFirst和Group.GetNext。
description_en: Returns an iterator over g for generic for loops, using Group.GetFirst and Group.GetNext internally.

functions.name: Auxiliary.NOT

returns.description: A predicate that returns not f(...).

description_zh: 返回将f结果取反的谓词函数。
description_en: Returns a predicate that negates f's result.

functions.name: Auxiliary.NULL
description_zh: 空辅助函数；有意不执行任何处理。
description_en: Empty helper function that intentionally does nothing.

functions.name: Auxiliary.nzatk
description_zh: 筛选辅助函数：表侧表示且当前攻击力大于0的卡返回true。
description_en: Filter helper that is true for face-up cards with current ATK greater than 0.

functions.name: Auxiliary.nzdef
description_zh: 表侧表示且当前守备力大于0的卡返回true。
description_en: Returns true for face-up cards with current DEF greater than 0.

functions.name: Auxiliary.OR

returns.description: A composed predicate.

description_zh: 返回组合条件函数；调用时会用相同参数依次执行传入的函数，并在第一个真值处停止。
description_en: Returns a composed predicate that calls each function with the same arguments and stops at the first truthy result.

functions.name: Auxiliary.OrcustratedBabelFilter
description_zh: 检查原本为Orcust系列的卡是否是在场上的连接怪兽，或在墓地的怪兽。
description_en: Returns true for original Orcust cards that are Link Monsters on the field or monsters in the GY.

functions.name: Auxiliary.PhantasmsSpSummonType
description_zh: 检查c是否是特殊召唤手续怪兽，供Phantasm特殊召唤辅助函数使用。
description_en: Returns whether c is a Special Summon procedure monster, used by Phantasm Special Summon helpers.

functions.name: Auxiliary.PlaceCardsOnDeckBottom

params.name: reason
params.description: Defaults to REASON_EFFECT.

returns.description: The number of operated cards.

description_zh: 以reason把g送到卡组最上方；让p为进入双方卡组的卡排序后，再移动到卡组最下方，并返回实际处理的卡数量。
