description_en: Sends g to the top of the Deck by reason, lets p order cards that reached either Deck, moves them to the bottom, and returns the number of operated cards.

functions.name: Auxiliary.PlaceCardsOnDeckTop

params.name: reason
params.description: Defaults to REASON_EFFECT.

returns.description: The number of operated cards.

description_zh: 以reason把g送到卡组最上方；需要时让p为进入双方卡组的卡排序，并返回实际处理的卡数量。
description_en: Sends g to the top of the Deck by reason, lets p order cards that reached either Deck when needed, and returns the number of operated cards.

functions.name: Auxiliary.PuzzleOp
description_zh: 残局模式的结束阶段操作；把玩家0的LP变为0。
description_en: Puzzle-mode End Phase operation that sets player 0's LP to 0.

functions.name: Auxiliary.qlifilter
description_zh: 机壳免疫用Value辅助函数。
接受由原本等级或阶级低于处理对象当前等级的怪兽发动的怪兽效果，并拒绝连接怪兽。
description_en: Qli immunity value helper.
It accepts activated monster effects from monsters whose original Level or Rank is lower than the handler's current Level, and rejects Link Monsters.

functions.name: Auxiliary.RegisterMergedDelayedEvent

params.name: g
params.description: Optional storage group; a kept-alive group is created when omitted.

description_zh: 登记全局监听，把同一连锁内多次发生的event合并成1次EVENT_CUSTOM+code事件。不在连锁中则立即触发，在连锁中则于连锁结束触发。
description_en: Registers global listeners that merge multiple occurrences of event into one EVENT_CUSTOM+code event. The merged event is raised immediately outside a Chain, or at Chain End while in a Chain.

functions.name: Auxiliary.RegisterMergedDelayedEvent_ToSingleCard

returns.description: The generated custom event code.

description_zh: 为单张卡登记1个事件或事件表的合并延迟监听，并返回生成的自定义事件编号。持有者移动到公开状态时会清空保存的卡，并在需要时安装共通的连锁结束触发器。
description_en: Registers single-card merged delayed event listeners for one event or a table of events, returning the generated custom event code. The helper clears stored cards when the owner moves to a public state and installs the shared Chain End raiser when needed.

functions.name: Auxiliary.RegisterMergedDelayedEvent_ToSingleCard_AddOperation
description_zh: Auxiliary.RegisterMergedDelayedEvent_ToSingleCard使用的内部辅助函数；登记1个事件监听及其连锁结束配套监听。
description_en: Internal helper that registers one event listener and its Chain End companion for Auxiliary.RegisterMergedDelayedEvent_ToSingleCard.

functions.name: Auxiliary.RegisterMergedDelayedEvent_ToSingleCard_RaiseEvent
description_zh: 单卡合并延迟事件使用的全局连锁结束辅助函数；对每个待处理的生成自定义事件触发1次，然后清空对应Group。
description_en: Global Chain End helper for single-card merged delayed events. It raises each pending generated custom event once, then clears its stored group.

functions.name: Auxiliary.SameValueCheck
description_zh: 检查g中的所有卡是否共享f返回值中的至少一个位；0张或1张卡的Group返回true。
description_en: Checks whether every card in g shares at least one bit returned by f; groups of 0 or 1 card return true.

functions.name: Auxiliary.SelectCardFromFieldFirst

returns.description: The selected cards.

description_zh: 选择辅助函数；先用HINTMSG_FIELD_FIRST提示玩家选择满足条件的场上卡。若取消该选择，则恢复之前的提示并回退到Duel.SelectMatchingCard。
description_en: Selection helper that first offers matching on-field cards with HINTMSG_FIELD_FIRST. If that selection is canceled, it restores the previous hint and falls back to Duel.SelectMatchingCard.

functions.name: Auxiliary.SelectFromOptions

returns.description: Selected option value or 1-based option index; nil if no option is available.

description_zh: 按条件筛选选项表，用可用选项文本调用Duel.SelectOption，并返回所选表的自定义值或原始序号。
每个选项为{condition, option[, value]}。没有条件成立时返回nil。默认返回的序号从1开始，不同于Duel.SelectOption从0开始。
description_en: Filters option tables by their condition, calls Duel.SelectOption with the available option labels, and returns the selected table's custom value or original index.
Each option is {condition, option[, value]}. If no condition is true, the helper returns nil. Its default index return is 1-based, unlike Duel.SelectOption's 0-based return.

functions.name: Auxiliary.SelectSameCount

params.name: min
params.description: default: 1

params.name: max
params.description: default: min(#g1, #g2, 127)

description_zh: 让tp构建一个从g1和g2中选取相同数量卡的选择结果。
except会先从两个Group中移除。若min大于计算出的max，结果可以为nil。
description_en: Lets tp build a selection that contains the same number of cards from g1 and g2.
except is removed from both groups before selection. The result can be nil if min is greater than the computed max.

functions.name: Auxiliary.SelectTargetFromFieldFirst

returns.description: The selected target cards.

description_zh: 取对象选择辅助函数；先用HINTMSG_FIELD_FIRST提示玩家选择满足条件的场上效果对象。若接受则登记为对象；否则恢复之前的提示并回退到Duel.SelectTarget。
description_en: Target-selection helper that first offers matching on-field effect targets with HINTMSG_FIELD_FIRST. If accepted, it sets those cards as targets; otherwise it restores the previous hint and falls back to Duel.SelectTarget.

functions.name: Auxiliary.SelfEquipFilter

returns.description: true if c has the flag id.

description_zh: c持有id标记时返回true；Auxiliary.IsSelfEquip用它判断由自身效果装备的卡。
description_en: Returns true if c has a flag with id, used by Auxiliary.IsSelfEquip to identify cards equipped by their own effect.

functions.name: Auxiliary.SequenceToGlobal

params.name: p
params.description: Player whose local field sequence is converted.
params.description_zh: 要转换其本地区域序号的玩家。

params.name: loc
params.description: LOCATION_MZONE or LOCATION_SZONE.
params.description_zh: LOCATION_MZONE或LOCATION_SZONE。

params.name: seq
params.description: Sequence inside loc. Monster Zone sequences up to 6 are accepted; Spell & Trap Zone sequences up to 4 are accepted.
params.description_zh: loc中的序号。怪兽区域可接受到6；魔法与陷阱区域可接受到4。

returns.description: The global zone bit, or 0 for invalid input.
returns.description_zh: 全局区域位；输入无效时为0。

description_zh: 把玩家本地的怪兽区域或魔法与陷阱区域序号转换为全局区域位。玩家、位置或序号无效时返回0。
怪兽区域位按16*p+seq位移；魔法与陷阱区域位按16*p+seq+8位移。
description_en: Converts a player's local Monster Zone or Spell & Trap Zone sequence into a global zone bit. Invalid players, locations, or sequences return 0.
Monster Zone bits are shifted by 16*p+seq; Spell & Trap Zone bits are shifted by 16*p+seq+8.

functions.name: Auxiliary.SetUnionState
description_zh: 在c成为装备卡后，为其适用已装备的同盟状态。
若c具有EFFECT_UNION_LIMIT效果，则登记对应的EFFECT_EQUIP_LIMIT和EFFECT_UNION_STATUS重置效果。旧式同盟卡还会获得EFFECT_OLDUNION_STATUS。
description_en: Applies the equipped Union state to c after it becomes equipped.
If c has an EFFECT_UNION_LIMIT effect, this registers the matching EFFECT_EQUIP_LIMIT and EFFECT_UNION_STATUS reset effects. Old Union cards also receive EFFECT_OLDUNION_STATUS.

functions.name: Auxiliary.SpiritReturnConditionForced

returns.description: true if the mandatory Spirit return effect should apply.

description_zh: 灵魂怪兽结束阶段强制回到手牌效果的条件；处理对象没有禁止回手效果，且没有可选择不回手效果时返回true。
description_en: Condition for the mandatory Spirit Monster End Phase return effect. It returns true while the handler is not prevented from returning and does not have the optional-return permission effect.

functions.name: Auxiliary.SpiritReturnConditionOptional

returns.description: true if the optional Spirit return effect should apply.

description_zh: 灵魂怪兽结束阶段可选回到手牌效果的条件；处理对象没有禁止回手效果，且具有可选择不回手效果时返回true。
description_en: Condition for the optional Spirit Monster End Phase return effect. It returns true while the handler is not prevented from returning and does have the optional-return permission effect.

functions.name: Auxiliary.SpiritReturnOperation
description_zh: 灵魂怪兽共通结束阶段回到手牌效果的操作；处理对象仍与效果关联时，将其回到手牌。
description_en: Operation for the shared Spirit Monster End Phase return effect. If the handler is still related to the effect, it returns that card to the hand.

functions.name: Auxiliary.SpiritReturnReg
description_zh: 登记Auxiliary.EnableSpiritReturn创建的临时结束阶段回手效果：1个强制触发效果和1个可选触发效果。
description_en: Registers the temporary End Phase return effects created by Auxiliary.EnableSpiritReturn: one mandatory trigger and one optional trigger.

functions.name: Auxiliary.SpiritReturnTargetForced

returns.description: true during target checks; otherwise no meaningful return value.

description_zh: 灵魂怪兽结束阶段强制回到手牌效果的目标函数；检查阶段始终返回true，之后登记回到手牌的操作信息。
description_en: Target function for the mandatory Spirit Monster End Phase return effect. During the check step it always returns true, then registers return-to-hand operation info.

functions.name: Auxiliary.SpiritReturnTargetOptional

returns.description: true during valid target checks; otherwise no meaningful return value.

description_zh: 灵魂怪兽结束阶段可选回到手牌效果的目标函数；检查阶段要求处理对象可以回到手牌，之后登记回到手牌的操作信息。
description_en: Target function for the optional Spirit Monster End Phase return effect. During the check step it requires the handler to be able to return to the hand, then registers return-to-hand operation info.

functions.name: Auxiliary.Stringid
description_zh: 返回卡片code的第id个卡片字符串编号；id从0开始。
description_en: Returns the card-string id for card code and string index id. The index starts at 0 and is commonly passed to Effect.SetDescription, Duel.Hint, or selection prompts.

functions.name: Auxiliary.sumreg
description_zh: 对eg中原本卡号等于e的Label的每张卡登记同卡号的标志效果，持续到结束阶段/重置。
description_en: For each card in eg whose original code equals e's label, registers a same-code flag effect that lasts through the End Phase/reset.

functions.name: Auxiliary.SZoneSequence

returns.description: The local column index, or NULL_VALUE for invalid input.

description_zh: 从控制者视角返回魔法与陷阱区域序号对应的本地列编号。
description_en: Returns the local column for a Spell & Trap Zone sequence from the controller's viewpoint.

functions.name: Auxiliary.TargetBoolFunction

returns.description: A target callback with parameters (effect, target).

description_zh: 返回效果目标回调函数；调用时会执行f(target, ...)并使用当前捕获的额外参数。
适用于SetTarget等需要(effect, target)形式函数的API。
description_en: Returns an effect target callback that calls f(target, ...) with the extra arguments captured now.
Use this when SetTarget or similar APIs expect a function with parameters (effect, target).

functions.name: Auxiliary.TargetEqualFunction
description_zh: 返回效果对象Value函数：对对象卡和额外参数调用f，并检查结果是否等于value。
description_en: Returns an effect target-value function that calls f on the target card and extra arguments, then checks whether the result equals value.

functions.name: Auxiliary.tgoval
description_zh: EFFECT_CANNOT_BE_EFFECT_TARGET常用的Value函数，用于防止成为对方效果的对象。
当原因玩家rp是e处理对象玩家的对方时返回true。
description_en: Shared value function for EFFECT_CANNOT_BE_EFFECT_TARGET effects that protect against the opponent's effects.
It returns true when the reason player rp is the opponent of e's handler player.

functions.name: Auxiliary.tgsval
description_zh: 自身对象保护用Value辅助函数；原因玩家是处理对象玩家时返回true。
description_en: Value helper for self-targeting protection; it returns true when the reason player is the handler's player.

functions.name: Auxiliary.ThisCardInGraveAlreadyCheckReg

returns.description: Always false after any tracking setup is done.

description_zh: Auxiliary.AddThisCardInGraveAlreadyCheck使用的条件回调；当此卡因效果、作为素材或未发动的费用送去墓地时，保存相关效果并登记重置效果，随后返回false让自身不再执行操作。
description_en: Condition callback used by Auxiliary.AddThisCardInGraveAlreadyCheck. When this card is sent to the Graveyard by an effect, material use, or non-activated cost, it stores the responsible effect and installs reset effects; it then returns false so no separate effect operation runs.

functions.name: Auxiliary.ThisCardInGraveAlreadyReset1
description_zh: 清除跟踪效果保存的相关效果，并重置这个临时重置效果。
description_en: Clears the stored responsible effect from the tracking effect and resets this temporary reset effect.

functions.name: Auxiliary.ThisCardInGraveAlreadyReset2
description_zh: 通过配对的重置效果清除保存的相关效果，并重置两个临时重置效果。
description_en: Clears the stored responsible effect through the paired reset effect, then resets both temporary reset effects.

functions.name: Auxiliary.ThisCardMovedToPublicResetCheck_ToSingleCard
description_zh: 单卡合并延迟事件使用的重置检查；若持有者已经表侧表示或处于公开状态，则清空保存的事件Group。
description_en: Reset check used by single-card merged delayed events. If the owner card is now face-up or public, it clears the stored event group.

functions.name: Auxiliary.tkfcon

returns.description: true if tp controls a Token on the field.

description_zh: 判断tp场上是否存在衍生物。省略tp且提供e时，tp默认使用e的持有者玩家。
description_en: Returns true if tp controls a Token on the field. If tp is omitted and e is provided, tp defaults to e's handler player.

functions.name: Auxiliary.TriamidSpSummonType
description_zh: 检查c是否是特殊召唤手续怪兽，供「三形金字塔」特殊召唤辅助函数使用。
description_en: Returns whether c is a Special Summon procedure monster, used by Triamid Special Summon helpers.

functions.name: Auxiliary.TRUE

returns.description: Always true.

description_zh: 返回true。
description_en: Returns true.

functions.name: Auxiliary.TurnPlayers

returns.description: Iterator that yields the turn player, then the other player.

description_zh: 返回一个迭代器，先返回当前回合玩家，再返回另一名玩家。
description_en: Returns an iterator that yields the current turn player first, then the other player.

functions.name: Auxiliary.UnionEquipFilter

returns.description: Filter function taking Card c and int tp.

description_zh: 返回现代同盟怪兽装备效果使用的筛选函数；对象必须表侧表示、由tp控制、没有装备现代同盟怪兽，并满足filter。
description_en: Returns a filter for modern Union equip effects. The target must be face-up, controlled by tp, have no modern Union monster equipped, and satisfy filter.

functions.name: Auxiliary.UnionEquipLimit

returns.description: Equip Limit value function.

description_zh: 返回现代同盟怪兽使用的装备限制Value函数；允许处理者玩家控制且满足filter的卡，并保持当前装备对象合法。
description_en: Returns an Equip Limit value function for modern Union monsters. It allows cards controlled by the handler's player that satisfy filter, and also keeps the current equip target legal.

functions.name: Auxiliary.UnionEquipOperation

returns.description: Operation function for the shared Union equip effect.

description_zh: 返回现代同盟怪兽共通装备效果的操作函数；将处理对象装备给选中的目标，若目标不再有效则因规则把处理对象送去墓地。
description_en: Returns the operation function for the shared modern Union equip effect. It equips the handler to the selected target, or sends the handler to the Graveyard by rule if the target is no longer valid.

functions.name: Auxiliary.UnionEquipTarget

returns.description: Target function for the shared Union equip effect.

description_zh: 返回现代同盟怪兽共通装备效果的目标函数；检查同盟次数标记、可用魔法与陷阱区域，选择有效目标，并登记装备操作信息。
description_en: Returns the target function for the shared modern Union equip effect. It checks the once-per-turn Union flag, requires an open Spell & Trap Zone, selects a valid target, and registers equip operation info.

functions.name: Auxiliary.UnionReplaceFilter

returns.description: true for destruction by battle or card effect.

description_zh: 现代同盟怪兽的破坏代替Value函数；因战斗或卡片效果将被破坏时返回true。
description_en: Destroy-substitute value function for modern Union monsters; returns true for destruction by battle or card effect.

functions.name: Auxiliary.UnionUnequipOperation
description_zh: 现代同盟怪兽共通解除装备效果的操作；处理对象仍与效果关联时，将其表侧表示特殊召唤。
description_en: Operation for the shared modern Union unequip effect; Special Summons the handler in face-up position if it is still related to the effect.

functions.name: Auxiliary.UnionUnequipTarget

returns.description: true during valid target checks; otherwise no meaningful return value.

description_zh: 现代同盟怪兽共通解除装备效果的目标函数；检查同盟次数标记、可用怪兽区域、当前装备对象，以及处理对象能否特殊召唤。
description_en: Target function for the shared modern Union unequip effect. It checks the Union flag, available Monster Zone, current equip target, and whether the handler can be Special Summoned.

functions.name: Auxiliary.UrsarcticExCostFilter

returns.description: true if c can be banished as an Ursarctic replacement cost.

description_zh: 「北极天熊」共通特殊召唤效果的代替费用筛选；匹配墓地中可作为费用除外，且具有编号16471775或89264428效果的卡。
description_en: Replacement-cost filter for the shared Ursarctic Special Summon effect. It accepts cards in the Graveyard that can be banished as cost through effect code 16471775 or 89264428.

functions.name: Auxiliary.UrsarcticReleaseFilter

returns.description: true if c is a Level 7 or higher monster in the hand.

description_zh: 「北极天熊」共通特殊召唤效果的费用筛选；匹配手牌中7星以上的怪兽。
description_en: Cost filter for the shared Ursarctic Special Summon effect. It accepts Level 7 or higher monsters in the hand.

functions.name: Auxiliary.UrsarcticSpSummonCondition

returns.description: true during Main Phase 1 or Main Phase 2.

description_zh: 「北极天熊」共通手牌快速效果的条件；当前为任一主要阶段时返回true。
description_en: Condition for the shared Ursarctic hand Quick Effect; returns true during either Main Phase.

functions.name: Auxiliary.UrsarcticSpSummonCost

returns.description: true during cost checks; otherwise no meaningful return value.

description_zh: 检查并支付「北极天熊」共通特殊召唤费用。玩家解放手牌中1只7星以上怪兽，或除外1张可用的墓地代替费用卡并使用对应效果的次数限制。
description_en: Checks and pays the shared Ursarctic Special Summon cost. The player releases a Level 7 or higher monster from the hand, or banishes a valid Graveyard replacement-cost card and consumes that effect's count limit.

functions.name: Auxiliary.UrsarcticSpSummonLimit

returns.description: true for Level 0 monsters.

description_zh: 「北极天熊」共通效果处理后登记的特殊召唤限制目标；对等级为0的怪兽返回true。
description_en: Special Summon restriction target applied after the shared Ursarctic effect resolves; returns true for monsters with Level 0.

functions.name: Auxiliary.UrsarcticSpSummonOperation
description_zh: 「北极天熊」共通特殊召唤效果的操作；特殊召唤处理对象后，登记直到结束阶段的特殊召唤限制，阻止等级为0的怪兽特殊召唤。
description_en: Operation for the shared Ursarctic Special Summon effect. It Special Summons the handler, then applies the End Phase Special Summon restriction that blocks Level 0 monsters.

functions.name: Auxiliary.UrsarcticSpSummonTarget

returns.description: true during valid target checks; otherwise no meaningful return value.

description_zh: 「北极天熊」共通特殊召唤效果的目标处理；要求有可用怪兽区域且处理对象可以特殊召唤，然后登记特殊召唤信息。
description_en: Target function for the shared Ursarctic Special Summon effect. It requires an open Monster Zone and that the handler can be Special Summoned, then sets Special Summon operation info.

functions.name: Auxiliary.UseExtraReleaseCount
description_zh: 对g中通过EFFECT_EXTRA_RELEASE_NONSUM被解放的对方卡使用次数限制，用于未通过Duel.SelectReleaseGroup选择的额外解放效果。
description_en: Consumes count limits for opponent's cards in g that were released through EFFECT_EXTRA_RELEASE_NONSUM, such as Lair of Darkness-style release effects not selected by Duel.SelectReleaseGroup.

functions.name: GetID

returns.description: The current script table.
The current card code.
String ID offset, 1 or 100.

description_zh: 返回当前脚本的表、卡名编号以及字符串偏移值。普通卡编号的偏移值为1，大型自定义编号的偏移值为100。
description_en: Returns the current script's table, card code, and string offset. The offset is 1 for regular card IDs and 100 for large custom IDs.

functions.name: Group.CheckSubGroup

returns.description: true if a valid subgroup exists.

description_zh: 检查g是否存在数量在min到max之间且满足f的子组，同时考虑Duel.GrabSelectedCard已有选择和Auxiliary.GCheckAdditional。
description_en: Checks whether g has a subgroup with size between min and max that satisfies f, while respecting already selected cards from Duel.GrabSelectedCard and Auxiliary.GCheckAdditional.

functions.name: Group.CheckSubGroupEach

returns.description: true if one card can satisfy each check.

description_zh: 检查g是否能为checks中的每个筛选各提供1张卡。省略f时，只要求每个位置的筛选成立。
description_en: Checks whether g can supply one card for each filter in checks. If f is omitted, only the per-position checks are required.

functions.name: Group.SelectSubGroup

returns.description: The selected subgroup, or nil if no valid selection is completed.

description_zh: 让tp从g中选择数量在min到max之间且满足f的子组。会考虑已有选择；若不能完成有效选择则返回nil。
description_en: Lets tp select a subgroup from g with size between min and max that satisfies f. It respects already selected cards and returns nil if no valid selection is completed.

functions.name: Group.SelectSubGroupEach

returns.description: The selected subgroup, or nil if no valid selection is completed.

description_zh: 让tp为checks中的每个筛选各选择1张卡，可选择是否允许取消。省略f时，最终组检查使用Auxiliary.TRUE。
description_en: Lets tp select one card for each filter in checks, optionally cancelable. If f is omitted, Auxiliary.TRUE is used for the final group check.

functions.name: bit.band

returns.description: Bitwise AND of a and b.

description_zh: 返回a和b的按位与结果。
description_en: Returns the bitwise AND of a and b.

functions.name: bit.bnot

returns.description: Bitwise NOT of a.

description_zh: 返回a的按位取反结果。
description_en: Returns the bitwise NOT of a.

functions.name: bit.bor
description_zh: 返回a与b的按位或结果。
description_en: Returns the bitwise OR of a and b.

functions.name: bit.bxor
description_zh: 返回a与b的按位异或结果。
description_en: Returns the bitwise XOR of a and b.

functions.name: bit.extract

returns.description: The extracted bit field.

description_zh: 从r中提取从field位开始的width位。width省略时为1。
description_en: Extracts width bits from r starting at bit field. width defaults to 1.

functions.name: bit.lshift
description_zh: 返回a左移b位后的结果。
description_en: Returns a shifted left by b bits.

functions.name: bit.replace

returns.description: r with the selected bit field replaced.

description_zh: 返回把r中从field位开始的width位替换为v的低width位后的结果。width省略时为1。
description_en: Returns r with width bits starting at field replaced by the low width bits of v. width defaults to 1.

functions.name: bit.rshift
description_zh: 返回a右移b位后的结果。
description_en: Returns a shifted right by b bits.

functions.name: Auxiliary.AddContactFusionProcedure

returns.description: The created Contact Fusion procedure effect.

description_zh: 为c登记接触融合特殊召唤手续，使用指定素材筛选位置和素材操作，并返回创建的手续效果。
description_en: Registers a Contact Fusion Special Summon procedure on c, using material filter locations and the provided material operation, and returns the created procedure effect.

functions.name: Auxiliary.AddFusionEffectProc

params.name: filter
params.description: Fusion Monster filter for the Extra Deck candidate.

params.name: mat_location
params.description: Base material locations, commonly LOCATION_HAND+LOCATION_MZONE.

params.name: mat_filter
params.description: Optional candidate material filter.

params.name: mat_operation
params.description: Optional operation that moves the selected material group.

params.name: params
params.description: Optional advanced params forwarded to AddFusionEffectProcUltimate.

returns.description: The created Fusion effect.

description_zh: Auxiliary.AddFusionEffectProcUltimate的便捷包装。
它会根据常用的融合召唤参数构造params表：额外卡组过滤、素材位置、素材过滤、素材移动操作以及可选的高级params。
description_en: Convenience wrapper for Auxiliary.AddFusionEffectProcUltimate.
It builds a params table from the common Fusion Summon arguments: Extra Deck filter, material locations, material filter, material movement operation, and optional advanced params.

functions.name: Auxiliary.AddFusionEffectProcUltimate
description_zh: 创建由params描述的可配置融合召唤发动效果。
缺省的素材位置、素材筛选、素材操作、特殊召唤nocheck和Category字段会填入MDPro3默认值。除非params.reg为false，否则该效果会作为发动效果登记给c。
生成的效果会检查额外卡组中的融合怪兽、取得并过滤融合素材、支持Chain Material后备流程、选择素材、按配置操作移动素材、以SUMMON_TYPE_FUSION特殊召唤，并完成正规手续。
description_en: Creates the configurable Fusion Summon activation effect described by params.

Missing material locations, material filters, material operations, Special Summon nocheck, and category fields are filled with the MDPro3 defaults. Unless params.reg is false, the effect is registered to c as an activation effect.

The generated effect checks Fusion Monsters in the Extra Deck, gathers and filters Fusion Materials, supports Chain Material fallback, selects materials, moves them with the configured operations, Special Summons with SUMMON_TYPE_FUSION, and completes the procedure.

functions.name: Auxiliary.AddFusionProcCode2
description_zh: 给c登记需要卡号为code1和code2的素材的融合召唤手续。
该辅助函数会把sub和insf原样转交给Auxiliary.AddFusionProcMix。
description_en: Registers a Fusion Summon procedure on c requiring materials with card codes code1 and code2.
The helper forwards sub and insf unchanged to Auxiliary.AddFusionProcMix.

functions.name: Auxiliary.AddFusionProcCode2FunRep
description_zh: 登记融合素材手续，要求code1、code2，以及minc到maxc张满足f的额外素材。
description_en: Registers a Fusion Material procedure requiring code1, code2, and between minc and maxc additional materials that satisfy f.

functions.name: Auxiliary.AddFusionProcCode3
description_zh: 登记需要卡号code1、code2、code3的怪兽作为固定融合素材的融合素材手续。
description_en: Registers a Fusion Material procedure requiring monsters with code1, code2, and code3 as fixed materials.

functions.name: Auxiliary.AddFusionProcCode4
description_zh: 登记固定四个卡名的融合手续，要求code1、code2、code3、code4作为素材。
description_en: Registers a fixed four-name Fusion procedure requiring code1, code2, code3, and code4 as materials.

functions.name: Auxiliary.AddFusionProcCodeFun
description_zh: 给c登记需要code1以及cc个满足f的额外融合素材的融合召唤手续。
该辅助函数会构造cc份f，并连同sub和insf转交给Auxiliary.AddFusionProcMix。
description_en: Registers a Fusion Summon procedure on c requiring code1 and cc additional Fusion Materials matching f.
The helper builds cc copies of f and forwards them to Auxiliary.AddFusionProcMix together with sub and insf.

functions.name: Auxiliary.AddFusionProcCodeFunRep
description_zh: 登记融合手续，要求code1以及minc到maxc只满足f的素材。
description_en: Registers a Fusion procedure requiring code1 plus between minc and maxc materials that satisfy f.

functions.name: Auxiliary.AddFusionProcCodeRep
description_zh: 登记固定数量融合素材手续，要求cc只卡号为code1的怪兽。
description_en: Registers a fixed-count Fusion Material procedure requiring cc monsters with card code code1.

functions.name: Auxiliary.AddFusionProcCodeRep2
description_zh: 登记融合素材手续，要求minc到maxc张code1，并带有可选代用素材和Instant Fusion处理。
description_en: Registers a Fusion Material procedure requiring between minc and maxc copies of code1, with optional substitute and Instant Fusion handling.

functions.name: Auxiliary.AddFusionProcFun2
description_zh: 给c登记需要1个满足f1和1个满足f2的素材的融合召唤手续。
description_en: Registers a Fusion Summon procedure on c that requires one material satisfying f1 and one material satisfying f2.

functions.name: Auxiliary.AddFusionProcFunFun
description_zh: 登记融合手续，要求1只满足f1的素材以及cc只满足f2的素材。
description_en: Registers a Fusion procedure requiring one material satisfying f1 and cc materials satisfying f2.

functions.name: Auxiliary.AddFusionProcFunFunRep
description_zh: 登记融合手续，要求1只满足f1的素材以及minc到maxc只满足f2的素材。
description_en: Registers a Fusion procedure requiring f1 plus between minc and maxc materials that satisfy f2.

functions.name: Auxiliary.AddFusionProcFunRep
description_zh: 给c登记需要cc个满足同一素材筛选函数f的素材的融合召唤手续。
description_en: Registers a Fusion Summon procedure on c that requires cc materials satisfying the same material filter f.

functions.name: Auxiliary.AddFusionProcFunRep2
description_zh: 登记融合手续，要求minc到maxc只满足f的素材。
description_en: Registers a Fusion procedure requiring between minc and maxc materials that satisfy f.

functions.name: Auxiliary.AddFusionProcMix
description_zh: 给fcard登记固定数量的混合融合素材手续。
每个额外参数都是一个必需素材槽，可以是卡号、筛选函数或替代项table。数字素材槽会更新列名素材元数据。
description_en: Registers a fixed-count mixed Fusion Material procedure on fcard.
Each extra argument is a required material slot and may be a card code, filter function, or table of alternatives. Numeric material slots update listed-material metadata.

functions.name: Auxiliary.AddFusionProcMixRep

params.name: sub
params.description: Can be fusion summoned with substitute material

params.name: insf
params.description: Can be fusion summoned with no material (Instant Fusion)

description_zh: 登记混合融合素材手续，包含一个重复素材槽和任意数量的固定素材槽。
fun1是重复使用minc到maxc次的素材要求；后续参数是固定要求。每个要求可以是卡号、筛选函数，或由卡号和筛选函数组成的表。
description_en: Registers a mixed Fusion Material procedure with one repeated slot and any number of fixed slots.

fun1 is the repeated material requirement used minc to maxc times; additional arguments are fixed requirements. Each requirement may be a card code, filter function, or table of card codes and filters.

functions.name: Auxiliary.AddFusionProcShaddoll
description_zh: 登记影依融合素材手续，要求1只影依素材以及1只把attr作为融合素材属性的素材。
description_en: Registers the Shaddoll Fusion Material procedure requiring one Shaddoll material and one material with attr as Fusion Attribute.

functions.name: Auxiliary.AddLinkProcedure
description_zh: 为c登记标准连接召唤手续，并返回创建的Effect。
f筛选素材，min/max限制素材数量，gf可额外检查选中的素材组。
description_en: Registers the standard Link Summon procedure for c and returns the created Effect.
f filters materials, min/max constrain the material count, and gf optionally checks the selected material group.

functions.name: Auxiliary.AddRitualProcEqual
description_zh: 创建仪式召唤发动效果，所选素材的仪式等级合计必须正好等于仪式怪兽的原本等级。
description_en: Creates a Ritual Summon activation effect whose selected materials' Ritual Levels must exactly equal the Ritual Monster's original Level.

functions.name: Auxiliary.AddRitualProcEqual2
description_zh: 使用Card.GetLevel登记等级正好相等的仪式召唤手续，并返回创建的Effect。
description_en: Registers an exact-Level Ritual Summon procedure using Card.GetLevel and returns the created Effect.

functions.name: Auxiliary.AddRitualProcEqual2Code
description_zh: 把code1加入c的列名卡号，然后使用仪式怪兽当前等级创建等等级仪式召唤手续。
description_en: Adds code1 to c's listed codes, then creates an equal-Level Ritual Summon procedure using the Ritual Monster's current Level.

functions.name: Auxiliary.AddRitualProcEqual2Code2
description_zh: 把code1和code2加入c的列名卡号，然后为卡号为其中之一的仪式怪兽创建等等级仪式召唤手续。
description_en: Adds code1 and code2 to c's listed codes, then creates an equal-Level Ritual Summon procedure for Ritual Monsters with either code.

functions.name: Auxiliary.AddRitualProcEqualCode

params.name: summon_location
params.description: default: LOCATION_HAND

returns.description: Created Ritual Summon activation effect.

description_zh: 为卡号code1的仪式怪兽创建仪式召唤发动效果。
所选素材的仪式等级合计必须等于该仪式怪兽的原本等级；可选的墓地素材筛选、素材筛选和额外回调会传给共用仪式手续。
description_en: Creates a Ritual Summon activation effect for Ritual Monster code1.

The selected materials' Ritual Levels must exactly equal the Ritual Monster's original Level, and optional Graveyard material, material filter, and extra callbacks are forwarded to the shared Ritual procedure.

functions.name: Auxiliary.AddRitualProcGreater
description_zh: 创建仪式召唤发动效果，所选素材的仪式等级合计必须大于等于仪式怪兽的原本等级。
description_en: Creates a Ritual Summon activation effect whose selected materials' Ritual Levels must be greater than or equal to the Ritual Monster's original Level.

functions.name: Auxiliary.AddRitualProcGreater2

returns.description: The created Ritual Summon effect.

description_zh: 为c添加仪式召唤效果，使用仪式怪兽的当前等级，并要求素材等级合计大于等于该等级。
description_en: Adds a Ritual Summon effect for c that uses the Ritual Monster's current Level and requires materials whose total Level is greater than or equal to it.

functions.name: Auxiliary.AddRitualProcGreater2Code

returns.description: The created Ritual Summon effect.

description_zh: 把code1登记为c列名的编号，然后添加只适用于该编号仪式怪兽的Greater2仪式手续。
description_en: Registers code1 as listed by c, then adds the Greater2 Ritual procedure restricted to Ritual Monsters with that code.

functions.name: Auxiliary.AddRitualProcGreater2Code2

returns.description: The created Ritual Summon effect.

description_zh: 把code1和code2登记为c列名的编号，然后添加只适用于任一编号仪式怪兽的Greater2仪式手续。
description_en: Registers code1 and code2 as listed by c, then adds the Greater2 Ritual procedure restricted to Ritual Monsters with either code.

functions.name: Auxiliary.AddRitualProcGreaterCode

params.name: summon_location
params.description: default: LOCATION_HAND

description_zh: 为仪式怪兽code1登记仪式召唤手续，允许素材仪式等级合计大于等于仪式怪兽原本等级。
该辅助函数还会把code1加入c的卡号/素材列表，并返回创建的手续效果。
description_en: Registers a Ritual Summon procedure for Ritual Monster code1, allowing material Ritual Levels to meet or exceed the Ritual Monster's original Level.
The helper also adds code1 to c's code/material list and returns the created procedure effect.

functions.name: Auxiliary.AddRitualProcUltimate

params.name: filter
params.description: Ritual Monster filter. It receives the candidate Ritual Monster plus the helper's extra arguments and should return true for monsters this effect can Summon.

params.name: level_function
params.description: Function used to get the required value from the Ritual Monster, commonly Card.GetOriginalLevel or Card.GetLevel.

params.name: greater_or_equal
params.description: Use "Greater" for equal-or-higher material totals or "Equal" for exact totals.

params.name: summon_location
params.description: Location to search for the Ritual Monster. Defaults to LOCATION_HAND.

params.name: grave_filter
params.description: Optional filter for extra Graveyard materials that the helper may merge into the material pool.

params.name: mat_filter
params.description: Optional filter applied to candidate Ritual Materials before the material subgroup is selected.

params.name: pause
params.description: If true, returns the effect without registering it to c.

params.name: extra_operation
params.description: Optional callback run after the Ritual Summon operation. Local wrappers pass the Summoned monster and selected material group to this callback.

params.name: extra_target
params.description: Optional callback run during the target branch for extra operation info or activation checks.

returns.description: The created Ritual Summon activation effect. If pause is false or nil, the helper also registers it to c.

description_zh: 为c创建可配置的仪式召唤发动效果并返回它。
生成的效果会检查仪式怪兽、取得仪式素材、确认素材等级合计正好相等或大于等于需求、解放仪式素材、以SUMMON_TYPE_RITUAL特殊召唤，并完成正规手续。
普通仪式魔法通常使用包装辅助函数；需要墓地素材、素材过滤、不立即登记或额外目标/操作回调时，可直接调用此函数。
description_en: Creates the configurable Ritual Summon activation effect for c and returns it.

The generated effect checks for a Ritual Monster, gathers Ritual Materials, validates an equal or greater-or-equal material total, releases Ritual Materials, Special Summons with SUMMON_TYPE_RITUAL, and completes the procedure.
Use wrapper helpers for ordinary Ritual Spells, and call this directly when a script needs Graveyard material, a material filter, delayed registration, or extra target/operation callbacks.

functions.name: Auxiliary.AddSynchroMixProcedure
description_zh: 登记混合同调召唤手续：最多3个固定素材筛选条件，加上f4重复minc到maxc次。
最大数量会按c的等级扣除必要固定素材后进行上限限制。
description_en: Registers a mixed Synchro Summon procedure requiring up to three fixed material filters plus f4 repeated between minc and maxc times.
The maximum count is capped by c's Level after subtracting any required fixed materials.

functions.name: Auxiliary.AddSynchroProcedure
description_zh: Synchro monster, 1 tuner + min to max monsters
description_en: Registers the standard Synchro Summon procedure for c.
f1 filters the Tuner material, f2 filters non-Tuner materials, and minc/maxc set the number of non-Tuner materials required.

functions.name: Auxiliary.AddSynchroProcedure2
description_zh: 为c登记旧式同调召唤手续，要求1只调整和1只非调整怪兽作为素材。
等价于Auxiliary.AddSynchroProcedure(c, f1, f2, 1, 1)。
description_en: Backward-compatible helper for a Synchro Monster that uses exactly 1 Tuner and 1 non-Tuner material.
It calls Auxiliary.AddSynchroProcedure(c, f1, f2, 1, 1).

functions.name: Auxiliary.AddXyzProcedure
description_zh: Xyz monster, lv k*n
description_en: Registers the standard Xyz Summon procedure for c.
f filters materials, lv is the required Level, ct is the minimum material count, and maxct optionally caps the maximum. alterf/alterdesc/alterop define an alternate one-card Xyz Summon route.

functions.name: Auxiliary.AddXyzProcedureLevelFree
description_zh: 给c登记不检查等级的超量召唤手续。
该辅助函数使用f、gf、minc、maxc以及可选的替代召唤设置，且没有显式返回值。
description_en: Registers a Level-free Xyz Summon procedure on c.
This helper uses f, gf, minc, maxc, and optional alternate-summon settings, and returns no explicit value.

functions.name: Auxiliary.AssaultModeLimit

returns.description: true if the Summon matches /Assault Mode conditions.

description_zh: 「/爆裂体」怪兽的特殊召唤限制Value函数；允许/爆裂体召唤值，或由「爆裂模式」发动的效果。
description_en: Special Summon restriction value for /Assault Mode monsters; allows the Assault Mode summon value or effects activated by Assault Mode Activate.

functions.name: Auxiliary.CheckXyz2XMaterial

returns.description: true if c can be Xyz Summoned with double-material support.

description_zh: 检查c是否可以用mg中的素材进行超量召唤，并允许有效的EFFECT_DOUBLE_XMATERIAL卡按2个素材计数。
description_en: Checks whether c can be Xyz Summoned using materials from mg while allowing valid EFFECT_DOUBLE_XMATERIAL cards to count as two materials.

functions.name: Auxiliary.ContactFusionCondition

returns.description: Condition function for a Contact Fusion procedure.

description_zh: 返回接触融合手续的条件函数；从指定位置收集有效素材，并检查c的融合素材要求。
description_en: Returns the condition function for Contact Fusion procedures. It collects valid materials from the configured locations and checks c's Fusion Material requirement.

functions.name: Auxiliary.ContactFusionMaterialFilter

returns.description: true if c is valid Contact Fusion material for fc.

description_zh: 接触融合手续的素材筛选；该卡必须能作为fc的融合素材，且提供filter时也必须满足filter。
description_en: Material filter for Contact Fusion procedures. The card must be usable as Fusion Material for fc and must satisfy filter when one is provided.

functions.name: Auxiliary.ContactFusionOperation

returns.description: Operation function for a Contact Fusion procedure.

description_zh: 返回接触融合手续的操作函数；把已选择素材设置给融合怪兽，执行mat_operation，并删除保留的Group。
description_en: Returns the operation function for Contact Fusion procedures. It sets the selected materials on the Fusion Monster, runs mat_operation, and deletes the kept-alive group.

functions.name: Auxiliary.ContactFusionSendToDeck

returns.description: Material operation that shuffles materials into the Deck.

description_zh: 返回接触融合素材操作函数；必要时公开里侧素材，提示墓地/除外素材，并把全部素材作为费用洗回卡组。
description_en: Returns a Contact Fusion material operation that reveals face-down materials when needed, hints Graveyard/banished materials, and shuffles all materials into the Deck as cost.

functions.name: Auxiliary.ContactFusionTarget

returns.description: Target function for a Contact Fusion procedure.

description_zh: 返回接触融合手续的目标函数；选择融合素材，保留选择的Group并保存到效果上，返回是否选择成功。
description_en: Returns the target function for Contact Fusion procedures. It selects Fusion Materials, keeps the selected group alive, stores it on the effect, and returns whether selection succeeded.

functions.name: Auxiliary.DarkFusionLimit

returns.description: true if the Summon matches Dark Fusion conditions.

description_zh: 「邪心英雄」/「暗黑融合」类效果的特殊召唤限制Value函数；允许「暗黑融合」本身、暗黑融合召唤值，或玩家受编号72043279效果影响时的融合召唤。
description_en: Special Summon restriction value for Evil HERO/Dark Fusion effects; allows Dark Fusion itself, the Dark Fusion summon value, or Fusion Summons while the player is affected by effect code 72043279.

functions.name: Auxiliary.DualNormalCondition
description_zh: 二重辅助条件：处理对象表侧表示且当前不处于二重怪兽视为效果怪兽的状态时返回true。
description_en: Gemini helper condition that returns true when the handler is face-up and not currently in Gemini treated-as-effect state.

functions.name: Auxiliary.EnableDualAttribute
description_zh: 为c登记标准二重怪兽处理。
该卡可以再次通常召唤；并且在怪兽区域或墓地表侧表示且不处于二重状态时，当作通常怪兽而不是效果怪兽。
description_en: Registers standard Gemini Monster handling on c.
The card can be Normal Summoned again, and while face-up in the Monster Zone or GY and not in Dual State, it is treated as a Normal Monster instead of an Effect Monster.

functions.name: Auxiliary.EnablePendulumAttribute
description_zh: 为灵摆怪兽c登记灵摆召唤手续。
除非reg为false，否则也会登记从手牌发动该灵摆卡的效果。
description_en: Registers the Pendulum Summon procedure for Pendulum Monster c.
Unless reg is false, it also registers the Pendulum Card activation effect from the hand.

functions.name: Auxiliary.EnableReviveLimitPendulumSummonable

params.name: loc
params.description: default: 0xff

description_zh: 给c启用苏生限制处理，同时允许其从loc对应位置进行灵摆召唤。
该辅助函数会把loc保存到c的metatable，并在c成功灵摆召唤时完成正规手续。
description_en: Enables revive-limit handling for c while also allowing it to be Pendulum Summoned from loc.
The helper stores loc on c's metatable and completes c's procedure when it is successfully Pendulum Summoned.

functions.name: Auxiliary.FCheckMix

returns.description: true if the remaining mixed Fusion Material functions can be satisfied.

description_zh: 混合融合素材递归检查；按顺序检查每个必需素材函数，把已选素材记录在sg中，并在需要时消耗代替融合素材许可。
description_en: Recursive mixed Fusion Material checker. It tests one required material function at a time, tracks selected materials in sg, and consumes the substitute-material allowance when needed.

functions.name: Auxiliary.FCheckMixGoal

returns.description: true if sg is a valid mixed Fusion Material group.

description_zh: 混合融合素材的最终组检查；验证必须使用的融合素材、EFFECT_TUNE_MAGICIAN_F限制、额外怪兽区域可用性以及额外融合目标检查。
description_en: Final group check for mixed Fusion Materials. It validates mandatory Fusion Materials, Tune Magician restrictions, Extra Monster Zone availability, and additional Fusion goal hooks.

functions.name: Auxiliary.FCheckMixRep

returns.description: true if the mixed-repeat material requirements can be satisfied.

description_zh: 检查已选择的重复混合融合素材组；可重复素材函数负责可变数量素材，其余每个素材函数各满足1次。
description_en: Checks a selected mixed-repeat Fusion Material group. The repeated material function must cover the variable-count materials, while each remaining function is satisfied once.

functions.name: Auxiliary.FCheckMixRepFilter

returns.description: true if c can satisfy this fixed material slot and the rest can be completed.

description_zh: Auxiliary.FCheckMixRep使用的递归辅助函数；临时把c分配给剩余的一个固定素材函数，并继续检查其余要求。
description_en: Recursive helper for Auxiliary.FCheckMixRep. It temporarily assigns c to one remaining fixed material function and continues checking the rest.

functions.name: Auxiliary.FCheckMixRepGoal

returns.description: true if sg is a valid mixed-repeat Fusion Material group.

description_zh: 重复混合融合素材的最终目标检查；验证已选数量限制、额外怪兽区域可用性、额外融合检查以及固定/重复素材要求。
description_en: Final goal check for mixed-repeat Fusion Materials. It validates selected count limits, Extra Monster Zone availability, additional Fusion hooks, and fixed/repeated material requirements.

functions.name: Auxiliary.FCheckMixRepGoalCheck

returns.description: true if shared mixed-repeat goal prechecks pass.

description_zh: 重复混合融合素材目标的共通预检查；排除无效的EFFECT_TUNE_MAGICIAN_F组合、缺少必须融合素材以及额外目标检查失败的情况。
description_en: Shared precheck for mixed-repeat Fusion Material goals. It rejects invalid Tune Magician combinations, missing mandatory Fusion Materials, and failed goal hooks.

functions.name: Auxiliary.FCheckMixRepSelected

returns.description: true if the selected-material recursion can succeed.

description_zh: 重复混合融合素材选择递归辅助函数；使用已选择素材条件转交Auxiliary.FCheckMixRepTemplate处理。
description_en: Selection-recursion helper for mixed-repeat Fusion Materials; it delegates to Auxiliary.FCheckMixRepTemplate using the selected-material condition.

functions.name: Auxiliary.FCheckMixRepSelectedCond

returns.description: true if the current mixed-repeat selection can continue or finish.

description_zh: 判断当前重复混合融合素材选择是否可以继续递归，或是否可以通过Auxiliary.FCheckSelectMixRep完成。
description_en: Checks whether the recursive mixed-repeat selection can continue from the currently selected group, or can finish through Auxiliary.FCheckSelectMixRep.

functions.name: Auxiliary.FCheckMixRepTemplate

returns.description: true if c can be assigned to a fixed or repeated material slot.

description_zh: 重复混合融合素材检查的通用递归模板；尝试把c分配给每个固定素材函数，或分配给可重复素材位置。
description_en: Generic recursive template for mixed-repeat Fusion Material checks. It tries assigning c to each fixed material function or to the repeated material slot.

functions.name: Auxiliary.FCheckSelectMixRep

returns.description: true if the current selection can be completed.

description_zh: 检查当前重复混合融合素材选择是否可以从已选Group继续完成。
description_en: Checks whether a mixed-repeat Fusion Material selection can be completed from the current chosen group.

functions.name: Auxiliary.FCheckSelectMixRepAll

returns.description: true if the selection can be completed through c.

description_zh: 重复混合融合选择使用的递归辅助函数；用于场地空间限制已经满足或不需要检查的情况。
description_en: Recursive helper for mixed-repeat Fusion selection when field-space constraints are already satisfied or not required.

functions.name: Auxiliary.FCheckSelectMixRepM

returns.description: true if c is a valid Monster Zone candidate and the selection can be completed.

description_zh: 重复混合融合选择使用的递归辅助函数；要求下一个候选素材由tp控制且位于怪兽区域。
description_en: Recursive helper for mixed-repeat Fusion selection that requires the next candidate to be controlled by tp in the Monster Zone.

functions.name: Auxiliary.FConditionFilterMix

returns.description: true if c is valid material and satisfies any required material function.

description_zh: 混合融合手续使用的素材筛选；检查c是否可以作为fc的融合素材，并满足至少1个必需素材函数。
description_en: Material filter used by mixed Fusion procedures. It checks whether c can be used as Fusion Material for fc and satisfies at least one required material function.

functions.name: Auxiliary.FConditionMix

returns.description: Condition function for a fixed mixed Fusion Material procedure.

description_zh: 返回固定混合融合素材手续的条件函数。
description_en: Returns the condition function for fixed mixed Fusion Material procedures.

functions.name: Auxiliary.FConditionMixRep

returns.description: Condition function for a mixed-repeat Fusion Material procedure.

description_zh: 返回带可重复素材位置的混合融合素材手续的条件函数。
description_en: Returns the condition function for mixed Fusion Material procedures with a repeated material slot.

functions.name: Auxiliary.FMaterialFilter

returns.description: true if c can be used as Fusion Material.

description_zh: 融合效果的默认融合素材筛选；判断c是否可以作为融合素材。
description_en: Default Fusion Material filter for Fusion effects; returns whether c can be used as Fusion Material.

functions.name: Auxiliary.FMaterialRemove
description_zh: 把融合素材以融合相关原因标记除外的默认操作。
description_en: Default operation for banishing Fusion Materials with Fusion reason flags.

functions.name: Auxiliary.FMaterialRemoveFilter

returns.description: true if c can be banished.

description_zh: 会除外素材的融合效果使用的默认墓地素材筛选；判断c是否可以除外。
description_en: Default Graveyard-material filter for Fusion effects that banish materials; returns whether c can be banished.

functions.name: Auxiliary.FMaterialToDeck
description_zh: 把融合素材以融合相关原因标记回到卡组的默认操作。
description_en: Default operation for returning Fusion Materials to the Deck with Fusion reason flags.

functions.name: Auxiliary.FMaterialToGrave
description_zh: 把融合素材以融合相关原因标记送去墓地的默认操作。
description_en: Default operation for sending Fusion Materials to the Graveyard with Fusion reason flags.

functions.name: Auxiliary.FMaterialToGraveFilter

returns.description: true if c can be sent to the Graveyard.

description_zh: 会把素材送去墓地的融合效果使用的默认素材筛选；判断c是否可以送去墓地。
description_en: Default Fusion Material filter for effects that send materials to the Graveyard; returns whether c can be sent to the Graveyard.

functions.name: Auxiliary.FOperationMix

returns.description: Operation function for a fixed mixed Fusion Material procedure.

description_zh: 返回固定混合融合素材手续的操作函数；选择有效融合素材并通过Duel.SetFusionMaterial保存。
description_en: Returns the operation function for fixed mixed Fusion Material procedures; it selects valid materials and stores them with Duel.SetFusionMaterial.

functions.name: Auxiliary.FOperationMixRep

returns.description: Operation function for a mixed-repeat Fusion Material procedure.

description_zh: 返回带可重复素材位置的混合融合素材手续的操作函数；让玩家构建有效素材组并保存。
description_en: Returns the operation function for mixed Fusion Material procedures with a repeated material slot; it lets the player build a valid material group and stores it.

functions.name: Auxiliary.FossilFusionLimit

returns.description: true if the Summon matches Fossil Fusion conditions.

description_zh: 化石融合类效果的特殊召唤限制Value函数；允许化石融合召唤值、「化石融合」本身，或处理对象不在额外卡组。
description_en: Special Summon restriction value for Fossil Fusion effects; allows Fossil Fusion's summon value, Fossil Fusion itself, or non-Extra Deck handlers.

functions.name: Auxiliary.FSelectMixRep

returns.description: true if adding c can complete or continue the selection.

description_zh: 重复混合融合选择的候选检查；临时把c加入sg，并返回当前选择是否已经有效或仍可完成。
description_en: Candidate test for mixed-repeat Fusion selection. It temporarily adds c to sg and returns whether the selection is already valid or can still be completed.

functions.name: Auxiliary.FShaddollCondition

returns.description: Condition function for a Shaddoll Fusion procedure.

description_zh: 返回「影依」融合手续的条件函数；检查1个「影依」素材和1个指定属性素材，并支持场地效果使用对方怪兽作为素材。
description_en: Returns the condition function for Shaddoll Fusion procedures. It checks for one Shaddoll material and one material with the required Attribute, with optional field-spell opponent-material support.

functions.name: Auxiliary.FShaddollExFilter

returns.description: true if c is a valid opponent-field Shaddoll Fusion Material.

description_zh: 配合编号81788994效果使用的对方场上「影依」融合素材筛选；c必须表侧表示、受该场地效果影响，并满足标准「影依」素材筛选。
description_en: Opponent-field Shaddoll Fusion Material filter used with effect code 81788994; c must be face-up, affected by the field effect, and pass the standard Shaddoll material filter.

functions.name: Auxiliary.FShaddollFilter

returns.description: true if c is valid Shaddoll Fusion Material.

description_zh: 标准「影依」融合素材筛选；该卡必须是「影依」怪兽或匹配指定属性，可以作为融合素材，且未被编号6205579效果阻止。
description_en: Standard Shaddoll Fusion Material filter. The card must be either a Shaddoll monster or match the required Attribute, be usable as Fusion Material, and not be blocked by effect 6205579.

functions.name: Auxiliary.FShaddollFilter1

returns.description: true if c belongs to Shaddoll Fusion set 0x9d.

description_zh: c属于「影依」融合系列0x9d时返回true。
description_en: Returns true if c belongs to the Shaddoll Fusion set 0x9d.

functions.name: Auxiliary.FShaddollFilter2

returns.description: true if c has attr as Fusion Attribute or effect code 4904633.

description_zh: c具有指定融合属性，或具有编号4904633效果时返回true。
description_en: Returns true if c has the required Fusion Attribute or effect code 4904633.

functions.name: Auxiliary.FShaddollOperation

returns.description: Operation function for a Shaddoll Fusion procedure.

description_zh: 返回「影依」融合手续的操作函数；选择2张必需融合素材，必要时使用对方场上素材效果，并通过Duel.SetFusionMaterial保存。
description_en: Returns the operation function for Shaddoll Fusion procedures; it selects the two required materials, optionally using the opponent-field material effect, and stores them with Duel.SetFusionMaterial.

functions.name: Auxiliary.FShaddollSpFilter1

returns.description: true if c can be paired with another valid material.

description_zh: 检查c是否可以和mg或exg中的另一张有效「影依」融合素材配对。
description_en: Checks whether c can be paired with another valid Shaddoll Fusion Material from mg or exg.

functions.name: Auxiliary.FShaddollSpFilter2

returns.description: true if c and mc form a valid Shaddoll Fusion Material pair.

description_zh: 检查c和mc是否组成所需的「影依」融合素材组合，并同时遵守必须融合素材和额外融合检查。
description_en: Checks whether c and mc form the required Shaddoll Fusion Material pair while respecting mandatory Fusion Material and additional Fusion checks.

functions.name: Auxiliary.FusionEffectUltimateFilter

returns.description: true if c can be Fusion Summoned with the provided material pool.

description_zh: 检查c是否为可由e使用mg和params中筛选条件进行融合召唤的融合怪兽。
description_en: Checks whether c is a Fusion Monster that can be Fusion Summoned by e using mg and the filters stored in params.

functions.name: Auxiliary.FusionEffectUltimateMatFilter

returns.description: true if c is affected by e and passes f when provided.

description_zh: 融合效果素材筛选；排除不受e影响的素材，并在提供f时套用该素材筛选。
description_en: Fusion effect material filter; rejects materials immune to e and applies the optional material filter f.

functions.name: Auxiliary.FusionEffectUltimateMatLocFilter

returns.description: true if c is outside loc or passes f.

description_zh: 按位置使用的融合素材筛选；不在loc的卡直接通过，在loc的卡则需要在提供f时满足f。
description_en: Location-specific Fusion material filter; cards outside loc pass, and cards in loc must satisfy f when one is provided.

functions.name: Auxiliary.FusionEffectUltimateOperation

returns.description: Operation function for a configurable Fusion Summon effect.

description_zh: 返回可配置融合召唤效果的操作函数；构建素材池，处理连锁素材，按位置执行素材操作，特殊召唤选择的融合怪兽，并执行额外回调。
description_en: Returns the operation function for configurable Fusion Summon effects. It builds the material pool, handles Chain Material, applies per-location material operations, Special Summons the chosen Fusion Monster, and runs extra callbacks.

functions.name: Auxiliary.FusionEffectUltimateTarget

returns.description: Target function for a configurable Fusion Summon effect.

description_zh: 返回可配置融合召唤效果的目标函数；检查可召唤融合怪兽和素材池，处理连锁素材的备用检查，并登记操作信息。
description_en: Returns the target function for configurable Fusion Summon effects. It checks available Fusion Monsters and material pools, handles Chain Material fallback, and registers operation information.

functions.name: Auxiliary.fuslimit
description_zh: 特殊召唤条件辅助函数；当召唤类型st包含SUMMON_TYPE_FUSION时返回true。
description_en: Special Summon condition helper that returns true when summon type st contains SUMMON_TYPE_FUSION.

functions.name: Auxiliary.GetLinkCount
description_zh: 连接怪兽且连接值大于1时，返回1加上连接值左移到高16位后的值；其他情况返回1。
description_en: Returns 1 plus the Link Rating shifted into the high word for Link Monsters with Link Rating greater than 1; otherwise returns 1.

functions.name: Auxiliary.GetLinkMaterials

returns.description: Available Link Materials.

description_zh: 返回tp可用的连接素材，包括通常怪兽区域素材，以及由额外连接素材效果允许使用的卡。
description_en: Returns the available Link Materials for tp, including regular Monster Zone materials and cards allowed by extra Link Material effects.

functions.name: Auxiliary.GetMinSynchroLevel

returns.description: Smallest Synchro Level value c can provide.

description_zh: 返回c可为syncard提供的最小同调等级，包括打包保存的可选同调等级。
description_en: Returns the smallest Synchro Level value c can provide for syncard, including packed alternative Synchro Levels.

functions.name: Auxiliary.GetSynchroLevelFlowerCardian

returns.description: Fixed Synchro Level value 2.

description_zh: 返回「花札卫」辅助函数使用的固定同调等级。
description_en: Returns the fixed Synchro Level value used by Flower Cardian helpers.

functions.name: Auxiliary.GetSynMaterials

returns.description: Available Synchro Materials.

description_zh: 返回tp对syncard可用的同调素材；若场上素材允许使用手牌同调素材，也会合并有效手牌素材。
description_en: Returns the available Synchro Materials for tp and syncard, including valid hand materials when any field material enables hand Synchro use.

functions.name: Auxiliary.IsDualState
description_zh: 条件辅助函数：e的处理对象未被无效且处于二重状态时返回true。
description_en: Condition helper that is true when e's handler is not disabled and is in Dual State.

functions.name: Auxiliary.IsNotDualState
description_zh: 二重辅助条件：效果被无效，或处理对象不处于二重怪兽视为效果怪兽状态时返回true。
description_en: Gemini helper condition that returns true when the effect is disabled or its handler is not in Gemini treated-as-effect state.

functions.name: Auxiliary.LCheckGoal

returns.description: true if sg is a valid Link Material group.

description_zh: 连接素材组的最终检查；验证连接数值合计、额外怪兽区域可用性、可选组筛选、额外素材兼容性，以及是否包含指定lmat。
description_en: Final Link Material group check. It verifies Link Rating total, Extra Monster Zone availability, optional group filter, extra-material compatibility, and required lmat inclusion.

functions.name: Auxiliary.LCheckOtherMaterial

returns.description: true if c is compatible with mg.

description_zh: 通过EFFECT_EXTRA_LINK_MATERIAL处理函数检查c是否与其他已选连接素材兼容。
description_en: Checks whether c is compatible with the other selected Link Materials through EFFECT_EXTRA_LINK_MATERIAL handlers.

functions.name: Auxiliary.LConditionFilter

returns.description: true if c is regular Link Material.

description_zh: 通常连接素材筛选；该卡必须可见或可被e选择，可以作为lc的连接素材，并在提供f时满足f。
description_en: Regular Link Material filter. The card must be visible or selectable by e, usable as Link Material for lc, and satisfy f when provided.

functions.name: Auxiliary.LExtraFilter

returns.description: true if c can be used through an extra Link Material effect.

description_zh: 由EFFECT_EXTRA_LINK_MATERIAL允许的额外连接素材筛选，用于手牌、魔法/陷阱区域或对方场上的卡。
description_en: Extra Link Material filter for hand, Spell & Trap Zone, or opponent-field cards granted by EFFECT_EXTRA_LINK_MATERIAL.

functions.name: Auxiliary.LExtraMaterialCount
description_zh: 对通过有效EFFECT_EXTRA_LINK_MATERIAL效果使用的已选连接素材消耗次数限制。
description_en: Consumes count limits for selected Link Materials that were used through valid EFFECT_EXTRA_LINK_MATERIAL effects.

functions.name: Auxiliary.LinkCondition

returns.description: Condition function for a Link Summon procedure.

description_zh: 返回连接召唤手续的条件函数。
description_en: Returns the condition function for Link Summon procedures.

functions.name: Auxiliary.linklimit
description_zh: 特殊召唤条件辅助函数：仅当st包含SUMMON_TYPE_LINK时返回true。
description_en: Special Summon condition helper that returns true only when st contains SUMMON_TYPE_LINK.

functions.name: Auxiliary.LinkOperation

returns.description: Operation function for a Link Summon procedure.

description_zh: 返回连接召唤手续的操作函数；设置素材，消耗额外素材次数限制，并把素材送去墓地。
description_en: Returns the operation function for Link Summon procedures; it sets the materials, consumes extra-material count limits, and sends the materials to the Graveyard.

functions.name: Auxiliary.LinkTarget

returns.description: Target function for a Link Summon procedure.

description_zh: 返回连接召唤手续的目标函数；选择有效连接素材子组并保存在效果上。
description_en: Returns the target function for Link Summon procedures; it selects a valid Link Material subgroup and stores it on the effect.

functions.name: Auxiliary.LUncompatibilityFilter

returns.description: true if c is incompatible with the rest of sg.

description_zh: c与其他已选连接素材不兼容时返回true。
description_en: Returns true when c is not compatible with the other selected Link Materials.

functions.name: Auxiliary.MaskChangeLimit

returns.description: true if the Summon matches Mask Change conditions.

description_zh: Masked HERO/Mask Change类效果的特殊召唤限制Value函数；允许Mask Change召唤值，或由编号21143940的卡发动的效果。
description_en: Special Summon restriction value for Masked HERO/Mask Change effects; allows the Mask Change summon value or effects activated by card code 21143940.

functions.name: Auxiliary.MustMaterialCheck
description_zh: 检查tp受到的code类型必须素材效果是否已经满足。
v为nil时，只有Duel.GetMustMaterial(tp, code)为空才成功，但utility脚本中存在硬编码的超量和同调素材例外。v提供时，返回Duel.CheckMustMaterial(tp, v, code)的结果。
description_en: Checks whether tp's required-material effects of type code are satisfied.

When v is nil, the helper succeeds only if Duel.GetMustMaterial(tp, code) is empty, except for the hard-coded Xyz and Synchro material exceptions present in the utility script. When v is supplied, it returns Duel.CheckMustMaterial(tp, v, code).

functions.name: Auxiliary.MustMaterialCounterFilter
description_zh: c不包含在g中时返回true，用于检查候选素材组是否漏掉必须素材。
description_en: Returns true when c is not contained in g; used to detect mandatory materials missing from a candidate material group.

functions.name: Auxiliary.NonTuner
description_en: Returns a non-Tuner material filter that also applies f when f is supplied.
Extra arguments are captured now and passed to f after the Card argument.

functions.name: Auxiliary.PConditionExtraFilter

returns.description: true if any extra Pendulum Summon effect allows c.

description_zh: 检查eset中的任意额外灵摆召唤效果是否允许c在当前刻度下使用。
description_en: Checks whether any extra Pendulum Summon effect in eset allows c for the current scales.

functions.name: Auxiliary.PConditionExtraFilterSpecific

returns.description: true if te allows c or te is nil.

description_zh: 检查1个额外灵摆召唤效果是否允许c在当前刻度下使用。
description_en: Checks whether one extra Pendulum Summon effect allows c for the current scales.

functions.name: Auxiliary.PConditionFilter

returns.description: true if c can be Pendulum Summoned.

description_zh: 灵摆召唤候选筛选；检查位置、等级或pendulum_level、刻度、特殊召唤合法性、禁止状态，以及额外灵摆召唤许可。
description_en: Pendulum Summon candidate filter. It checks location, Level or pendulum_level, scales, Special Summon legality, forbidden state, and extra Pendulum Summon permissions.

functions.name: Auxiliary.PendCondition

returns.description: true if a Pendulum Summon is available.

description_zh: 共通灵摆召唤手续的条件函数；检查2个灵摆区域、可用位置和区域、每回合状态，以及可召唤怪兽。
description_en: Condition function for the shared Pendulum Summon procedure. It checks the two Pendulum Zones, available locations and zones, once-per-turn state, and valid summonable monsters.

functions.name: Auxiliary.PendOperation
description_zh: 共通灵摆召唤手续的操作函数；选择通常或额外灵摆召唤效果，在手牌/额外卡组区域限制内选择怪兽，更新检查标记，并把选择合并到sg。
description_en: Operation function for the shared Pendulum Summon procedure. It chooses the regular or extra Pendulum Summon effect, selects monsters within hand/Extra Deck zone limits, updates the checklist, and merges the selection into sg.

functions.name: Auxiliary.PendOperationCheck

returns.description: Group check for Pendulum Summon zone limits.

description_zh: 返回组检查函数，用于限制一次灵摆召唤选择中的手牌数量、额外卡组数量和总区域数量。
description_en: Returns a group check that enforces the hand, Extra Deck, and total zone limits for a Pendulum Summon selection.

functions.name: Auxiliary.PendulumReset
description_zh: 在抽卡阶段开始时重置共通灵摆召唤检查标记。
description_en: Resets the shared Pendulum Summon checklist at the start of the Draw Phase.

functions.name: Auxiliary.PendulumSummonableBool

returns.description: true if c's current location is Pendulum Summonable by its flag.

description_zh: c具有psummonable_location标记且当前位置包含在其中时返回true。
description_en: Returns true if c has a psummonable_location flag that includes its current location.

functions.name: Auxiliary.penlimit
description_zh: 特殊召唤条件辅助函数：仅当st包含SUMMON_TYPE_PENDULUM时返回true。
description_en: Special Summon condition helper that returns true only when st contains SUMMON_TYPE_PENDULUM.

functions.name: Auxiliary.PSSCompleteProcedure
description_zh: 对通过复活限制辅助函数设置、并以灵摆召唤特殊召唤的怪兽完成正规手续。
description_en: Completes the procedure for monsters that were Special Summoned by Pendulum Summon through the revive-limit helper.

functions.name: Auxiliary.ritlimit
description_zh: 特殊召唤条件辅助函数：仅当召唤类型包含SUMMON_TYPE_RITUAL时返回true。
description_en: Special Summon condition helper that returns true only when the Summon Type contains SUMMON_TYPE_RITUAL.

functions.name: Auxiliary.RitualCheck
description_zh: 仪式素材组判定：检查区域可用性、指定的Greater/Equal等级规则、自定义mat_group_check以及RCheckAdditional。
description_en: Ritual material group predicate that checks zone availability, the requested Greater/Equal level rule, custom mat_group_check, and RCheckAdditional.

functions.name: Auxiliary.RitualCheckAdditional

returns.description: Additional Ritual Material subgroup check.

description_zh: 返回仪式素材选择时使用的额外子组检查函数，支持Equal或Greater仪式手续。
description_en: Returns an additional subgroup check used while selecting Ritual Materials for Equal or Greater Ritual procedures.

functions.name: Auxiliary.RitualCheckAdditionalLevel

returns.description: Smallest usable Ritual Level value.

description_zh: 当c的仪式等级打包了2个可选数值时，返回较小的可用仪式等级。
description_en: Returns the smaller usable Ritual Level value for c when its Ritual Level packs two alternatives.

functions.name: Auxiliary.RitualCheckEqual

returns.description: true if g exactly matches lv.

description_zh: 检查g中仪式等级合计是否正好等于c所需的lv。
description_en: Checks whether g's Ritual Levels exactly equal lv for c.

functions.name: Auxiliary.RitualCheckGreater

returns.description: true if g reaches at least lv.

description_zh: 检查g中仪式等级合计是否大于或等于c所需的lv。
description_en: Checks whether g's Ritual Levels are greater than or equal to lv for c.

functions.name: Auxiliary.RitualExtraFilter

returns.description: true if c is valid extra Graveyard Ritual Material.

description_zh: 墓地仪式素材筛选；c必须是f接受的有等级怪兽，并且可以被除外。
description_en: Graveyard Ritual Material filter; c must be a Level monster accepted by f and able to be banished.

functions.name: Auxiliary.RitualUltimateFilter

returns.description: true if c can be Ritual Summoned.

description_zh: 检查c是否为可用现有素材组以及所选Equal或Greater等级规则进行仪式召唤的有效仪式怪兽。
description_en: Checks whether c is a valid Ritual Monster that can be Ritual Summoned with the available material groups and the selected Equal or Greater level rule.

functions.name: Auxiliary.RitualUltimateOperation

returns.description: Operation function for a configurable Ritual Summon effect.

description_zh: 返回可配置仪式召唤效果的操作函数；选择仪式怪兽和素材，解放或除外素材，特殊召唤该怪兽，并执行额外回调。
description_en: Returns the operation function for configurable Ritual Summon effects. It selects the Ritual Monster and materials, releases or banishes the materials, Special Summons the monster, and runs extra callbacks.

functions.name: Auxiliary.RitualUltimateTarget

returns.description: Target function for a configurable Ritual Summon effect.

description_zh: 返回可配置仪式召唤效果的目标函数；检查仪式怪兽和素材池，并登记特殊召唤、除外及额外目标信息。
description_en: Returns the target function for configurable Ritual Summon effects. It checks Ritual Monsters and material pools, then registers Special Summon, banish, and extra target information.

functions.name: Auxiliary.SynCondition

returns.description: Condition function for a basic Synchro Summon procedure.

description_zh: 返回基础同调召唤手续的条件函数，并支持可选的固定调整素材处理。
description_en: Returns the condition function for basic Synchro Summon procedures, including optional fixed tuner material handling.

functions.name: Auxiliary.SynGroupCheckLevelAddition

returns.description: Group check for Synchro material Level pruning.

description_zh: 返回同调素材选择使用的组检查函数；要求已选素材的最小同调等级合计不超过syncard的等级。
description_en: Returns a group check for Synchro material selection that keeps the sum of the selected materials' minimum Synchro Levels at or below syncard's Level.

functions.name: Auxiliary.synlimit
description_zh: 特殊召唤条件辅助函数：仅当st包含SUMMON_TYPE_SYNCHRO时返回true。
description_en: Special Summon condition helper that returns true only when st contains SUMMON_TYPE_SYNCHRO.

functions.name: Auxiliary.SynLimitFilter

returns.description: true if f rejects c.

description_zh: 限制函数f存在且拒绝c作为syncard的素材时返回true。
description_en: Returns true when limiter function f exists and rejects c for syncard.

functions.name: Auxiliary.SynMaterialFilter

returns.description: true if c is usable Synchro Material.

description_zh: 同调素材筛选；c必须表侧表示或公开，并且可以作为syncard的同调素材。
description_en: Synchro Material filter; c must be face-up or public and usable as Synchro Material for syncard.

functions.name: Auxiliary.SynMixCheck

returns.description: true if the mixed Synchro Material selection can be completed.

description_zh: 检查剩余混合同调素材池是否能在可变素材数量范围内，完成当前已选固定素材组。
description_en: Checks whether the remaining mixed Synchro Material pool can complete the selected fixed-material group within the variable material count range.

functions.name: Auxiliary.SynMixCheckGoal

returns.description: true if sg plus sg1 is a valid mixed Synchro Material group.

description_zh: 混合同调素材组的最终检查；验证数量、额外怪兽区域、组回调、指定素材、必须同调素材、EFFECT_TUNE_MAGICIAN限制、等级合计、手牌素材限制以及调整限制。
description_en: Final mixed Synchro Material group check. It validates count, Extra Monster Zone availability, group callback, fixed material, mandatory Synchro Materials, EFFECT_TUNE_MAGICIAN restrictions, Level total, hand-material limits, and tuner limits.

functions.name: Auxiliary.SynMixCheckPrune

returns.description: true if the branch can be pruned by minimum Synchro Level total.

description_zh: 混合同调搜索的剪枝检查；当已选素材的最小同调等级合计达到syncard等级时返回true。
description_en: Pruning check for mixed Synchro searches; returns true once the selected materials' minimum Synchro Level total reaches syncard's Level.

functions.name: Auxiliary.SynMixCheckRecursive

returns.description: true if the recursive search can reach a valid group.

description_zh: 混合同调素材搜索的递归辅助函数；临时加入c，检查目标，并在分支仍可能成立时继续搜索mg。
description_en: Recursive mixed Synchro Material search helper. It temporarily adds c, checks the goal, and continues through mg while the branch remains possible.

functions.name: Auxiliary.SynMixCondition

returns.description: Condition function for a mixed Synchro Summon procedure.

description_zh: 返回混合同调召唤手续的条件函数；支持最多3个固定素材筛选和1个可变素材位置。
description_en: Returns the condition function for mixed Synchro Summon procedures with up to three fixed material filters and a variable material slot.

functions.name: Auxiliary.SynMixFilter1

returns.description: true if c can fill the first fixed material slot.

description_zh: 混合同调手续的第1个固定素材候选筛选。
description_en: First fixed-material candidate filter for mixed Synchro procedures.

functions.name: Auxiliary.SynMixFilter2

returns.description: true if c can fill the second fixed material slot or advance selection.

description_zh: 混合同调手续的第2个固定素材候选筛选；若不需要第2个筛选，则转入可变素材位置。
description_en: Second fixed-material candidate filter for mixed Synchro procedures, or the transition into the variable material slot when no second filter is required.

functions.name: Auxiliary.SynMixFilter3

returns.description: true if c can fill the third fixed material slot or advance selection.

description_zh: 混合同调手续的第3个固定素材候选筛选；若不需要第3个筛选，则转入可变素材位置。
description_en: Third fixed-material candidate filter for mixed Synchro procedures, or the transition into the variable material slot when no third filter is required.

functions.name: Auxiliary.SynMixFilter4

returns.description: true if c can fill the variable material slot.

description_zh: 混合同调手续的可变素材候选筛选；加入c后检查剩余素材池是否还能完成召唤。
description_en: Variable-slot candidate filter for mixed Synchro procedures; after adding c it checks whether the remaining material pool can complete the summon.

functions.name: Auxiliary.SynMixHandCheck

returns.description: true if hand Synchro Materials in g are legal.

description_zh: 检查已选手牌同调素材是否由允许使用手牌同调素材的卡支持，并验证筛选和数量限制。
description_en: Checks whether selected hand Synchro Materials are allowed by a material that grants hand Synchro use, including filter and count limits.

functions.name: Auxiliary.SynMixHandFilter

returns.description: true if c is a hand material enabled by another card.

description_zh: 当手牌素材是因为其他卡允许而被使用、不是依靠自身额外同调素材效果时返回true。
description_en: Returns true for a hand material that is being used because another card enables it, rather than by its own extra Synchro Material effect.

functions.name: Auxiliary.SynMixOperation

returns.description: Operation function for a mixed Synchro Summon procedure.

description_zh: 返回混合同调召唤手续的操作函数；设置素材，把素材送去墓地，并释放保留的Group。
description_en: Returns the operation function for mixed Synchro Summon procedures; it sets materials, sends them to the Graveyard, and releases the kept group.

functions.name: Auxiliary.SynMixTarget

returns.description: Target function for a mixed Synchro Summon procedure.

description_zh: 返回混合同调召唤手续的目标函数；引导素材选择，并把选择的Group保存在效果上。
description_en: Returns the target function for mixed Synchro Summon procedures; it guides material selection and stores the selected group on the effect.

functions.name: Auxiliary.SynOperation

returns.description: Operation function for a basic Synchro Summon procedure.

description_zh: 返回基础同调召唤手续的操作函数；设置素材，把素材送去墓地，并释放保留的Group。
description_en: Returns the operation function for basic Synchro Summon procedures; it sets materials, sends them to the Graveyard, and releases the kept group.

functions.name: Auxiliary.SynTarget

returns.description: Target function for a basic Synchro Summon procedure.

description_zh: 返回基础同调召唤手续的目标函数；选择同调素材并把选择的Group保存在效果上。
description_en: Returns the target function for basic Synchro Summon procedures; it selects Synchro Materials and stores the selected group on the effect.

functions.name: Auxiliary.TuneMagicianCheckAdditionalX

returns.description: Group check that rejects invalid EFFECT_TUNE_MAGICIAN_* pairs.

description_zh: 已废弃的工厂函数；返回组检查函数，用于排除含有对ecode无效的EFFECT_TUNE_MAGICIAN_*组合的素材组。
description_en: Deprecated factory that returns a group check rejecting groups with an invalid EFFECT_TUNE_MAGICIAN_* pair for ecode.

functions.name: Auxiliary.TuneMagicianCheckAdditionalXyz

returns.description: true if g has no invalid EFFECT_TUNE_MAGICIAN_X pair.

description_zh: 超量素材组的额外检查；排除无效的EFFECT_TUNE_MAGICIAN_X组合。
description_en: Additional Xyz material group check that rejects invalid EFFECT_TUNE_MAGICIAN_X pairs.

functions.name: Auxiliary.TuneMagicianCheckX
description_zh: 检查c是否具有ecode效果，且该效果的Value会拒绝已选Group sg中的至少另一张卡。
description_en: Checks whether c has an ecode effect whose value rejects at least one other card in selected group sg.

functions.name: Auxiliary.TuneMagicianFilter
description_zh: 取得效果e的Value函数并以f(e, c)调用，返回该结果。
description_en: Calls the effect's value function as f(e, c) and returns that result.

functions.name: Auxiliary.Tuner
description_zh: 返回一个素材筛选函数：接受对syncard来说是调整，且在提供f时满足f(target, ...)的卡。
description_en: Returns a material filter that accepts cards that are Tuners for syncard and also satisfy f(target, ...), when f is supplied.

functions.name: Auxiliary.Xyz2XMaterialEffectFilter

returns.description: true if c has a valid EFFECT_DOUBLE_XMATERIAL effect.

description_zh: 检查c是否具有对xyzc有效的EFFECT_DOUBLE_XMATERIAL效果；checked为true时可跳过通常超量素材筛选。
description_en: Checks whether c has a valid EFFECT_DOUBLE_XMATERIAL effect for xyzc, optionally skipping the normal Xyz Material filter when checked is true.

functions.name: Auxiliary.Xyz2XMaterialFilter

returns.description: true if c is valid Xyz Material for double-material handling.

description_zh: 双重素材处理用的超量素材筛选；c必须表侧表示或公开，可以作为xyzc的超量素材，匹配lv，并在提供f时满足f。
description_en: Xyz Material filter for double-material handling; c must be face-up or public, usable as Xyz Material for xyzc, match lv, and satisfy f when provided.

functions.name: Auxiliary.Xyz2XMaterialGoal

returns.description: true if g satisfies the double-material Xyz requirements.

description_zh: 可能使用EFFECT_DOUBLE_XMATERIAL的超量召唤最终组检查；验证额外怪兽区域、EFFECT_XYZ_MIN_COUNT，以及双重素材效果是否足以满足minc。
description_en: Final group check for Xyz Summons that may use EFFECT_DOUBLE_XMATERIAL. It validates Extra Monster Zone availability, EFFECT_XYZ_MIN_COUNT, and whether double-material effects cover minc.

functions.name: Auxiliary.Xyz2XMaterialOperation
description_zh: 为已选素材组中需要用于满足最小素材数量的EFFECT_DOUBLE_XMATERIAL卡消耗次数限制。
description_en: Consumes the count limits for selected EFFECT_DOUBLE_XMATERIAL cards needed for the selected group to satisfy the minimum material count.

functions.name: Auxiliary.XyzAlterFilter

returns.description: true if c is a valid alternate Xyz Material.

description_zh: 替代超量召唤候选筛选；检查alterf、超量素材合法性、额外怪兽区域、必须超量素材、EFFECT_XYZ_MIN_COUNT以及可选alterop验证。
description_en: Alternate Xyz Summon candidate filter. It checks alterf, Xyz Material legality, Extra Monster Zone availability, mandatory Xyz Materials, EFFECT_XYZ_MIN_COUNT, and optional alterop validation.

functions.name: Auxiliary.XyzCondition

returns.description: Condition function for a standard Xyz Summon procedure.

description_zh: 返回标准超量召唤手续的条件函数，支持可选的1张素材替代超量召唤以及EFFECT_DOUBLE_XMATERIAL处理。
description_en: Returns the condition function for standard Xyz Summon procedures, including optional alternate one-card Xyz Summon and EFFECT_DOUBLE_XMATERIAL handling.

functions.name: Auxiliary.XyzLevelFreeCondition

returns.description: Condition function for a Level-free Xyz Summon procedure.

description_zh: 返回不检查等级的超量召唤手续的条件函数，支持可选组筛选和1张素材替代超量召唤。
description_en: Returns the condition function for Level-free Xyz Summon procedures with optional group filter and alternate one-card Xyz Summon support.

functions.name: Auxiliary.XyzLevelFreeFilter

returns.description: true if c is valid Level-free Xyz Material.

description_zh: 不检查等级的超量素材筛选；c在场上时必须表侧表示，可以作为xyzc的超量素材，并在提供f时满足f。
description_en: Level-free Xyz Material filter; c must be face-up if on the field, usable as Xyz Material for xyzc, and satisfy f when provided.

functions.name: Auxiliary.XyzLevelFreeGoal

returns.description: true if g satisfies the Level-free Xyz requirements.

description_zh: 不检查等级的超量召唤最终组检查；验证额外怪兽区域、可选组筛选gf以及EFFECT_XYZ_MIN_COUNT要求。
description_en: Final group check for Level-free Xyz Summons. It validates Extra Monster Zone availability, optional group filter gf, and EFFECT_XYZ_MIN_COUNT requirements.

functions.name: Auxiliary.XyzLevelFreeOperation

returns.description: Operation function for a Level-free Xyz Summon procedure.

description_zh: 返回不检查等级的超量召唤手续操作函数；处理替代召唤，把原本叠放素材因规则送去墓地，设置素材并叠放。
description_en: Returns the operation function for Level-free Xyz Summon procedures; it handles alternate summons, sends old overlay cards to the Graveyard by rule, sets materials, and overlays them.

functions.name: Auxiliary.XyzLevelFreeTarget

returns.description: Target function for a Level-free Xyz Summon procedure.

description_zh: 返回不检查等级的超量召唤手续目标函数；在替代素材和通常组选素材之间选择，并保存所选Group。
description_en: Returns the target function for Level-free Xyz Summon procedures; it chooses between alternate material and regular group selection and stores the selected group.

functions.name: Auxiliary.xyzlimit
description_zh: 特殊召唤条件辅助函数：仅当st包含SUMMON_TYPE_XYZ时返回true。
description_en: Special Summon condition helper that returns true only when st contains SUMMON_TYPE_XYZ.

functions.name: Auxiliary.XyzOperation

returns.description: Operation function for a standard Xyz Summon procedure.

description_zh: 返回标准超量召唤手续的操作函数；处理替代召唤、双重素材次数限制，把原本叠放素材因规则送去墓地，设置素材并叠放。
description_en: Returns the operation function for standard Xyz Summon procedures; it handles alternate summons, double-material count limits, sends old overlay cards to the Graveyard by rule, sets materials, and overlays them.

functions.name: Auxiliary.XyzTarget

returns.description: Target function for a standard Xyz Summon procedure.

description_zh: 返回标准超量召唤手续的目标函数；在替代素材、双重素材组选取以及通常超量素材选择之间进行处理。
description_en: Returns the target function for standard Xyz Summon procedures; it chooses between alternate material, double-material group selection, and regular Xyz Material selection.
